#### Run 17f: the enters-side event bindings and "instead" effects

Row 17f was split into 17f to 17h (the run table): its list is seven unrelated mechanisms. This run takes the ones a
"whenever [an object] enters" ability reads; `AllyCombatDamageTriggerEffect` (18 cards whose effects act on the
creature that dealt combat damage by rebinding the entry's source) is row 17g, and the abilities still held as effects
by emblems and grants (`SpellCastTriggerEffect` on emblems, Olivia's granted `StateTriggerEffect`) row 17h. Row 17g's
old content, the collectors that judge an authored conditional by type, is row 17i.

**What the scan found.**

- `EvolveTriggerEffect` had two roles. The evolve keyword's collector (`TriggerCollectionService.collectEvolveTrigger`)
  judged the comparison as the ability triggered and bound the entering creature's power and toughness into the
  entry; and four cards authored it: Hulkling, Burgeoning Bruiser, Evolving Adaptive (`(CounterType.OIL)`) and
  Sharp-Eyed Rookie (`(alsoResolve)`, the Clue), which a class-keyed handler (`EnterTriggerCollectorService
  .handleAllyEvolve`) judged and bound the same way. None of the three has the keyword (their own abilities are worded
  like it), and Pollywog Prodigy, which has the keyword (`Keyword.EVOLVE`, from Scryfall), authored it a second time,
  so its evolve triggered twice. The handler fired `Triggers.evolves()` for any +1/+1 counter it placed.
- `ChampionOfTheHareishTriggerEffect` was bound by a class-keyed handler with the entering creature's types as it
  triggered (and skipped the trigger when there were none).
- `TriggeringPermanentEntryExclusionEffect` was Kodama of the East Tree's: `PutCardToBattlefieldEffect`'s flag (and
  `MayEffect`'s delegation) told the "you may" enter handler to skip a permanent the source had put onto the
  battlefield.
- Oran-Rief Hydra and Emeria Shepherd were two abilities each (step 14 run 16t), one per branch of "if that land is a
  Forest (Plains) … instead", filtered by the land as it entered.

**The model.**

- Evolve's intervening "if" is `TriggeringPermanentHasGreaterPowerOrToughnessThanSource` (new condition, CR 702.100a,
  checked): the triggering permanent and the source, each as it is on the battlefield or as it last existed there
  (its departure snapshot, CR 608.2h, checked); a permanent on the battlefield that isn't a creature never compares
  (CR 702.100c, checked). The keyword's collector judges it as the ability triggers and puts `ConditionalEffect(it,
  EvolveEffect)` on the stack (CR 603.4, checked), so it is checked again as it resolves. `EvolveEffect` (renamed from
  `EvolveTriggerEffect`, no fields, engine-only) puts the +1/+1 counter on the source and fires `Triggers.evolves()`
  when it lands (CR 702.100b, checked). No stats are bound into the entry.
- Hulkling, Evolving Adaptive and Sharp-Eyed Rookie: `Triggers.enters(CREATURE, ANOTHER_YOU_CONTROL)`,
  `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(new TriggeringPermanentHasGreaterPowerOrToughnessThanSource())`, and
  `PutCountersOnSourceEffect(1, 1, 1)` / `PutCountersOnSelfEffect(CounterType.OIL)` /
  `SequenceEffect.of(PutCountersOnSourceEffect(1, 1, 1), CreateTokenEffect.ofClueToken(1))`. The pipeline judges the
  "if" as the ability triggers (with the entering permanent as the context's triggering permanent) and wraps the
  effect in it. Sharp-Eyed's two effects are one sequence: the pipeline wraps each registration in the "if", so two
  registrations checked it twice and the counter made the second check fail.
- Champion of the Hareish: `BuddyListGrowOrWriteEffect` (renamed from `ChampionOfTheHareishTriggerEffect`, no fields)
  reads the stack entry's triggering creature as the ability resolves: its types now (every creature type for
  changeling), else as it last existed on the battlefield. The generic enter collector puts it on the stack.
- "If it wasn't put onto the battlefield with this ability" (Kodama) is the trigger's filter,
  `PermanentNotPredicate(new PermanentPutOntoBattlefieldBySourcePredicate())` (new predicate, judged with the watching
  source as the filter's source): a fact of the entering permanent that can't change. Every permanent
  `PutCardToBattlefieldEffect` puts from a hand records the permanent whose ability put it
  (`Permanent.putOntoBattlefieldWithAbilitySourcePermanentId`, existing), not only Kodama's.
- Oran-Rief Hydra and Emeria Shepherd are one ability each: `ConditionalReplacementEffect(new
  TriggeringPermanentHasSubtype(FOREST / PLAINS), base, upgraded)`, read as the ability resolves. A land that leaves
  first is read as it last existed: `PermanentRemovalService` records the triggering permanent's last-known card (the
  layered types, subtypes and colors of `snapshotEffectivePermanentCard`) on every stack entry whose triggering
  permanent leaves (`StackEntry.triggeringPermanentLastKnownCard`, new, copied by the copy constructor), and
  `EffectResolutionService` gives a `TriggeringPermanentHasSubtype` "if" or "instead" that card as its triggering card
  once the permanent is gone. A new field rather than `lastKnownPermanentCards`, which the token-copy handlers read for
  copiable values.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17f-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module): Hulkling, Evolving Adaptive,
Sharp-Eyed Rookie, Pollywog Prodigy (its authored evolve removed), Champion of the Hareish, Kodama of the East Tree,
Oran-Rief Hydra, Emeria Shepherd.

**Gone.** `EvolveTriggerEffect` (now `EvolveEffect`) and its `counterType` / `alsoResolve`,
`ChampionOfTheHareishTriggerEffect` (now `BuddyListGrowOrWriteEffect`) and its `enteringSubtypes`,
`TriggeringPermanentEntryExclusionEffect`, `PutCardToBattlefieldEffect.suppressesTriggeringPermanentEntry` and
`withTriggeringPermanentEntrySuppressed()`, and `EnterTriggerCollectorService`'s `handleChampionOfTheHareishEnter`,
`handleAllyEvolve` and `suppressesTriggerForEnteringPermanent`.

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix (CR 608.2h): Oran-Rief Hydra's and Emeria Shepherd's land is read as the ability resolves, so a Forest

#### Run 17g: "it" / "that creature" of a combat damage trigger

**What the scan found.** `AllyCombatDamageTriggerEffect` was read by `CombatAbilityReader.allyCombatDamage` (and its
`AllyCombatDamage` record) for the "a creature you control deals combat damage to a player [or battle]" collectors of
`CombatDamageService` (the ally, owner-relative commander, same-name and graveyard collectors), the planar collector
(`TriggerCollectionService.checkPlanarAllyCreatureCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers`), `TriggeredAbilityQueueService
.targetFilterForTriggeredEffects` and `Card.bindEffectToTargetGroup`. 18 cards authored it: 16 `boundToDealer` (the
collector made the creature that dealt the damage the stack entry's source, with a source snapshot, so "put a counter
on it" was written as a counter on the source), Mindblade Render `opponentsDealtDamage` (an extra pass over the other
players' battlefields), Pirated Copy a `dealerPredicate` (the same-name filter the collector judged from the record).
Saskia, Soundwave, Vaan and Pep, which agent-docs still showed with it, were converted earlier.

**The model.**

- The ally collectors and the planar one put the watcher on the stack as the source and record the creature that dealt
  the damage as the entry's triggering permanent (`triggeringPermanentId`, its controller and its snapshot); "one or
  more" keeps its creatures as the entry's triggering permanents and names no single one. The collectors read the
  ability's filter, "one or more" and effect from `CombatAbilityReader.CombatEffect` directly; `AllyCombatDamage` and
  `allyCombatDamage` are gone.
- "Put a [+1/+1, quest] counter on it" / "that many": `PutCounterOnReferencedPermanentEffect(PermanentReference
  .TRIGGERING, type[, new EventValue()])`, existing. Four existing effects take the triggering permanent as a parameter:
  `TurnSourceFaceUpEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent()` and `DoublePlusOneCountersOnSourceEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent()`
  (a `PermanentReference reference` component, `SOURCE` or `TRIGGERING`; the no-argument constructors keep `SOURCE`),
  `FlickerEffect.flickerTriggeringPermanent()` (`FlickerScope.TRIGGERING`, immediate and at-step) and
  `CreateTokenCopyOfEnteringPermanentEffect.nonlegendary()` (a `removeLegendary` component; the handler already read
  the triggering permanent, and now copies its departure snapshot when it left and no enters collector recorded its

#### Run 17h: emblems' and granted abilities are abilities

**What the scan found.** `SpellCastTriggerEffect` was authored by nine cards: six emblems (`CreateEmblemEffect`'s
static-effect list), read by three branches of `TriggerCollectionService`'s emblem cast loop (Dack Fayden's "gain
control of those permanents", which captured the spell's permanent targets as a non-targeting multi-target entry; a
`GivePoisonCountersEffect(TARGET_PLAYER)` record, Ajani, Sleeper Agent's, queued with the record's target filter; and a
generic non-targeting one, Jaya, Kaito, Rowan, Tyvar); Gale, Conduit of the Arcane's five specialized abilities and
Passionate Archaeologist's granted ability (records under an unfiltered `Triggers.youCastSpell()`, read by the
registry's "you cast" handler); and Leshrac's Sigil (`Triggers.opponentCastsSpell()`). Olivia, Crimson Bride's
returned creature got `GrantEffectEffect(StateTriggerEffect, TARGET)`, read by `StateTriggerService` from the
permanent's granted effects. The record's "a player casts" and exile handlers had no card left; a granted record that
was all cascades was one copy (`TriggerCollectionService.dispatch`), and two copy-retention lookups
(`MayCopyHandlerService`, `BecomeCopyOfTargetCreatureUntilEndOfTurnEffectHandler`) looked inside records no card wrote.

**The model.**

- `TriggeredAbility` has a `targetFilter` component (new, `withTargetFilter`): the restriction on the ability's target
  when no card's target groups hold it, as an emblem's ability or a granted one has no card that binds its effects to a
  target group. Only the spell-cast collector reads it, so the ability rejects one on a trigger condition other than a
  cast trigger. `CastAbility.of(TriggeredAbility, …)` takes it as the cast ability's target filter, so every cast
  reader (the battlefield's printed and granted abilities, exile, the temporary global abilities, emblems) reads it.
- `CreateEmblemEffect` and `Emblem` have a `triggeredAbilities` component (new; `CreateEmblemEffect(TriggeredAbility,
  reminderText)` for "you get an emblem with '[triggered ability]'"). The emblem cast loop hands each emblem's cast
  abilities to the generic cast collector (`collectEmblemCastAbilities`): abilities of emblems function in the command
  zone (CR 114.4), the trigger's player relation is judged against the emblem's controller, the collector judges the
  spell filter, intervening "if" and target filter with the emblem's card as the source, and an ability with a limit
  throws. The collector describes an emblem's ability (its source a `CardType.EMBLEM` card) as "<card>'s emblem".
- Dack Fayden's "gain control of those permanents" is the existing `GainControlOfAllPermanentsMatchingEffect` with the
  new `PermanentIsTargetOfTriggeringSpellPredicate`, read through the new `FilterContext.triggeringSpellTargetIds`:
  the handler fills it with the triggering spell's target and declared targets, on the stack or, once it has left,
  as it was when the ability triggered (the entry's triggering spell snapshot, CR 608.2h). The trigger is
  `Triggers.youCastSpell().withStackEntryFilter(new StackEntryTargetsPermanentPredicate(new PermanentTruePredicate()))`.
- Gale's specialized abilities are filtered cast triggers (`GaleConduitOfTheArcane.addSpecializedSpellCastTrigger`,
  which `SpecializeGaleEffectHandler` calls); green's "target creature" is a target group on the specialized card.
- Passionate Archaeologist's granted ability is `Triggers.youCastSpell().withStackEntryFilter(new
  StackEntryCastFromZonePredicate(EXILE))` with its own "target opponent" filter.
- Olivia's returned creature gains `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect(new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.sourceState(…), new
  ExileSelfEffect()), TARGET)` (as Carnage, Crimson Chaos grants its ability). `StateTriggerService` reads the
  state-triggered abilities among a permanent's granted effects through `MiscAbilityReader.stateTrigger(ability)`
  (new, `stateTriggers(Card)` reads the printed ones through it). No ability writes a `StateTriggerEffect` any more.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17h-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module): Ajani, Sleeper Agent; Dack
Fayden; Jaya, Fiery Negotiator; Kaito, Cunning Infiltrator; Rowan, Scholar of Sparks; Tyvar Kell; Gale, Conduit of the
Arcane; Passionate Archaeologist; Olivia, Crimson Bride.

**Gone.** The emblem cast loop's three `SpellCastTriggerEffect` branches and `isNonTargetingEmblemSpellCastTrigger` /
`isUnconditionalNonTargetingEmblemTrigger`; the record's "a player casts", "you cast" and exile registry handlers;
`dispatch`'s granted-record cascade check; the record branches of the two copy-retention lookups; `Card`'s target-group
binding of `SpellCastTriggerEffect` and `StateTriggerEffect`; `GaleConduitOfTheArcane.specializedSpellCastTrigger`.

- An emblem's cast ability is judged as a battlefield one is: an Adventure's or an X spell's characteristics on the

  removed branches matched the printed card without them.
- Dack Fayden's emblem reads "those permanents" as the ability resolves from the spell (or its snapshot once it left),

- Olivia's granted ability is described as "<card>'s state-triggered ability" (the record's text was its own).
- No other change: the converted cards' card tests pass unchanged.

**Kept.**

#### Run 17i: the self-attack collector judges no conditional by type

Row 17i was split into 17i to 17l (the run table). A scan of the engine found about 150 places where a collector
judges a `ConditionalEffect` by its condition's class as the ability triggers: 68 in `CombatAttackService`, 43 in
`StepTriggerService`, 12 in `TriggerCollectionService`, the rest in the spell-cast, combat damage, combat trigger,
enters, exiled-card and draw code. A scan of the cards (`scripts/step15-run17i-scan.py`: every attack-trigger statement
with its options and its effect conditionals, against the Oracle text in the card-data cache) found 456 attack abilities with
a condition: 168 write a condition of the trigger event as an intervening "if". This run takes the self-attack
collector ("whenever this creature attacks"), which already judges each ability's event condition and intervening "if"
from the ability with the attacker, the number of attackers and the attack target. Converting the other attack
families' cards first failed 43 card cases there: their collectors don't judge those conditions from the ability yet,
and "you attack"'s "that many" came from the type-judged wrapper. They are row 17j.

**What the scan found.** CR 603.4 (checked): an intervening "if" is only an "if" that immediately follows the trigger
condition. 61 "whenever this creature attacks" abilities wrote a condition of the trigger event as one:
"whenever this and at least N other creatures attack" (`MinimumAttackers`, battalion), "attacks while saddled"
(`SourceIsSaddled`), "attacks a battle" / "an opponent" / "a player" / "the monarch" (`AttackedTargetMatches`,
`AttackedTargetIsOpponent`, `AttackedTargetIsMonarch`), Kari Zev's "attacks while you don't control a legendary
Monkey" (`ControlsPermanentCountAtMost`), Glimmer Lens's "equipped creature and at least one other creature attack",
and the conditions on which an ability exists (Catch of the Day's modes). The collector judged them from the ability
as it triggered, and then also by type: it removed effects whose wrapper failed again without the attack's context,
and unwrapped the attacker counts, attack targets, saddled and Void conditions so the stack entry wouldn't recheck them
without that context.

**The model.**

- A condition of the trigger event is the ability's event condition (`withEventCondition`): judged as the attackers are
  declared, with the attacker count and the attack target, and not checked again as the ability resolves. The 61
  abilities are converted by script (an ability is converted only when its Oracle line has no ", if" after the trigger
  condition, the card's own name masked).
- The self-attack collector's type-based `removeIf` / `replaceAll` branches are gone (`AttacksAlone`,
  `ControlsPermanentCountAtMost`, `Equipped`, `ControlsAnotherPermanent`, `ControllerCastSpellThisTurn`,
  `VoidCondition`, `SourceIsRenowned`, `SourceIsSaddled`, the defending-player conditions, `ControllerHandEmpty`,
  `GraveyardCardThreshold`, `MinimumAttackers`, `ExactlyAttackers`, the three attacked-target conditions) and
  `isDefendingPlayerCondition` with them. An intervening "if" stays wrapped around each effect for the check as the
  ability resolves (CR 603.4).
- `DeclaredAttackCondition` (new marker, `model/condition`): a condition about the attack as declared
  (`AttackingCreaturesTotalPowerAtLeast`, `ExactlyAttackers`). As a self-attack ability's intervening "if" ("if you
  attacked with … this combat": pack tactics, Creepy Puppeteer) it is judged from the declared attackers and its
  wrapper comes off, as the answer as the ability resolves is the same; the collector did this for pack tactics by its
  class.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17i-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module): 61 abilities of 59 card
classes (Alacrian Jaguar to Wojek Halberdiers; the script lists them by condition).

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix (CR 603.4): Kari Zev, Crew of Two's "attacks while you don't control a legendary Monkey" isn't checked
  again as the ability resolves, so a legendary Monkey that arrives in response doesn't stop the conjuring.
- The other converted abilities aren't checked again as they resolve either; for most (battalion's attackers as
  declared, saddled until end of turn, the attack target, a Class level or chosen mode) the answer was the same.
- Emeritus of Ideation's "you may exile eight cards from your graveyard. If you do, …" (an effect "if", not an
  intervening one) goes on the stack with fewer than eight cards and does nothing, where the collector removed it by its
  condition's class.

**Kept, for rows 17j to 17l.** The other combat families' type-based judging (the "attacks and isn't blocked",
"you attack", "a player attacks", "a creature you control attacks" and graveyard attack collectors, blocks, combat
damage) and their cards' trigger-event intervening "if"s (Master of Cruelties among them); Scriv's Contract's "if
it's attacking one of your opponents. Otherwise" pre-resolved by the self-attack collector
(`resolveAttackedTargetConditions`, an effect "if" that needs the attack target as the ability resolves); the step,
spell-cast, enters and other collectors.

**Found, not fixed.** Switchgrass Grazer gates its whole ability on "saddled" (`withInterveningIf(new
SourceIsSaddled())`); its Oracle text gates only the perpetual grant ("If Switchgrass Grazer is saddled and a creature
was dealt damage this way, …"), which its effect can't express yet. It is left out of the conversion and named in
`ORACLE_TEXT_EFFECT_MAP.md`.

**Scripts.**

- `scripts/step15-run17i-scan.py` (read-only): the attack abilities' conditions by Oracle wording, the lists the card
  script takes; at this run's end its "EVENT attacks" list is Switchgrass Grazer alone.
- `scripts/step15-run17i-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module): the card classes.
- `scripts/step15-run17i-tests.py` (idempotent, per letter module): Kari Zev's case.
- `scripts/step15-run17i-docs.py` (idempotent): exact edits in `EFFECTS_INDEX.md`, `EFFECTS_QUICK_REFERENCE.md`,
  `ORACLE_TEXT_EFFECT_MAP.md`, `CARD_PATTERNS_CREATURES_TRIGGERED.md`, `CARD_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAYBOOK.md` and the
  implement-card skill (the rule: a condition of the trigger event is an event condition); it fails if a self-attack
  ability is still shown with a `ConditionalEffect` of an attacker count, saddled or pack tactics. `EFFECT_MERGE_PLAN.md`
  names none of the changed forms.

The collector was edited by hand.

**Tests changed.**

- `KariZevCrewOfTwoTest#conditionIsCheckedAtResolution` (by script) became
  `conditionIsOnlyCheckedAsTheAbilityTriggers`: it asserted the intervening "if" recheck the Oracle text doesn't have.

**Test runs.**

- Card: the test class of every card with a "whenever this creature attacks" ability (1,473 classes, 11,506 cases): all

#### Run 17j: the "you attack" family judges no conditional by type

Row 17j (the other combat collectors) was split into 17j and 17k, and the later rows renumbered (17l the steps and
phases, 17m the rest). A scan widened from run 17i's to every combat trigger factory (`scripts/step15-run17j-scan.py`:
the option conditions and the effects' conditionals of each ability, against the Oracle text) showed two kinds of work
in the row: the "you attack" collectors, which already judged each ability's options or only needed to, and the rest,
where a condition's class decides the trigger's shape and not only whether it triggers ("a player attacks one of your
opponents" fans out once for each attacked opponent by `PlayerAttacksOneOfYourOpponents`' class, "whenever your
commander attacks" from a graveyard once for each attacking commander by `HasAttacker`'s predicate). The second kind
needs triggers the collectors don't have yet, so it is row 17k.

**The model.**

- A condition of a "whenever you attack" / "whenever you attack a player (or planeswalker)" trigger event is the
  ability's event condition (run 17i's rule, CR 603.4: "with three or more creatures", "with your commander", "with one
  or more creatures with power 4 or greater", "with exactly two creatures", a Class's level, a solved Case, an unlocked
  door, a Siege's mode).
- "Whenever one or more [filter] you control attack" / "whenever you attack with one or more [filter]" is the trigger's
  filter, `Triggers.youAttack().withFilter(filter)`, the form Vrestin and the Witch-king already had: the ability
  triggers only if a declared attacker matches, "they" are the matching attackers, and "that many" is their number,
  which the collector now sets as the stack entry's event value for a filtered ability (it came from the type-judged
  `MinimumMatchingAttackers` wrapper). "Two or more [filter]" (Gideon, the Oathsworn, Master's Guidance, Path of
  Mettle, Tide Skimmer) stays the event condition `MinimumMatchingAttackers(2, filter)`.
- `CombatEffect.effectAsJudged()` (`CombatAbilityReader`): the effect as a collector that judged the ability's options
  puts it on the stack, wrapped in the intervening "if" for the check as it resolves, but for one about the attack as
  declared, whose wrapper comes off. `DeclaredAttackCondition.isDeclaredAttackFact` is that test, through `AllOf` /
  `AllConditions`; `HasAttacker` is now a `DeclaredAttackCondition` (Fearless Swashbuckler's "if a Pirate and a
  Vehicle attacked this combat", which the collector unwrapped by class). The self-attack collector reads it too.
- The readers:
  - "whenever you attack" (`CombatAttackService`): its type-judged branches (`AttackingCreaturesTotalPowerAtLeast`,
    `MinimumAttackers`, `HasAttacker` and compound `HasAttacker` gates with `residualAfterAttackerGate`,
    `AllMatchingCreaturesAttack`, `MinimumAttackingCreaturesOfSubtype`, `AttackingCreaturesGreaterThanSourceCounters`,
    `ExactlyAttackers`, `MinimumMatchingAttackers`, `SourceHasChosenMode`) are gone; it already judged the options
    with the number of (matching) attackers.
  - "whenever you attack a player (or planeswalker)": it judged no option at all (an intervening "if" of a class it
    didn't list was checked only as the ability resolved); it now judges each ability's event condition and
    intervening "if" against the attacked player or planeswalker, with the number of creatures attacking it as the X,
    and its type-judged branches are gone.
  - The graveyard "whenever you attack" reader: `graveyardAttackConditionsMet` (which checked every nested
    conditional, an effect "if" too, as the ability triggered) and the `MinimumAttackers` / `HasAttacker` unwrapping are
    gone; the judge already judged the options. The commander fan-out stays (row 17k).
  - The command-zone reader (Sidar Jabari) and the planar reader (Valor's Reach): their `HasAttacker` and
    `ExactlyAttackers` branches are gone; a planar ability's effect "if" is no longer checked as it triggers.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17j-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 80 card classes: run 17i's
condition lists applied to the `youAttack`, `youAttackPlayer` and `youAttackPlayerOrPlaneswalker` statements (Ainok
Strike Leader to Zurzoth); the filter form for Celeborn, Choco, Chong and Lily, Lulu's specialized faces, Poetic
Ingenuity, Prodigy's Prototype, The Earth King, The Ur-Dragon and Varina; W'Kabi's compound intervening "if" split into
the event condition (`HasAttacker` of the commander) and the intervening "if" (`ControlsPermanent`). Endless Ranks of
HYDRA and Vivi's Persistence are left out (the commander fan-out).

**Behaviour changes.**

- The converted abilities' conditions aren't checked again as they resolve. For most the collector already unwrapped
  them; a Class's level, a solved Case, an unlocked door and Party Dude's level were rechecked, with the same answer.
- A filtered "one or more [filter]" ability is a stack object of its own, not one with the source's first "you attack"
  ability and its granted ones (CR 603.3), and its attacking snapshots and triggering permanents are the matching
  attackers.
- "Whenever you attack a player" abilities' intervening "if"s are judged as they trigger (CR 603.4); none was written
  with a class the collector didn't list, so no card changes.

#### Run 17k: the attack collectors judge no conditional by type

Row 17k (the other combat collectors) was split into 17k and 17l, and the later rows renumbered (17m the steps and
phases, 17n the rest). The attack collectors of `CombatAttackService` had the type-judged branches and the fan-outs the
row named; the attached permanents' attack triggers (`CombatTriggerService`), "attacks and isn't blocked", blocks and
combat damage read other collectors with their own branches, and are row 17l. Scriv's Contract's pre-resolved "if it's
attacking one of your opponents" (the self-attack collector's `resolveAttackedTargetConditions` and
`CombatTriggerService.resolveAttackedTargetOpponentSteps`) moved from the last row to 17l with them.

**The model.**

- "Whenever a player attacks one of your opponents" is a trigger of its own, `Triggers.playerAttacksOneOfYourOpponents()`
  (`CombatEvent.ONE_OR_MORE_ATTACK_YOUR_OPPONENT`, `ObjectRelation.ANY`), once for each of the source controller's
  opponents attacked (CR 603.2c); "whenever an opponent attacks another one of your opponents" is
  `Triggers.opponentAttacksAnotherOpponent()` (the same event, `OPPONENT_CONTROLS`). The collector
  (`checkPlayerAttacksYourOpponentTriggers`, watches `ON_ANY_PLAYER_ATTACKS_YOUR_OPPONENT` and
  `ON_OPPONENT_ATTACKS_ANOTHER_OPPONENT`) judges each ability's options against that opponent and puts each ability on
  the stack as an object of its own (CR 603.3), the opponent its attacked target and the attacking player its
  non-targeting `targetId`. The fan-out by the classes of `PlayerAttacksOneOfYourOpponents`,
  `OpponentAttacksAnotherOpponent`, Squall's and Breena's conditions is gone, and the first two conditions with it.
- `ConditionContext.attackedTargetId` (new component, `withAttackedTargetId`; `forStackEntry` reads the entry's
  attacked target): the player, planeswalker or battle an attack trigger's event was aimed at where it isn't the
  `targetId`. `AttackedTargetIsMonarch`, `AttackedOpponentHasMoreLifeThanAnotherOpponent` and Squall's condition read it
  (else the `targetId`, which the collectors set to the attack target as the ability triggers), so the intervening "if"
  reads the same player as the ability triggers and as it resolves; `EffectResolutionService.isConditionMet`'s two
  class-keyed swaps of the target for the entry's attacked target are gone. The context is not game state: nothing to
  copy for simulations.
- Squall, Gunblade Duelist's condition is `AttackersHavePowerOrToughnessEqualToSourceChosenNumber` (renamed from
  `PlayerAttacksOneOfYourOpponentsWithPowerOrToughnessEqualToSourceChosenNumber`): a creature attacking the attacked
  target has power or toughness equal to the chosen number.
- "Whenever a player attacks" (`ON_ANY_PLAYER_ATTACKS`): every ability's filter, event condition and intervening "if"
  are judged from the ability against the attacking player and the number of attackers, and the intervening "if" stays
  wrapped for the check as it resolves. The type-judged branches (`AllOf`, `MinimumMatchingAttackers`,
  `MinimumAttackers`, the enchanted-player, opponent-attack and planeswalker conditions, with the unwrapping of some)
  are gone; each ability is grouped by `CombatAbilityReader.byAbility` rather than `splitLaterAbilities`. "Whenever one
  or more [filter] attack" is the trigger's filter (run 17j's form): the ability triggers only if a declared attacker
  matches, and the entry's attacking snapshots are the matching attackers.
- "Whenever a creature you control attacks": the `AttacksAlone`, `AttacksPlayerAlone` and `SourceAttackedThisCombat`
  `removeIf` / unwrapping branches are gone (the options were already judged with the attacking creature).
  `CombatEffect.effectAsJudged()` also takes the intervening "if"'s wrapper off a `TriggeredModalEffect`, whose mode is
  chosen as the ability triggers (CR 603.3c): the chosen mode is what resolves, and the card writes the "if" into each
  mode for that check (Jin Sakai, the only such card). `CombatEffect.asJudged()` is the read in that form.
- "Whenever a creature attacks" (M'Baku's `AttackedTargetIsMonarch` judged by class) and "whenever a creature attacks
  you" (every `ConditionalEffect` judged, an effect "if" too) judge the ability's options with the attacker as the
  triggering permanent and the attack target as the target.
- "Whenever your commander attacks" from a graveyard is `Triggers.creatureAttacks().withFilter(new
  PermanentIsCommanderPredicate(true))` read from every graveyard (`GRAVEYARD_ON_ANY_CREATURE_ATTACKS`,
  `checkGraveyardCreatureAttacksTriggers`): once for each attacking creature that is a commander the card's owner owns,
  whoever controls it. The graveyard "you attack" reader reads only the attacking player's graveyard, and its
  `isOwnedCommanderAttackTrigger` fan-out by `HasAttacker`'s predicate is gone.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17k-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 27 card classes: Combat
Calligrapher, Ellie, Brick Master, Breena and Squall on `playerAttacksOneOfYourOpponents()`, Karazikar on
`opponentAttacksAnotherOpponent()`, Killian, Decisive Mentor's filter, Tahngarth, First Mate's compound intervening
"if" split into the event condition (`AttackingPlayerIsOpponent`) and the intervening "if" (`SourceIsTapped`), the 19
"whenever a player attacks" abilities of 18 card classes whose trigger-event condition was an intervening "if"
(Archnemesis to Trouble in Pairs, the scan's EVENT list), Endless Ranks of HYDRA and Vivi's Persistence on the graveyard `creatureAttacks()`
filter. Everwatching Threshold, Mangara, Tomik, Mirkwood Trapper, Norn's Decree, Breena and Squall keep their genuine
intervening "if"s.

- The converted event conditions aren't checked again as the abilities resolve. Most were unwrapped by the collector

#### Run 17l: the other combat collectors judge no conditional by type

Row 17l: the combat collectors outside `CombatAttackService`'s attack triggers. A read of each showed what was left:
the attached permanents' attack collector (`CombatTriggerService`) and the block collectors already judged every
ability's options; the type-judged branches and the collectors that judged no option were in the "attacks and isn't
blocked", combat damage and Equipment readers.

**The model.**

- "Whenever this creature attacks and isn't blocked" (`CombatBlockService.collectUnblockedAttackTriggers`): the
  printed and granted abilities' event condition and intervening "if" are judged as they trigger, against the attack
  target with the attacker as the triggering permanent; the collector judged none, so an intervening "if" was checked
  only as the ability resolved.
- The attached permanents' "deals combat damage to a player / an opponent" (`checkAttachedCombatDamageToPlayerTriggers`):
  every ability's options are judged against the player dealt damage, from the attached permanent and its
  controller, with the damage as the event value; the collector judged none, and dropped `AttackedTargetIsOpponent`
  wrappers by class when the player dealt damage was the attached permanent's controller.
- "Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage (to a player / or battle)" (`queueSourceDealsCombatDamageTriggers`):
  the Equipment's abilities' options are judged as they trigger; `DamageTriggerCollectorService`'s handler keyed on
  `ConditionalEffect`, which judged any conditional of the ability (an effect "if" too) and put it on the stack still
  wrapped, is gone.
- The self "deals combat damage to a player" collector: the `Metalcraft` branch, which put a metalcraft ability on the
  stack as an entry of its own after it was judged, is gone; the ability takes the common path.
- "Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player": the `SourceCounterThreshold`,
  `SourceClassLevelAtLeast` and `SourceHasChosenMode` branch, which judged the intervening "if" again by class and
  unwrapped it, is gone.
- `CombatTriggerService`'s `AttackedTargetIsMonarch` unwrap is gone: no attached ability writes it as an intervening
  "if" (The Spear of Bashenga's is the event condition), and run 17k's `ConditionContext.attackedTargetId` reads the
  entry's attacked target for one as it resolves.

#### Run 17m: the step and phase collectors judge no conditional by type

Row 17m: `StepTriggerService` and `DrawService`. Every step reader already read the abilities through
`StepAbilityReader`, which judges each ability's event condition and intervening "if" as it triggers and wraps the
intervening "if" around each effect for the check as it resolves (run 16e). What was left were `ConditionalEffect`
branches keyed on the condition's class that judged that wrapper again, in the same context, and put the ability on
the stack by their own path.

**The model.**

- The class-keyed branches are gone (39, by a brace-matching edit script kept with the run's scratch files, the
  collectors checked by hand afterwards): the upkeep chain's 15 (`NoOtherPermanent`, the life, hand, library,
  permanent-count, counter and graveyard thresholds), the opponent upkeep's hand-size check, the each-end-step chain's
  11 (`NotKicked`, `Morbid`, `GainedLifeThisTurn`, the damage-this-turn conditions and others), the "your end step"
  chain's 7 (`Raid`, the permanent counts, `DidntAttack`, `AllOf`, the died / left-graveyard-this-turn conditions and
  others), the opponent end step's and the graveyard end step's generic re-judging, the enchanted controller's end step's
  `EnchantedCreatureDidntAttack` skip, and the beginning-of-combat and draw collectors' `MaxSpeed` checks. Each
  ability takes the collector's common path, which routes a `ConditionalEffect` by its wrapped effect's target spec
  and keeps the wrapper. The each-end-step and "your end step" chains gain one branch each for a `ConditionalEffect`
  whose wrapped effect targets a permanent, player or exiled card, keyed on the target spec, not the condition: the
  common targeted path needs a declared target or names no exiled card, and the class-keyed branches had routed
  Lathiel's target-group distribution, Nyla's exiled card and Thendar's "up to one" target.
- The each-end-step branch for an intervening "if" around a "you may" (Sygg, River Cutthroat) stays, keyed on the
  wrapped `MayEffect`, not on the condition: it puts the wrapper on the stack so the condition is checked before the
  "you may" is asked. Its re-judging is gone.
- "Max speed — [ability]" is the ability's event condition (`withEventCondition(new MaxSpeed())`, Endrider
  Spikespitter's form): the ability exists only at max speed. The draw collector unwrapped it by class after judging it.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17m-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 7 card classes (8 abilities):
Aether Syphon, Embalmed Ascendant, Hangarback Assembler, Mendicant Core, Guidelight, Rising Chicane, Smog Smasher (both
abilities), Zahur, Glory's Past.

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix (CR 603.4): Aggression's and Insubordination's "destroy that creature if it didn't attack this turn" is an
  effect "if": the ability goes on the stack whether or not the creature attacked and checks it as it resolves, where
  the collector kept it off the stack by the condition's class.
- The abilities whose branch pushed the unwrapped effect (`Raid`, `Morbid`, `GainedLifeThisTurn`, the died and
  left-graveyard-this-turn conditions) check their intervening "if" again as they resolve (CR 603.4); none of those
  conditions can turn false later in the turn, so the answer is the one judged as the ability triggered. A raid "you
  may" goes on the stack as the wrapped ability, not as a pending may ability, and asks as it resolves.
- The entries the branches built now carry the common path's source permanent snapshot (and attached permanent
  snapshot).

**Kept, for row 17n.** The graveyard upkeep reader's rebuild of `SourceCardInGraveyard` with the card's graveyard entry
version, and the step abilities' trigger-event intervening "if"s (`scripts/step15-run17m-scan.py`'s EVENT lists; a
recheck as they resolve gives the same answer for all but vanishing's, which is a real intervening "if", CR 702.63a).
Boons' `ConditionalEffect` check stays: a boon isn't a triggered ability read through the step reader.

#### Run 17n: the enter and dispatch collectors judge no conditional by type

Row 17n (the rest) was split into 17n and 17o: `TriggerCollectionService` alone had eleven class-keyed sites of
different kinds. This run takes the ones the trigger pipeline already judges the options of: the "another / an
opponent's permanent enters" collectors and `dispatchSlotEffect`. The trigger pipeline
(`TriggeredAbilityStackService.triggerOnce`) judges each zone-change ability's event condition and intervening "if" as
it triggers, with the source and controller and the moved permanent as the triggering permanent, and wraps the
intervening "if" around each effect.

**The model.**

- "Whenever another artifact you control enters": the `ControlsPermanentCount` re-judge (Voldaren Bloodcaster) is gone.
- "Whenever a land an opponent controls enters" (`triggerOpponentLandEnters`): its three class-keyed checks and the
  `unwrapImprintedCardNameConditional` / `unwrapPermanentEnteredThisTurnConditional` helpers are gone. The conditions
  read "that player" and the entering land from the context the pipeline judges in:
  - `TargetPlayerControlsMoreLandsThanController` and `PermanentEnteredThisTurn` with the new
    `CountScope.TARGET_PLAYER` read "that player" as the context's target when it is a player, else the controller of
    its triggering permanent (`ConditionEvaluationService.thatPlayer`);
  - `ImprintedCardNameMatchesEnteringPermanent` reads the entering card as the context's triggering card, else its
    triggering permanent's card.
- `dispatchSlotEffect`'s `SourceHasChosenMode` judge-and-unwrap is gone: a chosen mode's ability is written with the
  mode as its event condition. The two "whenever this permanent becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent
  controls" collectors (the ward one and the non-counter one) judged no option of their printed abilities, so Catch of
  the Day's ward mode had relied on that branch; they now judge each ability's event condition and intervening "if"
  from the source as it triggers (Guardian Sunmare's "while saddled" event condition among them).

#### Run 17o: the own enters abilities' cast-time facts are a marker, not 25 classes

Row 17o (split from the last row): `EtbEffectResolver`, which puts a "when this enters" ability's effects into the form
they take as it triggers. Its `ConditionalEffect` handler judged each condition by its class through a `Verdict`
switch (drop, nothing, unwrap, keep, unjudged; about 25 cases), and `ownEntryConditionMet` judged the ability's
intervening "if" and event condition by wrapping them into a placeholder `ConditionalEffect` for the same switch.

**The model.**

- `EntryFactCondition` (new marker, `model/condition`, the pattern of `DeclaredAttackCondition`): a condition fixed as
  the permanent entered: `Kicked`, `NotKicked`, `CastFromZone`, `EnteredFromZone`, `WasCast`, the alternative-cost
  conditions (`CastForAlternateCost`, `…ProwlCost`, `…MadnessCost`, `…SpectacleCost`), `RepeatedAdditionalCostPaid`,
  `CollectEvidenceCostPaid`, `SourceEntryCostPaid`, `GiftPromised`, the mana-spent conditions (`ColorSpentToCast`,
  `SnowManaSpentToCast`, `TreasureManaSpentToCast`), `RevealCardFromHandCostPaid`, `ControlledDragonAsCast`,
  `SourceIsToken`, and `ControllerMainPhase` (as an own enters ability reads it: the main phase the permanent entered
  during, Addendum). `isEntryFact` also takes a `NotCondition`, `AllOf`, `AllConditions` or `AnyOf` of them.
- The resolver: an entry fact is judged as the ability triggers, with the entering permanent's cast-time facts (the
  stack entry can't read how the permanent was cast); true, its wrapper comes off; false, an effect that does nothing
  takes its place, so the ability still goes on the stack (CR 603.4: an effect's "if" doesn't keep its ability from
  triggering). Any other condition stays wrapped and is checked as the effect resolves. Blitz's two reminder
  abilities still drop (`isBlitzReminder`, CR 702.152a).
- `ownEntryConditionMet` judges an option with `ConditionEvaluationService` in the cast-time context, but for a
  condition on the ability's target, which isn't chosen yet (CR 603.3d), unless the source is an Aura entering
  attached.
- `GiftPromised`, `RevealCardFromHandCostPaid` and `ControlledDragonAsCast` read the source permanent's record when the
  context's flag isn't set, as `CastForAlternateCost` already did.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17o-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 6 card classes: Dwarven Mine,
Gingerbread Cabin, Idyllic Grange, Mystic Sanctuary and Witch's Cottage ("when this land enters untapped": the event
condition, where the resolver unwrapped the intervening "if" by class, "sampled at entry"), and Mythos of Illuna's
granted "when this permanent enters, if it's a creature, it fights …" (an intervening "if" written as an effect's
conditional, which the resolver judged by class; its fight effect and the target group it is bound to share one
instance).

**Behaviour changes.**

- An own enters ability whose only effect has a false cast-time "if" (written as an effect's, not the ability's) goes
  on the stack and does nothing, where the resolver dropped it (CR 603.4); none of the card tests asserts the old form.
- The non-fact conditions the resolver judged by class (`CardsInHandAtMost`, `SourceIsCreature`,
  `SourceMatchesPermanentPredicate`, an Aura's `TargetPermanentMatches`, `SourceUntapped`) are, as intervening "if"s,
  judged as the ability triggers and checked again as it resolves (CR 603.4), and as effects' "if"s checked as they
  resolve; "enters untapped" is an event condition, not checked again.

**Kept, for row 17p.** The resolver's other trigger-time rewrites (the chosen ETB mode, evoke, tribute, dash, "unless
cast from your hand", `GainLifeEqualToToughnessEffect`) are the effects' own mechanics, not conditionals; the spell-cast
collector's mana-spent X sniffers and the death collector's power choice only decide which event value the entry
carries.

**Scripts.**

- `scripts/step15-run17o-docs.py` (idempotent): `EFFECTS_QUICK_REFERENCE.md`'s `EntryFactCondition` entry, with "when
  this enters, if it was kicked" as `withInterveningIf(new Kicked())` and "enters untapped" as the event condition.
  `EFFECT_MERGE_PLAN.md` names none of the changed forms.

The resolver and conditions were edited by hand.

#### Run 17r: the life and time-counter collectors judge no conditional by type

Row 17r (what run 17q's "done" check found) was split into 17r to 17u by family: its first group alone had about 25
collector sites of different kinds. This run takes the collectors that judged a life or time-counter ability's
intervening "if" a second time, from the `ConditionalEffect` the reader wraps around each effect, and pushed the effect
unwrapped, so the "if" was never checked again as the ability resolved; and the class-keyed `ConditionalEffect`
handlers that only forwarded to their watch's default handler.

**The model.**

- The life collectors (`TriggerCollectionService`: "you gain life", "you lose life", "an opponent loses life", "you pay
  life") judge each ability's event condition and intervening "if" from the ability as it triggers
  (`watchJudge(...).triggers(ability)`, as "an opponent gains life" already did through `dispatchWatch`), and dispatch
  the effects as the reader gives them: an intervening "if" stays wrapped and is checked again as the ability resolves
  (CR 603.4). `unwrapLifeChangeConditional` is gone.
- `MiscTriggerCollectorService`: the four life `ConditionalEffect` handlers that re-judged and unwrapped are gone. "An
  opponent loses life" has a default handler (the effect as given, the life lost as the event value; Kefka's
  `DrawCardEffect(new EventValue())` reached a handler only through the unwrap), "an opponent gains life" uses its
  default, and "you gain life" / "you lose life" keep one `ConditionalEffect` handler that puts the conditional on the
  stack as it is with the life gained or lost as the event value (no other handler takes a wrapped effect there).
- `PermanentCounterRemovalTriggerCollectorService`'s time-counter handler no longer judges and unwraps a conditional;
  `dispatchCounterAbility` judged the ability's options already.
- The forwarding `ConditionalEffect` handlers whose watch has a default are gone: `DamageTriggerCollectorService`'s
  "an opponent is dealt damage", "a source an opponent controls deals damage to you" and "this is dealt damage", and
  `MiscTriggerCollectorService`'s proliferate and crime handlers (the registry falls back to the default, which
  received the same effect).

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17r-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 13 card classes, whose
intervening "if" was a condition of the trigger event or one the ability exists under, now the event condition (judged
as the ability triggers, not again as it resolves, as the collectors treated it):

- "during your turn" / "for the first time during each of your turns": Cat Collector, Kefka, Ruler of Ruin, Moonstone
  Harbinger, Shadowheart, Sharran Cleric's specialized abilities, Vampire Scrivener (both), Wax-Wane Witness;
- a Class's level (CR 716.2a): Cleric Class, Gourmand's Talent (both), Intermediate Chirography;
- vanishing's "When the last time counter is removed from this permanent, sacrifice it" (CR 702.63a: the last
  counter's removal is the trigger event): Aven Riftwatcher, Calciderm, Chronozoa, Regenerations Restored. The upkeep
  ability's "if this permanent has a time counter on it" is a real intervening "if" and stays.

**Behaviour changes.**

  condition, which is judged as before and, as before, not checked again. An intervening "if" a later card writes on a
  life or time-counter ability is checked again as it resolves (CR 603.4), where the collectors dropped it.
- "You pay life" and "an opponent loses life" now judge an ability's event condition (neither had one).

**Split.** The rest of row 17r, as rows:

#### Run 17s: the damage, ward, land-tap, suspended-card and opponent-graveyard collectors judge no conditional by type

Row 17s, in one run: the five collector sites run 17r left that judged an authored conditional or wrapper by its class
as the ability triggered.

**The model.**

- `TriggerCollectionService.queueNoncombatDamageToPlayerEffect` no longer judges and unwraps a `ConditionalEffect`.
  `checkSourceDealsDamageToPlayerTriggers` judges each ability's event condition and intervening "if" as it triggers,
  the attached Aura's or Equipment's too (judged before only by the unwrap, without the damage), with the damage dealt
  as the event value and the player dealt damage as the context's target (`withTargetId`, as the combat collector
  already judged). An intervening "if" stays around the effect and is checked again as the ability resolves (CR 603.4),
  the entry carrying the damage as its event value; the effect under it decides how the ability goes on the stack, and a
  "you may" under one goes on the stack, its question asked as it resolves (CR 603.5).
- `DamagedPlayerOnlyEffect` is gone. Hellish Rebuke's "when this permanent deals damage to the player who cast Hellish
  Rebuke" is the granted ability's event condition, the new `TargetPlayerIs(UUID)` ("that player is [one player]", the
  context's target, which both damage collectors set to the player dealt damage). The spell's grant handler
  (`GrantStaticEffectToOpponentPermanentsUntilEndOfTurnEffectHandler`) fills its `null` player with the caster as the
  spell resolves; no collector rewrites it. `CombatDamageService`'s unwrap went with it.
- The becomes-the-target counter-unless collector (`collectBecomesTargetOfOpponentCounterTriggers`) judges the printed,
  the duration-granted and the statically granted abilities with one judge as they trigger, and puts the counter-unless
  effect on the stack with its intervening "if" around it (checked again as it resolves; the "unless" is dealt with
  then, CR 603.5). No card has such an "if" today; Catch of the Day's chosen mode is an event condition.
- Land taps: `LandTapTriggerCollectorService.handleConditionalManaAbilitySequence` is gone. A triggered mana ability
  (CR 605.1b: it triggers from a permanent tapped for mana, has no target and could add mana) doesn't go on the stack
  and resolves as soon as it triggers (CR 605.4a; Barbflare Gremlin's ruling says its ability is one), so the check of
  its intervening "if" as it triggered is its check as it resolves: `TapAbilityReader.TapEffect.effectAsJudged()` takes
  the judged wrapper off such an ability (`TapAbilityReader.isTriggeredManaAbility`), and the land-tap collector and its
  planar reader read `printedEffectsAsJudged`. A land-tap ability that uses the stack keeps its wrapper. "Could add
  mana" is the new marker `TriggeredManaAbilityEffect`, on the 11 land-tap mana effects.
- Suspended cards: `SpellCastTriggerCollectorService.handleSuspendedCardMayPutTimeCounterTrigger`, keyed by
  `SourceCardSuspended` and one ability shape, is gone. The suspended reader (`collectSuspendedCastAbility`) judges the
  ability, leaves its intervening "if" wrapped, hands an effect with a handler of its own to it (Deep-Sea Kraken's) and
  puts any other on the stack as it is, the caster as "that player" (the non-targeting target Pardic Dragon's
  `TRIGGERING_SPELL_CONTROLLER` "you may" reads) and the spell as its triggering card. The handler set an event value of
  1 only so `PutTimeCountersOnSuspendedCardEffectHandler`'s gate would pass; that gate (Curse of the Cabal's "if the
  player does") is now the card's `ConditionalEffect(new EventValueAtLeast(1), …)` on the recorded sacrifice count, as
  Leviathan and Gisa's Favorite Shovel write it.
- "Whenever a card is put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere": `MiscTriggerCollectorService`'s

#### Run 17t: the trigger conditions written as wrapper effects

Row 17t, in one run. The row counted 9 cards; 13 card classes constructed the four classes (Hedron Blade's
`CombatOpponentConditionalEffect` is the record behind `CombatOpponentFilterEffect`, and `CopyThisSpellIfConditionEffect`
had 10 cards, not 7). Six domain types are gone: `CombatOpponentFilterEffect`, `CombatOpponentConditionalEffect`,
`DestroySubtypeCombatOpponentEffect`, `EnteringCreatureExactStatsConditionalEffect` with its only implemented interface
`EnterCreatureConditionalEffect`, and `CopyThisSpellIfConditionEffect`.

**The model.**

- The attached combat collector (`CombatTriggerService`) reads a filter on a "blocks" or "becomes blocked" ability of an
  Aura or Equipment: the creature on the other side of the block (CR 509.3f), judged as the ability triggers.
  `checkAuraTriggersForCreature` judges it against the creature blocked, or, for "becomes blocked" without
  `EACH_BLOCKER`, against every blocker (once if one or more match, CR 509.3c); `checkAttachedPerBlockerTriggers`
  judges an `EACH_BLOCKER` ability's filter against each blocker (CR 509.3d). `attachedCombatEffects` still throws on a
  filter of any other watch, and on a limit. The two class-keyed branches (the `DestroySubtypeCombatOpponentEffect`
  rebuild as an auto-targeted `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect`, the `CombatOpponentFilterEffect` unwrap) are gone.
- The ally-creature enters collector no longer unwraps (`unwrapEnterCreatureConditional` gone; `dispatchEntering`'s
  raw-effect overload went with it), nor does the put-counters handler re-wrap Sigil Captain's stats.
- "When you cast this spell, copy it" is the existing `CopyTriggeringSpellEffect` in the `Triggers.youCastThisSpell()`
  ability. The self-cast collector puts an ability whose effect copies this spell (`CopyTriggeringSpellEffect`, behind a
  `MayEffect`, a `ConditionalEffect` or in a `SequenceEffect` of such steps: `copiesThisSpell`) on the stack as one object
  of its own, the spell its triggering card and triggering spell (`setTriggeringSpell`), non-targeting; the copy is made
  from the live spell as the ability resolves, or as it last existed on the stack (CR 608.2h). Its event condition and
  intervening "if" are judged as it triggers by `triggeredEffects`, the intervening "if" left wrapped (CR 603.4), and a
  "you may" is asked as it resolves (CR 603.5). No spell snapshot is bound into an effect. A perpetually granted
  untargeted self-cast effect's entry (Inspiring Easel's grant) carries the triggering spell too, so its copy survives the
  spell being countered as the bound snapshot did.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17t-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 13 card classes:

- Wooden Stake: `Triggers.blocks().withFilter(vampire)` and `Triggers.becomesBlocked().withFilter(vampire)` with
  `EACH_BLOCKER`, each the existing `DestroyCombatOpponentEffect(true)` (as Mirror Shield writes it).
- Hedron Blade: "becomes blocked by one or more colorless creatures" is `Triggers.becomesBlocked().withFilter(colorless)`.
- Sigil Captain: "if that creature is 1/1" is the intervening "if" (its rulings say so) `TriggeringPermanentMatches` of
  power and toughness at least / at most 1, with `PutCounterOnReferencedPermanentEffect(TRIGGERING, +1/+1, 2)`.
- The copy cards, each condition checked against CR 603.4's wording: "copy it if …" an effect "if" (`ConditionalEffect`:
  Mentor's Guidance, Lumaret's Favor; its ruling says it is checked as the ability resolves); "when you cast this spell
  while …" the event condition (Social Snub, Ancestral Communion); "when you cast this spell, if …" the intervening "if"
  (Malicious Affliction's morbid, Sage of the Skies, Bygone Marvels, whose condition was written both as the ability's
  intervening "if" and inside the wrapper); plain "copy it" (Brass Knuckles, Inspiring Easel's grant). Banish into
  Fable's "from your hand" is the event condition, and its "copy it if you control an artifact, then copy it if you
  control an enchantment" one ability of two effect "if"s (`SequenceEffect`). "You may copy" stays a `MayEffect`; "(The
  copy becomes a token.)" is `new CopyTriggeringSpellEffect(true)`; Bygone Marvels' "copy this spell twice"
  `withCopies(2)` (one copy event).

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix: Banish into Fable's two copies come from one triggered ability (CR 603.3), both on the stack before either
  resolves; the card had two abilities, the first copy resolving before the second ability did
  (`BanishIntoFableTest#copiesOnceForArtifactAndTwiceForArtifactAndEnchantment` now asserts one copy trigger, then two
  copies on the stack).
- Malicious Affliction's, Sage of the Skies' and Bygone Marvels' intervening "if" is checked again as the ability
  resolves (CR 603.4); none of their conditions can stop holding within the turn. Social Snub's and Ancestral
  Communion's event conditions are judged once, as before.
- A copy is made from the spell as it is when the ability resolves (CR 608.2h: the object's current information in
  its zone), not from a snapshot taken as it was cast; once the spell has left the stack it is copied as it last
  existed there, as before.
- Wooden Stake's "a Vampire" is judged through `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate` (the layered subtypes) instead of
  `GameQueryService.permanentHasSubtype`.

**Left, and noted.** The self-cast collector still routes its other copy keywords by class (`CopyThisSpellIfCasualtyPaidEffect`,
`CopyThisSpellForXValueEffect`, `ReplicateEffect`, the `SpellCastCopyTriggerEffect` family, storm), each binding a
snapshot of the spell into `CopyControllerCastSpellEffect` / `StormCopyEffect`; they are keyword triggers, not
conditions written as wrappers, so they stay outside this row. Unbreakable Remnant's "when you cast this spell from your
graveyard" is written as an intervening "if" where it is a trigger-event condition (no behaviour difference). For step
16: no new `Card`, `StackEntry` or `GameData` state; nothing new is slot-keyed.

The collectors, `CombatTrigger`'s and `PutCountersOnEnteringCreatureEffect`'s Javadoc were edited by hand.

#### Run 17u: the event bindings and the cast trigger's "you may" go on the stack as the cards wrote them

Row 17u, in one run: the seven rebuilds run 17r and 17s listed. Step 15's "done" condition was then checked; it doesn't
hold, so rows 17v to 17x list what is left (below).

**The model.**

- "Its controller loses N life": the attached combat collector (`CombatTriggerService`) no longer bakes the creature's
  controller into `EnchantedCreatureControllerLosesLifeEffect`, and no longer names the creature as the entry's
  non-targeting target for it (`losesLifeAsEnchantedCreatureController` gone). The cards use the existing
  `LoseLifeEffect(N, TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)`, the controller of the entry's triggering permanent as the ability
  resolves (else as it last existed); every plain attached attack, block and becomes-blocked entry records the creature
  and its controller and is non-targeting (no effect of it targets). The same bake went from the enchanted-controller
  upkeep reader (`StepTriggerService`: "that player loses N life" is `LoseLifeEffect(N, TRIGGERING_PLAYER)`, the
  upkeep's player the entry's non-targeting target) and from `DamageTriggerCollectorService` (Ragged Veins' class-keyed
  handler gone: `LoseLifeEffect(new EventValue(), TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)` through the "enchanted creature is
  dealt damage" default, which records the damage, the creature and its controller). `EnchantedCreatureControllerLosesLifeEffect`
  is left only for "when enchanted creature dies" (row 17v).
- `MustBlockSourceEffect`: no collector rebinds its source. The effect names what the target must block when its
  `sourcePermanentId` isn't set (an activated ability still snapshots it as it is activated, outside the trigger
  pipeline): the entry's source (`PermanentReference.SOURCE`, the default: an attacker's own or temporarily granted
  attack ability, Tower Above's grant, whose entry's source is the attacker) or the entry's triggering permanent
  (`MustBlockSourceEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent()`: Grappling Hook's "you may have target creature block it", "it" the
  equipped creature). `CombatTriggerService`'s and `CombatAttackService`'s rebinds are gone.
- "Choose one at random" (`RandomChoiceEffect`): a modal triggered ability's mode is chosen as it goes on the stack
  (CR 603.3c, 700.2b), random or not; no ruling of Cult of Skaro or Typhoid Mary, Fractured says otherwise, and Typhoid
  Mary's test ("discarding in response cannot replace the already randomly chosen mode") already relied on it. The
  self-attack collector's pick, which replaced the effect before the entry existed, is gone; `StackedModalTriggerService`
  announces the mode of any triggered entry whose one effect is a `RandomChoiceEffect` (maybe under an intervening "if",
  which stays around the chosen mode's effects) before anyone gets priority, as it announces a "choose one", so a copy
  of the ability (Adric) keeps the mode. The effect's handler still chooses at resolution where nothing announced it.
- "You may" and "you may pay" of a cast trigger: `CastAbility.of` no longer takes off a lone plain `MayEffect` or
  `MayPayManaEffect` (its `manaCost` / `optionalPrompt` components and the `onStackPath` parameter are gone), and the
  generic cast collector no longer re-wraps it (its four re-wrapping blocks are gone): the ability goes on the stack as
  the card wrote it, its question asked as it resolves (CR 603.5). What a lone plain "you may [pay]" offers is what the
  collector judges for the ability's targets, X and modes (`CastAbility.effectsTargetsAreChosenFor()`, CR 603.3d), a
  read-through like `TriggerTargetCollector`'s. The graveyard cast reader's `MayPayManaEffect` rebuild is gone (Lingering
  Phantom, Masked Admirers): one entry with the card's own effects.
- Leshrac's Sigil is a filtered cast trigger (`Triggers.opponentCastsSpell().withFilter(green)`) with its own
  `MayPayManaEffect`; "look at that player's hand" is `ChooseCardsFromTargetHandEffect.ofTriggeringPlayer()` (new
  component `triggeringPlayersHand`: it declares no target, so the collector gives the caster as the entry's
  non-targeting "that player", which the handler already read). The record's "an opponent casts" handler,
  `SpellCastTriggerCollectorService.authored` and `CastAbility.of(SpellCastTriggerEffect, MayEffect)` are gone. No card
  constructs `SpellCastTriggerEffect` now; the record stays for `TextChangeTransformer`'s case and the service tests
  that build cast abilities from it (`SpellCastTriggerCollectorServiceTest.authored`), row 17w.
- Deep-Sea Kraken: "whenever an opponent casts a spell, if this card is suspended, remove a time counter from it" is
  the ability with its intervening "if" (`SourceCardSuspended`) and the existing `RemoveTimeCounterFromExiledCardEffect`,
  as Pardic Dragon writes its ability; the suspended reader puts it on the stack as it is.
  `RemoveTimeCounterWhenOpponentCastsSpellEffect` and its handler are gone.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17u-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 14 card classes: Contaminated
Bond, Nettling Curse, Sinister Possession, Parasitic Impetus, Scriv, the Obligator (the Contract token), Ragged Veins
(`LoseLifeEffect` with `TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER`), Numbing Dose, One Thousand Lashes, Stab Wound, Soul Bleed
(`TRIGGERING_PLAYER`), Grappling Hook, Deep-Sea Kraken, Leshrac's Sigil.

**Behaviour changes.**

- No card's "you may" moved from trigger time to resolution: every one the unwrap took off was re-wrapped and asked as
  the ability resolved. The cards that author a cast trigger's lone "you may [pay]" now put the card's own effect on
  the stack, equal to the one the collector rebuilt.
- An intervening "if" around a cast trigger's lone "you may" is now outside it, so it is checked before the question as
  the ability resolves (CR 603.4); the rebuild asked first (Dovin's Acuity's "during your main phase", which can't stop
  holding in between).
- The graveyard cast reader's "you may pay" entry now records the cast spell as its triggering card and its mana spent
  as X, as its other entries do, and asks with the card's own prompt (Lingering Phantom's and Masked Admirers' were the
  same text).
- The random mode is still chosen as the ability goes on the stack, now on the entry by the stack's mode announcement,
  for any collector; it is logged.

For step 16: no new `Card`, `StackEntry` or `GameData` state. `MustBlockSourceEffect` gained a component (its old
constructors are kept), `ChooseCardsFromTargetHandEffect` one (its old canonical constructor is kept), `CastAbility`
lost three; nothing new is slot-keyed.

**Step 15's "done" condition, checked.** Greps over the engine and domain main sources:

- `AwareEffect`: none. `OncePerTurnTriggerEffect`: none.
- `value = ConditionalEffect.class`: six registrations on four handlers (`DamageTriggerCollectorService`'s two "a source
  you control deals noncombat damage", `MiscTriggerCollectorService`'s "you gain / lose life",

#### Run 17v: the enchanted creature that dies or leaves, and the dying creature's power, read from the stack entry

Row 17v, split into 17v and 17v2. The row's about 25 sites span two families of different weight: the amounts and
controllers baked from the creature as it last existed (this run), and the returns rebuilt with the dying card's id,
whose entries already use the triggering card for the Aura's own graveyard stay and whose Necrotic Plague target chooser
reads the baked controller in `TriggeredAbilityQueueService` (row 17v2, with three death bakes that each need a new
piece: Mask of Griselbrand's `MayPayLifeEffect` takes an `int`, Faces of the Past needs a "shares a creature type with
the triggering permanent" predicate, Hateful Eidolon's departed attachments carry no Aura controller).

**The model.**

- "When enchanted creature dies": `TriggerContext.EnchantedPermanentDeath` carries the dying permanent as it last
  existed on the battlefield (new `dyingPermanent` component; CR 603.10a, checked). Every entry the enchanted-death

  target choice carries the snapshot (`DeathTriggerTarget.withTriggeringPermanent`). Effects read the creature as the

  `TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER` recipients, `GameQueryService.findTriggeringPermanentController`.

  record the dying creature as the triggering permanent with its power at trigger (`recordDyingCreature`), as the

#### Run 17v2: the Aura and creature returns and the death collector's last bakes read the stack entry

collector's three bakes that each needed a new piece. Not split.

**The model.**

  stack also records the cards the permanent put into the graveyard (every card of a merged permanent) as its

  `SequenceEffect`). A target choice carries the dying creature's last-known controller

  target spec, `PermanentNotPredicate(PermanentControlledByTriggeringPermanentControllerPredicate)`, and the new

  `FilterContext.triggeringPermanentControllerId` once the permanent has left (CR 603.10a), which

  the chooser from the effect by class, and the handler reads "its controller" through
  `GameQueryService.findTriggeringPermanentController` (CR 608.2h).

  graveyard incarnation, or its exile incarnation (`triggeringCardExileEntryVersion`) when it was exiled. Kaya's
  Ghostform is `Triggers.putIntoGraveyardOrExileFromBattlefield(null, ENCHANTED)` (a second key of the enchanted-leaves

#### Run 17w: the cast triggers' mana-value amounts read the triggering spell

Row 17w, split into 17w and 17w2. The row's about 41 sites are several families of different weight: the amounts
"equal to that spell's mana value" (or the mana spent on it) that an existing effect can read from the stack entry
with an existing amount (this run), and the rest (row 17w2): predicates and characteristics read from the spell, which
need an existing effect to take the spell's mana value into a card or permanent predicate (Infernal Kirin's
`RevealHandAndDiscardMatchingCardsEffect`, Celestial Kirin's `DestroyAllPermanentsEffect`) or an amount for P/T
(Veiled Sentry's `BecomeCreatureEffect` takes `int`s), Magmablood Archaic's colors spent, and the handlers that rebuild
with the spell's name, snapshot, caster or mana cost (same-name graveyard counts, counter-unless, Knowledge Pool,
Possibility Storm, Eye of the Storm, the copy-for-each family, the drain and life-loss rebuilds,
`CounterTriggerCollectorService`'s copy), then the `SpellCastTriggerEffect` record.

**When the value is read.** Every card's ruling (checked with `get_rulings`) reads "that spell's mana value" with the
chosen X (CR 202.3e, checked) and, if the spell left the stack, as it last existed there (Rashmi's ruling; CR 608.2h,
checked). A spell's mana value doesn't change on the stack, so reading it as the ability resolves from the live spell,
else the entry's triggering spell (`TargetSpellManaValue`), gives what the baked value gave. Imminent Doom's ruling
fixes "that much" at the counters as the ability triggered, which its filter makes equal to the spell's mana value.

**The model.**

- Rashmi, Eternities Crafter: `Triggers.youCastSpell().nthThisTurn(1)` (the first spell of any kind the controller
  casts this turn, what the handler's `getSpellsCastThisTurnCount == 1` checked) and `RashmiRevealTopCardEffect()`
  (lost its `int`), whose handler evaluates `TargetSpellManaValue` against the entry. `RashmiTriggerEffect` and its
  handler are gone.
- "Deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to any target": `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new
  TargetSpellManaValue())` on a filtered cast trigger (Rage Extractor `.withFilter(PhyrexianManaPredicate)`, Thor, God of
  Thunder `.withFilter(noncreature)`, Kaervek the Merciless `opponentCastsSpell().anySpell()`). The generic collector's
  target choice already carries the spell and its mana value (`effectCarriesTriggeringSpellManaValue`), and the entry
  takes the spell's snapshot from the choice (run 17b).
- "+X/+X (or +X/+0) where X is that spell's mana value": `BoostSelfEffect(new TargetSpellManaValue(), new
  TargetSpellManaValue() / new Fixed(0))`, with `GrantKeywordEffect(TRAMPLE, SELF)` for Skittering Cicada (Manaplasm,
  Jamie McCrimmon, Erratic Cyclops, Renegade Bull). The non-targeted entry has the triggering spell.
- Hammerhead Tyrant: "up to one target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value X or less" is the card's
  own target group with `PermanentMaxManaValueXPredicate`, `ReturnToHandEffect.target()` on `youCastSpell().anySpell()`.
  `readsManaValueX` knows `PermanentMaxManaValueXPredicate`, and the multi-target choice (an "up to one" group goes
  there) gets the spell's mana value as its X when the target filter reads X (`ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger.xValue`,
  which its candidate scan and the entry's resolution check read); any other multi-target cast choice keeps X 0.
- Chandra, Dressed to Kill's emblem: `new CreateEmblemEffect(new TriggeredAbility(youCastSpell().withFilter(red), new
  DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new ManaSpentToCast())), text)`, collected by the emblem cast reader (run 17h); the
  generic collector gives a `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(ManaSpentToCast)` the mana spent on the spell as the ability's
  X (`effectNeedsSpellManaSpentX`), which `ManaSpentToCast` reads on a cast trigger. The class-keyed emblem branch in
  `TriggerCollectionService` is gone.
- Imminent Doom: `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new TargetSpellManaValue())`; `snapshotCountersOnSourceDamage`, which
  rewrote any top-level `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(CountersOnSource)` of a cast trigger to `Fixed`, is gone (no other
  cast trigger had one: Sphinx-Bone Wand's sits in a "you may" and reads its counters as it resolves, as before).
- Gone: `RashmiTriggerEffect`, `DealDamageEqualToSpellManaValueToAnyTargetEffect`,
  `DealDamageEqualToManaSpentToCastToAnyTargetEffect`, `BoostSelfByCastSpellManaValueEffect`,
  `ReturnTargetPermanentByCastSpellManaValueEffect`, their five handlers in `SpellCastTriggerCollectorService`
  (`handleRashmiFirstSpell`, `handleManaValueDamage`, `handleReturnTargetPermanentByCastSpellManaValue`,
  `handleManaSpentDamage`, `handleManaValueSelfBoost`), the emblem branch and `snapshotCountersOnSourceDamage`.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17w-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 12 card classes: Rashmi,
Eternities Crafter, Rage Extractor, Thor, God of Thunder, Kaervek the Merciless, Hammerhead Tyrant, Chandra, Dressed to
Kill, Skittering Cicada, Manaplasm, Jamie McCrimmon, Erratic Cyclops, Renegade Bull, Imminent Doom.

- Hammerhead Tyrant's entry now has the spell's mana value as its X and its card's target group as the filter its

For step 16: no new `Card`, `StackEntry` or `GameData` state; nothing new is slot-keyed.

#### Run 17w2: the cast triggers' "that player" and the spell's name, mana value and colors spent read the stack entry

Row 17w2, split into 17w2 and 17w3. The row's about 34 sites are two families of different weight: the rebuilds an
existing effect can do from what the generic cast collector already puts on its entry, the caster as "that player" (the
non-targeting `targetId` the `TRIGGERING_PLAYER` recipients read) and the triggering spell (this run), and the rebuilds
whose effect binds the spell's stack object or caster for a counter, a cast from exile or a copy (row 17w3: Cephalid
Shrine's counter-unless, Ice Cave, Chalice of the Void, Void Mirror, Knowledge Pool, Possibility Storm, Eye of the Storm,
the seven `CopySpellForEach…Effect(snapshot, …)` classes and Thousand-Year Storm's `StormCopyEffect`,
`CounterTriggerCollectorService`'s copy, then the `SpellCastTriggerEffect` record). The generic collector's counter
entry targets the spell where those handlers make a non-targeting one and skip an uncounterable spell, and the copy
handlers fix the copies' targets as the ability triggers; each needs a decision of its own.

**When the value is read.** As the ability resolves (CR 608.2h, checked): "that player" is the caster, and the spell's
name, mana value and colors spent don't change while it is on the stack, so the live spell gives what the baked value
gave; once it has left, the entry's snapshot is the spell as it last existed. The rulings (checked with `get_rulings`)
agree: Veiled Sentry ("If the spell is no longer on the stack when the triggered ability resolves, the mana value of the
spell is still remembered"), Magmablood Archaic ("It resolves even if that spell is countered or otherwise leaves the
stack"), Celestial Kirin (the mana value with the chosen X, CR 202.3e, checked). Veiled Sentry's and Scab-Clan
Berserker's "if" are intervening "if"s (CR 603.4, checked); Adrenaline Jockey's and Scytheclaw Raptor's "if it's not
their turn" stays the cast filter `notDuringCastersTurn()` the deleted handler checked, as the turn can't change before
the ability resolves.

**The model.**

- "That player loses N life" / "deals N damage to that player" / "that player loses N life and you gain M life": a
  filtered cast trigger with `LoseLifeEffect(N, TRIGGERING_PLAYER)`, `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(N, TRIGGERING_PLAYER)`
  and `GainLifeEffect(M)`, on the generic collector's non-targeting entry. Teval, Arbiter of Virtue `LoseLifeEffect(new
  TargetSpellManaValue(), CONTROLLER)`, Treacherous Blessing `LoseLifeEffect(1)`, Curse of Wizardry `withFilter(new
  CardHasSourceChosenColorPredicate())`, Scab-Clan Berserker `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(new
  SourceIsRenowned())`, Magebane Lizard's `SpellsCastThisTurn(…, TARGET_PLAYER)` the caster's as before.
- "The number of cards in all graveyards with the same name as that spell": the new card predicate
  `CardSharesNameWithTriggeringSpellPredicate` in `CardsInGraveyard(…, ANY_PLAYER)`. `AmountEvaluationService`'s graveyard
  count reads the name from the resolving entry's triggering spell (the live spell, else its snapshot; a face-down spell
  has none) and judges it as a `CardNamedPredicate`; `PredicateEvaluationService` matches nothing without the entry.
  Nantuko Shrine `CreateTokenForTriggeringPlayerEffect(new CreateTokenEffect(…))`, Aven Shrine `GainLifeEffect(…,
  TRIGGERING_PLAYER)`, Cabal Shrine `DiscardEffect(…, TRIGGERING_PLAYER)`, Dwarven Shrine `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new
  Scaled(…, 2), TRIGGERING_PLAYER)`.
- "With that spell's mana value" as an effect's own filter: the generic collector gives the ability the spell's mana
  value as its X when an effect's filter reads X (`effectFilterReadsManaValueX`: `DestroyAllPermanentsEffect` with a
  permanent X predicate, `RevealHandAndDiscardMatchingCardsEffect` with a card X predicate), as it does for a target
  restricted by it (Skyfire Kirin, run 17b). Celestial Kirin `DestroyAllPermanentsEffect(new
  PermanentManaValueEqualsXPredicate())`, Infernal Kirin `RevealHandAndDiscardMatchingCardsEffect(new
  CardManaValueEqualsXPredicate())`, whose handler now passes the entry's X and the game to the card predicate.
- "For each color of mana spent to cast that spell": `ColorsSpentToCast` on a cast trigger (a triggered entry with a
  triggering spell) reads the ability's X, which the generic collector sets to the colors spent on the spell
  (`effectReadsColorsSpent`), as `ManaSpentToCast` reads the mana spent. Magmablood Archaic `BoostAllOwnCreaturesEffect(new
  ColorsSpentToCast(), new Fixed(0))`.
- "It becomes an Illusion creature with power and toughness each equal to that spell's mana value":
  `BecomeCreatureEffect` gained `powerAmount` / `toughnessAmount` (evaluated once as it resolves; the int forms
  unchanged) and the `(DynamicAmount, DynamicAmount, CardSubtype)` constructor. Veiled Sentry `BecomeCreatureEffect(new
  TargetSpellManaValue(), new TargetSpellManaValue(), ILLUSION)` with the intervening "if" `SourceIsEnchantment`.
- `CardHasSourceChosenColorPredicate` reads the card's colors as effects leave them (`getEffectiveCardColors`), as
  `CardColorPredicate` does and as Curse of Wizardry's deleted handler did.
- Gone: `CasterLosesLifeOnSpellCastEffect`, `CasterLosesLifeOnChosenColorSpellCastEffect`, `SpellCastLifeDrainEffect`,
  `SpellCastDamageToCasterEffect`, `CreateSquirrelTokensForSameNameCardsInGraveyardsOnSpellCastEffect`,
  `DealDamageForSameNameCardsInGraveyardsOnSpellCastEffect`, `GainLifeForSameNameCardsInGraveyardsOnSpellCastEffect`,
  `DiscardForSameNameCardsInGraveyardsOnSpellCastEffect`, `DiscardAllCardsWithCastSpellManaValueEffect`,
  `DestroyAllPermanentsWithCastSpellManaValueEffect`, `BecomeCreatureByCastSpellManaValueEffect`,
  `BoostAllOwnCreaturesByColorsSpentOnSpellCastEffect`, their twelve handlers in `SpellCastTriggerCollectorService` and
  `spellManaValueOnStack`.
