#### Run 17w3: the cast triggers' counter and exile rebuilds read the stack entry, and `SpellCastTriggerEffect` is gone

Row 17w3, split into 17w3 and 17w4. The row's about 22 sites are two families of different weight: the counter and
exile rebuilds, whose effect binds the spell's name, mana cost or stack object, or its caster, and which an existing
effect reads from the generic cast collector's entry (this run), and the copy rebuilds (row 17w4): the seven
`CopySpellForEach…Effect(snapshot, …)` classes, Thousand-Year Storm's `StormCopyEffect` and
`CounterTriggerCollectorService`'s copy, whose handlers judge the spell's targets as the ability triggers (the sole
target, "targets only this", another legal target) and fix the copies' targets from them, which needs a decision on
each card's trigger condition and on what the copy handlers read once the spell has left. The `SpellCastTriggerEffect`
record went in this run, as no card constructs it.

**When the value is read.** As the ability resolves (CR 608.2h, checked): the triggering spell is the live spell while
it is on the stack, else the entry's snapshot; "that player" is the caster. The rulings (checked with `get_rulings`)
agree. Chalice of the Void: "The number of charge counters on Chalice of the Void matters only at the time the spell is
cast" and "if it leaves the battlefield once its ability has triggered, that ability will still counter the spell": a
trigger condition, not an intervening "if", so the stack-entry filter `StackEntryManaValueEqualsSourceCountersPredicate`
judges it as the spell is cast and nothing is judged again (the deleted handler's resolution check compared the spell's
mana value with itself). Void Mirror's "if no colored mana was spent to cast it" is an intervening "if" (CR 603.4,
checked), but what was spent can't change once the spell is cast, so the filter's verdict is the resolution's too (as
run 17w2's `notDuringCastersTurn()`). Knowledge Pool ("If the original spell isn't exiled … the rest of the ability does
nothing"), Possibility Storm ("If Possibility Storm's ability doesn't exile the original spell … you'll still exile
cards … until you exile a card that shares a card type with it") and Eye of the Storm (a copy of a card "won't trigger
this ability") exile the spell only while it is still on the stack, as their handlers did; Possibility Storm reads the
spell's card types from the entry's snapshot once it has left. Ice Cave: "The mana cost does not include cost increases
or reductions": the printed cost with the chosen X, read from the live spell, else the snapshot (a second Ice Cave still
offers it after the first countered the spell, as before).

**The model.**

- "Counter that spell" of a cast trigger is `CounterSpellEffect()` on a filtered cast trigger: the generic collector's
  spell-target branch aims the non-targeting entry at the triggering spell (`targetId` the spell in `Zone.STACK`, the
  caster as `counteredSpellControllerId`, the triggering spell recorded). Chalice of the Void
  `Triggers.playerCastsSpell().withStackEntryFilter(new StackEntryManaValueEqualsSourceCountersPredicate(CHARGE))`, Void
  Mirror `.withStackEntryFilter(new StackEntryNotPredicate(new StackEntryColoredManaSpentPredicate()))`.
- `StackEntryColoredManaSpentPredicate` (new, sealed `StackEntryPredicate`): a spell that had colored mana spent to cast
  it, read by `TargetLegalityService` from `GameData.getSpellCastColorsSpent` (what the deleted handler checked);
  `PredicateEvaluationService` has no game and matches nothing, as for the other game-reading stack predicates.
- Cephalid Shrine: `CounterUnlessPaysEffect(new CardsInGraveyard(new CardSharesNameWithTriggeringSpellPredicate(),
  CountScope.ANY_PLAYER))` on `playerCastsSpell().anySpell()`, the count read as it resolves (run 17w2's predicate).
- Ice Cave: `CounterUnlessOtherPlayerPaysManaCostOnSpellCastEffect()` on `playerCastsSpell().anySpell()` is now a
  resolution effect (a spell spec, so the entry is aimed at the spell without targeting it; new handler). As it resolves
  it reads the spell's mana cost and inserts `MayPayManaEffect(cost, CounterSpellEffect(), …, ANY_OTHER_PLAYER)` as the
  ability's next effect (the insert-a-follow-up pattern, so the payment resumes as any resolution-time "you may pay"
  does). `MayPayManaEffectHandler`'s `ANY_OTHER_PLAYER` leaves out the controller of the entry's triggering spell instead
  of the entry's `activePlayerId`, which only Ice Cave's handler set.
- Knowledge Pool `KnowledgePoolExileAndCastEffect()` and Possibility Storm `PossibilityStormExileAndCastEffect()` on
  `playerCastsSpell().castFrom(Zone.HAND)`, Eye of the Storm `EyeOfTheStormExileAndCopyEffect()` on `playerCastsSpell()
  .withFilter(instant or sorcery).withStackEntryFilter(new StackEntryNotPredicate(new StackEntryIsCopyPredicate(true)))`:
  the three records lost their bound ids (spell, source permanent, caster, Possibility Storm's card) and their handlers
  read the entry's triggering card and spell snapshot, its source permanent and its non-targeting "that player".
- Gone: `CounterUnlessPaysForSameNameCardsInGraveyardsOnSpellCastEffect`, `CounterSpellIfManaValueEqualsSourceCountersEffect`,
  `CounterSpellIfNoColoredManaSpentEffect` (and their two handlers), `KnowledgePoolCastTriggerEffect`,
  `PossibilityStormCastTriggerEffect`, `EyeOfTheStormCastTriggerEffect`, the seven class-keyed handlers in
  `SpellCastTriggerCollectorService`, and `SpellCastTriggerEffect` with `TextChangeTransformer`'s case for it (a cast
  trigger's filter is rewritten by `transformSpellFilter`). Two cards (Aisha of Sparks and Smoke, Inventive Iteration)
  still imported the record unused.

#### Run 17w4: the copy-for-each cast triggers read the stack entry's triggering spell

Row 17w4, split into 17w4 and 17w5. The row's about 10 sites are two families of different weight: the seven
`CopySpellForEach…Effect(snapshot, …)` classes (this run), whose class-keyed cast handlers judged the spell's targets
and fixed a snapshot, the caster and the original target into the effect, and three sites of their own (row 17w5):
Thousand-Year Storm's prior-spells `StormCopyEffect`, whose count needs an amount `CopyTriggeringSpellEffect` can read,
`CounterTriggerCollectorService`'s Trial and Error copy, a different collector, and `FirstSpellCastTriggerEffect`
(below).

**When the value is read.** As the ability resolves (CR 608.2h, checked): the copies are made from the spell as it is
on the stack then (its targets, X, modes and costs, CR 707.10, checked), else from the stack entry's snapshot of it as
it last existed there. The rulings (checked with `get_rulings`) agree: "The copy is created even if the spell that
caused the ability to trigger has been countered by the time the ability resolves" (Exterminator Magmarch; Precursor
Golem's, Mirrorwing Dragon's and Zada's copies likewise), Beamsplitter Mage's "If you don't control another creature
the spell could target as Beamsplitter Mage's triggered ability resolves, you don't copy that spell" and "If Beamsplitter
Mage leaves the battlefield or becomes an illegal target for the spell that caused its ability to trigger, that spell
is still copied", Magmarch's "If the ability does trigger but no other opponent controls any nonland permanents the
spell could target by the time the ability resolves, the ability won't do anything". "Targets only this creature" /
"targets only a single Golem" / "targets only a single nonland permanent an opponent controls" / "with a single target"
are trigger conditions (the rulings: "the ability triggers whenever … casts an instant or sorcery spell that targets
only [it] and no other object or player"; Glimmervoid Basin: "If a spell targets the same player or object multiple
times, it won't cause Glimmervoid Basin's first ability to trigger"), so they are the triggers' stack-entry filters,
judged as the spell is cast. Ink-Treader Nephilim's "if that spell targets only this creature", Beamsplitter Mage's
"if you control one or more other creatures that spell could target" and Magmarch's "if another opponent controls one or
more nonland permanents that spell could target" are intervening "if"s (CR 603.4, checked): the filter judges them as
the ability triggers and the copy effect again as it resolves.

**The model.**

- Each card is a filtered cast trigger: `Triggers.playerCastsSpell()` / `youCastSpell()` with an instant-or-sorcery
  `withFilter` (Feather: noncreature; Hive Mind and Curse of Echoes keep their `StackEntryTypeInPredicate`) and its
  target condition as `withStackEntryFilter`: "targets only this creature" is Bill Potts' `StackEntryAllOfPredicate(
  StackEntryTargetsOnlySinglePermanentOrPlayerPredicate, StackEntryTargetsSourcePredicate)` (Mirrorwing Dragon, Zada,
  Beamsplitter Mage, Ink-Treader Nephilim, Feather), "targets only a single Golem" `StackEntryTargetsOnlySinglePermanentOrPlayerPredicate`
  with `StackEntryTargetsPermanentPredicate(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(GOLEM))`, Magmarch's the same with a nonland
  permanent an opponent controls, Curse of Echoes' `StackEntryControlledByEnchantedPlayerPredicate` (moved from the
  effect to the trigger). The generic cast collector puts the ability on the stack with the source permanent, the
  triggering card and spell, and the caster as its non-targeting "that player".
- `StackEntryHasOneTargetPredicate` (new): "a spell with a single target", one target chosen once (unlike
  `StackEntryIsSingleTargetPredicate`, which allows the same object named several times); `TargetLegalityService`
  judges it. Glimmervoid Basin `withFilter(instant or sorcery).withStackEntryFilter(new StackEntryHasOneTargetPredicate())`.
- `StackEntryCouldTargetAnotherPermanentPredicate(PermanentPredicate filter, boolean otherThanTargetController)` (new):
  the spell could target a permanent matching `filter` (judged from the ability's controller) other than its targets,
  and with `otherThanTargetController` one controlled by a player other than its target's controller. Judged by
  `SpellCastTriggerCollectorService.matchesCastSpellPredicate` (which enumerates the spell's legal targets through
  `ValidTargetService`, as it judges `StackEntryIsCardExiledWithSourcePredicate`); `TargetLegalityService` and
  `PredicateEvaluationService` match nothing. Beamsplitter Mage `(creature you control, false)`, Magmarch `(nonland
  permanent an opponent controls, true)`.
- The seven effects lost their bound components: `CopySpellForEachOtherPermanentOrPlayerEffect(boolean
  permanentOrPlayerOnly)` (its target spec always the spell target, so as Glimmervoid's cast trigger the generic
  collector's spell branch aims the non-targeting entry at the triggering spell, as it does for "counter that spell"),
  `CopySpellForEachOtherSubtypePermanentEffect(CardSubtype)`, `CopySpellForAnotherOpponentPermanentEffect()`,
  `CopySpellForEachOtherControlledCreatureEffect(boolean chooseOne)`, `CopySpellForEachOtherCreatureEffect()`,
  `CopySpellForEachOtherCreatureWithManaEffect(String)`, `CopySpellForEachOtherPlayerEffect(boolean optional)`. Their
  handlers read the spell through `CopySupport.triggeringSpell(gameData, entry)` (new: the spell while it is on the
  stack, else the entry's snapshot) and the caster as its controller; "other" is the ability's source (Mirrorwing, Zada,
  Beamsplitter, Ink-Treader, Feather) or the spell's sole target as it triggered (`CopySupport.soleTargetId` of the
  snapshot: Precursor Golem, Magmarch). Magmarch's "another opponent" is the controller of that target as the ability
  resolves, or as it last existed if it left the battlefield (`GameData.departedPermanentControllerIds`). Beamsplitter's
  and Magmarch's choice completions and Feather's multi-choice read the spell from the resolving entry
  (`pendingEffectResolutionEntry`). Ink-Treader's handler checks its intervening "if" again (the spell's sole target is
  still the source).
- Gone: the seven class-keyed handlers in `SpellCastTriggerCollectorService` (`handleCopySpellForEachOtherPermanentOrPlayer`,
  `handleCopySpellForSubtype`, `handleCopySpellForAnotherOpponentPermanent`, `handleCopySpellForEachOtherControlledCreature`,
  `handleCopySpellForEachOtherCreature`, `handleCopySpellForEachOtherCreatureWithMana`, `handleCopySpellForEachOtherPlayer`)
  and their helpers (`spellTargetsOnlyPermanent`, `hasOtherLegalCreatureTarget`, `hasAnotherOpponentPermanentTarget`,
  `findInstantOrSorceryOnStack`, `soleTargetId`, `soleNonPlayerTargetId`). No class went: each effect is still the
  resolution of its card's ability (EFFECT_MERGE_PLAN step 25 may still merge the two creature-filtered ones; its
  target signature lost the snapshot components).

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17w4-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 10 card classes: Zada, Hedron
Grinder, Mirrorwing Dragon, Beamsplitter Mage, Ink-Treader Nephilim, Feather, Radiant Arbiter, Precursor Golem,
Exterminator Magmarch, Hive Mind, Curse of Echoes, Glimmervoid Basin. Radiant Performer and Radiate construct
`permanentsAndPlayersOnly()`, unchanged.

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix: Ink-Treader Nephilim's intervening "if" is checked again as the ability resolves (CR 603.4): a spell
  redirected to another creature in response isn't copied
  (`InkTreaderNephilimTest#noCopiesWhenTheSpellNoLongerTargetsOnlyItAsTheAbilityResolves`, Lightning Bolt redirected by
  Shunt; the deleted handler copied the trigger-time snapshot).
- The copies of Precursor Golem, Mirrorwing Dragon, Zada, Beamsplitter Mage, Ink-Treader Nephilim, Feather and Magmarch
  are made from the spell as it resolves, else as it last existed (CR 608.2h), where the deleted handlers copied the
  snapshot taken as the ability triggered; Hive Mind's and Curse of Echoes' already did. The copies' targets are
  replaced, so no test sees a difference. Glimmervoid Basin's "other" target is read from the spell as it resolves too.
- Precursor Golem's "a single Golem" is judged with the permanent's subtypes as effects leave them and needs no other
  target (a card in a graveyard) on the spell; the deleted handler read the printed subtypes of the spell's one
  non-player target. The copies' Golems are still the printed ones (the handler's own filter, noted below).
- Beamsplitter Mage's intervening "if" reads the spell's legal targets with its X (`computeValidTargetsForSpell`), as
  Magmarch's did; Magmarch's "another opponent" is the target's controller as the ability resolves.
- Otherwise none intended: the entries are the generic collector's (now with the source permanent, which the deleted

#### Run 17w5: Thousand-Year Storm, Trial and Error and The Lord of Pain read the stack entry

Row 17w5, not split: the three sites run 17w4's Findings left, each a record a collector judged by class and rebuilt
with the triggering spell bound in (Thousand-Year Storm's `StormCopyEffect(snapshot, caster, copies)`, Trial and
Error's `MayEffect(CopyControllerCastSpellEffect(snapshot, controller))`, The Lord of Pain's `CastAbility` with
`PlayerOtherThanPredicate(caster)`). Each card is now its trigger with existing effects that read the stack entry.

**When the value is read.** As the ability resolves (CR 608.2h, checked), the copies made from the triggering spell as
it is on the stack then, else as it last existed there (CR 707.10, checked). The rulings (checked with `get_rulings`)
agree. Thousand-Year Storm: "Copies are created even if the spell that caused Thousand-Year Storm's ability to trigger
has been countered by the time that ability resolves" and "Spells you've cast that were countered were still cast, and
so will add copies". Its count, "each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast before it this turn", is fixed by the
cast itself: a spell cast in response is cast after it, so it is counted as the ability resolves but only up to the
triggering spell's place among its caster's spells this turn, which the stack entry keeps from the moment the ability
triggers (CR 601.2i, checked: cast triggers trigger as the spell becomes cast). Trial and Error ("A spell fizzles when
it tries to resolve but each of its targets is no longer a legal target"): the countered or fizzled spell is copied as
it last existed on the stack, a copy of it too: a copy of a spell ceases to exist once it leaves the stack (CR 704.5e,
checked), but it triggered and its last-known information is copied. "Choose new targets for the copy" lets its
controller leave the targets unchanged (CR 115.7d, checked), the copy effect's usual new-target choice. The Lord of
Pain: "The Lord of Pain's last ability must target a player other than the one who cast the spell that caused the
ability to trigger" and "If a spell has {X} in its mana cost, use the value chosen for X": "another target player" is
judged against the caster as the target is chosen and again as it resolves, the mana value read from the triggering
spell (with its X) as it resolves.

**The model.**

- Thousand-Year Storm: `Triggers.youCastSpell().withFilter(instant or sorcery)` with `new CopyTriggeringSpellEffect()
  .withCopies(new SpellsCastBeforeTriggeringSpellThisTurn(instant or sorcery))`.
- `SpellsCastBeforeTriggeringSpellThisTurn(CardPredicate filter)` (new `DynamicAmount`): the matching spells the
  triggering spell's caster (its snapshot's controller) cast this turn before it: `GameData.getSpellsCastThisTurn` up to
  `StackEntry.triggeringSpellCastIndex`. Zero without a triggering spell.
- `StackEntry.triggeringSpellCastIndex` (new, an `int`, `-1` when none; copied by the copy constructor, so in
  simulations): the triggering spell's place among its caster's spells cast this turn, the card's latest casting there
  (a card cast, returned and cast again is a new spell each time). The generic cast collector sets it on its
  non-targeting entries (the spell-target branch and the plain branch), where it records the triggering spell; a
  targeted cast trigger's entry, built from its choice, doesn't have it (no card needs it there).
- `CopyTriggeringSpellEffect` gained `dynamicCopies` and `withCopies(DynamicAmount)`: the count is evaluated as the
  ability resolves, no copy at zero. `CopyControllerCastSpellEffectHandler` evaluates its `dynamicCopies` (no card set
  it before) from the resolving entry (`AmountContext.forStackEntry`) instead of a bare caster, and a count of several
  no longer has the single-copy replacement applied to each copy again (the copy event's count already includes it).
- Trial and Error: `Triggers.thisSpellCounteredOrFizzles()` with `new MayEffect(new CopyTriggeringSpellEffect(), "Copy
  Trial and Error?")`. `CounterTriggerCollectorService`'s countered-or-fizzled collector is now generic (keyed by
  `CardEffect`): the spell's ability goes on the stack as written, controlled by the spell's controller, with the spell
  as it last existed as its triggering card and spell. `CopyTriggeringSpellEffectHandler` no longer refuses a triggering
  spell that is a copy (a cast trigger's spell never is one; a fizzled copy of Trial and Error is).
- The Lord of Pain: `target(new PlayerPredicateTargetFilter(new PlayerOtherThanTriggeringPlayerPredicate(), …))
  .addTrigger(Triggers.playerCastsSpell().nthThisTurn(1), new DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new TargetSpellManaValue(),
  TARGET_PLAYER))`.
- `PlayerOtherThanTriggeringPlayerPredicate` (new, sealed `PlayerPredicate`, replacing `PlayerOtherThanPredicate`, which
  only the deleted handler built): a player other than the one the event was about. `TargetLegalityService
  .matchesPlayerPredicate` has an overload with the triggering player (the others pass none, which matches nobody for
  it), `ValidTargetService.filterValidPlayerTargets` one for a trigger's player choice, `TriggeredAbilityQueueService`
  passes the choice's triggering player, and the resolution recheck the entry's. The generic cast collector's
  single-target choice carries the caster as its triggering player (`SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget.withTriggeringPlayer`),
  which the entry built from it keeps.
- Gone: `CopySpellForEachPriorInstantOrSorceryEffect`, `CopyThisSpellWhenCounteredOrFizzlesEffect`,
  `FirstSpellCastTriggerEffect`, `PlayerOtherThanPredicate`, and the three class-keyed handlers
  (`handleFirstSpellCastTrigger`, `handleCopySpellForEachPriorInstantOrSorcery`, the class-keyed countered-or-fizzled
  one).

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17w5-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module): Thousand-Year Storm, Trial
and Error, The Lord of Pain.

**Behaviour changes.**

- No rules fix. Thousand-Year Storm's count is the deleted handler's (the spells before the triggering one), now read as
  the ability resolves; its copies are made by the shared controller-copy machinery (the same new-target choice per
  copy, and a replacement's extra copies, such as Twinning Staff's, with a choice of their own).
- The Lord of Pain's ability goes on the stack through the generic cast collector as before; its target choice and
  entry now carry the caster as their triggering player, and its damage is the spell's mana value read as it resolves
  (the same number: a spell's mana value doesn't change on the stack).
- Trial and Error's entry now has the countered spell as its triggering card and spell; the prompts are the same.
- Every targeted cast trigger's choice now carries the caster as its triggering player, so a `PermanentControlledByTriggeringPlayerPredicate`
  filter on a cast trigger would read "that player" as the caster (no card has one).

For step 16: one new `StackEntry` field, copied; nothing new is slot-keyed. One record gained a component.

#### Run 17x: the storm family's copy counts read the stack entry

Row 17x, split by family into 17x to 17x5. The row's about 66 sites are five families that share only the collectors
rebuilding them: the storm family's six `StormCopyEffect(snapshot, caster, copies)` rebuilds in
`TriggerCollectionService` (this run, the one family with one model: a "when you cast this spell" copy with a count),
the damage family (row 17x2), the enter and land-tap families (row 17x3), the life, emblem, step and vote families
(row 17x4), and the rest of `TriggerCollectionService` with `LegacyTriggerBindings`' nine (row 17x5).

**When the value is read.** Storm (CR 702.40a, checked: "copy it for each other spell that was cast before it this
turn"), replicate (CR 702.56a, checked: "When you cast this spell, if a replicate cost was paid for it, copy it for
each time its replicate cost was paid"), gravestorm (CR 702.69a, checked) and the cards' own counts are information
the copy effect needs as it is applied (CR 608.2h, checked), so each is read as the ability resolves, from the stack
entry. The rulings (checked with `get_rulings`) agree. Ral, Crackling Wit: "Spells cast from zones other than a
player's hand and spells that were countered or otherwise failed to resolve are counted by the storm ability" and "If
a spell has multiple instances of storm, each will trigger separately" (CR 702.40b, checked). Show of Confidence:
"The triggered ability counts all instants and sorceries that were cast before it resolves. If you cast instant
spells in response to the ability, those spells will count." Echo Storm: "Each Storm's triggered ability counts only
how many times you've cast your commander from the command zone before that triggered ability resolves" and "If you
have multiple commanders, you'll copy this spell for each time you've cast either of them". Storm's "before it" is
fixed by the cast itself: the count stops at the triggering spell's place in the turn's cast order, which the stack
entry keeps from the moment the ability triggers, so a spell cast in response isn't counted (a card cast again is a
new object, CR 400.7, checked, with a new place). Replicate's "if a replicate cost was paid for it" is an intervening
"if" (CR 603.4, checked), judged as the spell is cast and again as the ability resolves. The copies are made from the
spell as it is on the stack then, else as it last existed there (CR 608.2h); a copy of a permanent spell becomes a
token (CR 111.13, checked), the cards' `permanentSpellCopiesAreTokens()`.

**The model.**

- Every card is its `Triggers.youCastThisSpell()` ability with the existing `CopyTriggeringSpellEffect` and a count
  `withCopies(DynamicAmount)`, evaluated as it resolves (run 17w5's `dynamicCopies`):
  - storm: `CopyTriggeringSpellEffect.storm()` (new factory) = `withCopies(SpellsCastBeforeTriggeringSpellThisTurn
    .byAnyPlayer())`; the `StormEffect(true)` cards add `permanentSpellCopiesAreTokens()` (Tempest Technique,
    Stormscale Scion), Aeve, Progenitor Ooze also `withoutSupertypes(Set.of(LEGENDARY))`;
  - Show of Confidence ("each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast this turn", read as it resolves): the
    existing `SpellsCastThisTurn(instant or sorcery, CONTROLLER, excludeResolvingSpell)`;
  - replicate: `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(new RepeatedAdditionalCostPaid(cost))` and `withCopies(new
    RepeatedAdditionalCostCount(cost))`, both existing (Changing Loyalty `permanentSpellCopiesAreTokens()`);
    Exterminate!'s tap replicate `withInterveningIf(new SpellXAtLeast(1))` and `withCopies(new TriggeringSpellXValue())`;
  - "copy it X times" (Photon Blast Barrage) and Plumb the Forbidden's "for each creature sacrificed this way" (the
    spell's X): `withCopies(new TriggeringSpellXValue())`;
  - gravestorm (Bitter Ordeal, Follow the Bodies, Ominous Harvest): the new
    `PermanentsPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldThisTurn` (the existing counter); coststorm (Friarball): the new
    `DistinctManaValuesAmongOtherSpellsAndLandsPlayedThisTurn` ("other" the entry's triggering spell); the counter
    kinds (Storm of Forms): the existing `DistinctCounterKindsAmongControlledPermanents`; the commander casts (Echo
    Storm, Skull Storm, Genesis Storm, Fury Storm, Empyrial Storm, Hatut Zeraze Strike Force): the existing
    `CommanderCastsFromCommandZoneThisGame()` (the casts the engine records per caster, which every other
    commander-cast card reads; the deleted record read the commanders' tax).
- `SpellsCastBeforeTriggeringSpellThisTurn` gained `anyPlayer` (the one-argument form, Thousand-Year Storm's, counts
  the caster's spells): every player's spells ahead of `StackEntry.triggeringSpellTurnCastIndex` in the new
  `GameData.getSpellCastOrderThisTurn()`.
- `StackEntry.triggeringSpellTurnCastIndex` (new, an `int`, `-1` when none; copied by the copy constructor, so in
  simulations): the triggering spell's place in the turn's cast order across every player. The generic cast collector
  sets it next to `triggeringSpellCastIndex` (its private `castIndex` is now `GameData.getSpellCastIndexThisTurn`).
- The self-cast collector's "copy this spell" branch records the triggering spell through the new
  `recordTriggeringSpell`: the spell, both places, its X and its repeatable additional cost payments (the cast facts
  the counts and replicate's intervening "if" read as the ability resolves; the plain self-cast trigger already
  carries the spell's X and kicker so). Its four class-keyed branches (`CopyThisSpellForXValueEffect`,
  `ReplicateEffect`, `SpellCastCopyTriggerEffect`, `StormEffect`) and `queueStormTrigger` are gone.
- Granted storm: Prismari, the Inspiration grants `CopyTriggeringSpellEffect.storm()`
  (`GrantCastTriggerToSpellsEffect(STORM_TO_INSTANT_OR_SORCERY, …)`), and the pending "the next instant or sorcery
  spell you cast this turn has storm" (Storm, Force of Nature, Crackling Spellslinger) is the same effect; both go on
  the stack as written through `queueGrantedStorm`, the spell recorded as above. Ral, Crackling Wit's emblem is
  `CreateEmblemEffect(new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.youCastSpell().withFilter(instant or sorcery),
  CopyTriggeringSpellEffect.storm()), …)` (Jaya's form, run 17h), collected by the generic cast collector; the emblem
  loop's `StormEffect` branch is gone. Granted replicate (Djinn Illuminatus, Hatchery Sliver, Threefold Signal, Ian
  Chesterton) is built as the same intervening-"if" copy when the spell's payments include its cost; a spell's own
  replicate with that cost still triggers alone (`countsReplicatePayments`).
- Gone: `StormEffect`, `StormCopyEffect` and `StormCopyEffectHandler`, `SpellCastCopyTrigger`,
  `SpellCastCopyTriggerEffect`, `OtherInstantsAndSorceriesCastCountEffect`, `GravestormEffect`, `CoststormEffect`,
  `CopyThisSpellForEachCounterKindEffect`, `CopyThisSpellForEachCommanderCastEffect`, `CopyThisSpellForXValueEffect`,
  `ReplicateEffect`, and `CardImmutabilityArchTest`'s allowance for the deleted handler.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17x-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module and `shared`), 68 card classes:
the 34 storm cards (Corvid Squall in `shared`), Indris's conjured Lightning Bolt, Prismari, Ral, Show of Confidence,
the 17 replicate cards (Exterminate! among them), Photon Blast Barrage and Plumb the Forbidden, the three gravestorm
cards, Friarball, Storm of Forms and the six commander-cast cards.

**Behaviour changes.**

- No rules fix. The storm count is the deleted handler's number (the spells before it), now read as the ability
  resolves; the counts the deleted records read as it resolved (gravestorm, coststorm, the commander casts, Show of
  Confidence) still are, and the counter kinds and the X, fixed as the spell was cast before, are read as it resolves

- The copies are made by the shared controller-copy machinery (`CopyControllerCastSpellEffectHandler`), as Thousand-Year

- The commander-cast count reads the casts the engine records per caster, not the commanders' tax (the same number in

(damage, …, not damagedCreatureId)`). `DamageTriggerCollectorService`: All Will Be One's counters placed
(`DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(countersPlaced)`), Flameblade Angel's `DealDamageToDamageSourceControllerEffect(1,
sourcePermanentId, sourceControllerId)`, Justice's total (`DealDamageToPlayersEffect(total, TARGET_PLAYER)`), Mangara's
Equity's and Imodane's damage dealt, and the enchanted-creature destroy handler's `ATTACHED` → `TRIGGERING` rewrite (Hot
Soup, Mortal Wound). `CombatDamageService`: `TargetPlayerLosesGameEffect(defenderId)` and Harsh Justice's reflected
`DealDamageToPlayersEffect(damage, …)`.

**When the value is read.** "That much" is the damage the event dealt (or the counters it put), fixed by the event: it
is the stack entry's event value, as every other damage collector has kept it since run 10. "That creature's controller",
"that creature's or spell's controller" and "that source's controller" need information from an object, so they are
read as the ability resolves: the object's current information if it is still in the zone it was expected in, else its
last known information (CR 608.2h, checked). The rulings (checked with `get_rulings`) don't say otherwise: Greatbow
Doyen's two ("an Archer permanent", "combat damage or not"), Justice's two (one source's simultaneous damage summed into
one reflection, "a triggered ability, which is added to the stack just after"), Flameblade Angel's two (one trigger per
recipient, the may cycle), All Will Be One's two (one trigger per placement event); Kusari-Gama, Imodane, Mangara's
Equity, Flayed Nim, Harsh Justice and Hot Soup have none. Optional abilities still go on the stack and ask as they
resolve (CR 603.5, checked). "Defending player" (Kusari-Gama) is fixed by the combat (CR 506.2, checked) and stays the
entry's non-targeting player.

**The model.**

- A trigger-condition record a collector still judges by class (its filters are not expressible as the trigger's
  `PermanentPredicate` filter: "a red creature or spell", "of the chosen color … to you or a white creature you control",
  "a spell that targets only a single creature", "this / an Archer you control … to a creature", equipped-and-blocking)
  names the effect that goes on the stack, `triggeredEffect()`, as `DamagedCreatureTriggerEffect.triggeredEffect()`
  already did; the collector puts it on the entry unchanged and records the event there:
  - `ReflectAllyDamageToDamagedCreatureControllerEffect.triggeredEffect()`: `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new EventValue(),
    TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)`, or `LoseLifeEffect(new EventValue(), TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)` for Flayed
    Nim's form. The entry's source is still the creature that dealt the damage ("that Archer deals"), the damaged
    creature its triggering permanent (with its controller as the event happened as the fallback), the damage its
    event value; it no longer has a target.
  - `EquipmentDamagesOtherDefendingCreaturesEffect.triggeredEffect()`: `DealDamageToEachMatchingPermanentEffect(new
    EventValue(), creature and not PermanentIsTriggeringPermanentPredicate, TARGET_PLAYER)`, the damaged blocker the
    entry's triggering permanent. `DealDamageToEachMatchingPermanentEffectHandler`'s filter context now carries the
    entry's triggering permanent (no card's predicate on that effect read it before).
  - `ReflectSourceDamageToItsControllerEffect.triggeredEffect()`: `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new EventValue(),
    TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)`, the damage source the entry's triggering permanent (none for a spell) and its
    controller as it dealt the damage the fallback.
  - `ReflectDamageToChosenColorCreatureEffect.triggeredEffect()`: `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect(new EventValue())`,
    the damaging creature the entry's non-chosen target as before.
  - `DealDamageToEachOpponentWhenSingleTargetCreatureSpellDealsDamageEffect.triggeredEffect()`:
    `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new EventValue(), EACH_OPPONENT)`, the damage to the spell's single creature target the
    event value.
- All Will Be One writes `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new EventValue())`; the counters-placed collector queues it
  unchanged with the counters as the target choice's event value (`SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget.spellManaSpentX`, which
  the entry built from the choice keeps as its event value).
- Flameblade Angel writes `MayEffect(DealDamageToPlayersEffect(1, DamageRecipient.TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER))`;
  the collector puts the "you may" on the stack as written, the source its triggering permanent and the source's
  controller as it dealt the damage the fallback (a spell source). `DealDamageToDamageSourceControllerEffect` and its
  handler are gone.
- "Whenever enchanted / equipped creature is dealt damage, destroy it" is `DestroyReferencedPermanentEffect(
  PermanentReference.TRIGGERING)` (Hot Soup, Mortal Wound, Mire Blight, Sporogenic Infection, Cryoshatter); the
  class-keyed `handleEnchantedCreatureDealtDamageDestroy` is gone and the watch's default collector, which records the
  creature, its controller, the damage and the source snapshot, queues it.
- "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game" (Phage, Vraska the Unseen's Assassin
  tokens, Vraska, Golgari Queen's emblem grant, Summon: Primal Odin): the creature collector's `TargetPlayerLosesGameEffect` branch is
  gone. `TargetPlayerLosesGameEffect(null)` already reports `DAMAGED_PLAYER`, so the generic entry carries the player
  dealt damage as its non-targeting player, which the handler reads (as the attached collector already did for Vorpal
  Sword). The record keeps `playerId` for the engine-built abilities that bind it (`StepTriggerService`,
  `LegacyTriggerBindings`, `EtbEffectResolver`, `GraveyardReturnSupport`: rows 17x4 and 17x5).
- Harsh Justice's delayed reflection is `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new EventValue(), TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)`
  with the damage as the entry's event value.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17x2-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 7 card classes: All Will Be
One, Flameblade Angel, Hot Soup, Mortal Wound, Mire Blight, Sporogenic Infection, Cryoshatter (its "is dealt damage"
ability; its "becomes tapped" one keeps `ATTACHED`). The other cards (Greatbow Doyen, Flayed Nim, Kusari-Gama, Justice,
Mangara's Equity, Imodane, Phage, the two Vraskas, Summon: Primal Odin, Harsh Justice) are unchanged: the engine and

**Behaviour changes.**

#### Run 17x3: the enter family's values read the stack entry's triggering permanent

Row 17x3, split into 17x3 and 17x3b. The row's sites, re-checked with run 17u's audit (`scripts/step15-run17u-audit.py`)
and by reading the collectors, are two families. This run takes the first: the places where a collector rebuilt an enter
ability with a value of the entering creature (its name, power or toughness) bound in or read through a swapped class,
and `LandTapTriggerCollectorService`'s three. Row 17x3b (new) is the second: the become-a-copy rebuilds and the markers
the enter collector rewrites to an effect aimed at the entering permanent as the entry's target ("transform it", "put
counters on it", "attach this to it", "that creature's controller"), which need one model for "it" across about ten
handlers.

The sites (15): `EnterTriggerCollectorService`'s Guardian Project draw (`DrawCardIfEnteringCreatureHasUniqueNameEffect(
name, cardId)`), the "you may gain life equal to that creature's toughness / power" rewrites in `handleEnterMay`
(`GainLifeEffect(TargetToughness / TargetPower)` aimed at the creature), the mandatory toughness one (`GainLifeEffect(
SourceToughness)` with the entering creature as the entry's source), the "another creature enters" life gain evaluated
as it triggered (`GainLifeEffect(amount)`), Wild Pair's `SearchLibraryForCreatureWithSameTotalPowerToughnessEffect(power,
toughness)`, Hamletback Goliath's `PutCountersOnSelfEffect(…, ChosenPermanentPower)`, Quickbeast Amulet's
`IntensifySourceCardByAmountEffect(ChosenPermanentPower)`, Cream of the Crop's `LookAtTopCardsEffect(TargetPower, …)`;
`EtbEffectResolver`'s own-enters `GainLifeEqualToToughnessEffect` → `GainLifeEffect(SourceToughness)` and
`TriggerCollectionService`'s damaged-creature death `GainLifeEffect(lastKnownToughness)` (the same class, so they go with
it); `LandTapTriggerCollectorService`'s `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(damage, TARGET_PLAYER)` (queued and, inside a triggered
mana ability, resolved at once), Sanctimony's `MayEffect(GainLifeEffect(n))` and Vorinclex's `SkipNextUntapEffect(
TRIGGERING)`.

**When the value is read.** "That creature's power / toughness", "the same total power and toughness" and "it doesn't
have the same name as another creature you control" need information from a specific object, so they are read as the
ability resolves: the creature's current information while it is on the battlefield, else its last known information
(CR 608.2h, checked). The rulings (checked with `get_rulings`) agree: Hamletback Goliath ("The value of X is determined as
the ability begins resolving. If the other creature is no longer on the battlefield, its last known existence on the
battlefield is checked"), Wild Pair (power and toughness "as it exists on the battlefield … might also have been affected
while the triggered ability was on the stack"; "use the power and toughness of that creature as it last appeared"),
Pantlaza and Ikra Shidiqi (the two other `TriggeringPermanentToughness` readers whose creature can still be on the
battlefield: "determined as … resolves"). Guardian Project's and Wild Pair's conditions follow the trigger condition, so
they are intervening "if"s (CR 603.4, checked), judged as the creature enters and again as the ability resolves; Guardian
Project's rulings: "checked both as that creature enters and as Guardian Project's ability resolves", a creature that died
in response is "a creature card in your graveyard that shares a name", one that left and returned "a new creature you
control that shares a name". Optional abilities still go on the stack and ask as they resolve (CR 603.5, checked). The
land-tap damage of a triggered mana ability (Overabundance, Barbflare Gremlin) still resolves at once (CR 605.4a,
checked).

**The model.**

- `TriggeringPermanentPower` and `TriggeringPermanentToughness` read the stack entry's triggering permanent as the ability
  resolves: its current power or toughness while it is on the battlefield (0 for a noncreature), else the value the
  collector recorded as the ability triggered (a dying creature's last-known one), else its departure snapshot. Before,
  `TriggeringPermanentPower` read only the recorded value and `TriggeringPermanentToughness` the recorded value before the
  live one. No card read them for a creature still on the battlefield with a recorded value: the death collectors record
  them for a creature that is gone, Pantlaza's "you may" binds the creature as the entry's target, which the toughness
  reads first, and the combat and face-up collectors (Ikra Shidiqi, Hamza) record none.
- Guardian Project: `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(new TriggeringPermanentMatches(new PermanentNotPredicate(new
  PermanentSharesNameWithControlledCreatureOrGraveyardCreaturePredicate())))` with the existing `DrawCardEffect`; the
  condition judges the creature as it last existed if it has left (`departedPermanentSnapshots`), and the predicate's
  graveyard check finds its own card if it died. `DrawCardIfEnteringCreatureHasUniqueNameEffect`, its handler and the
  collector's handler with its trigger-time name check are gone.
- "You gain life equal to its / that creature's toughness" is `GainLifeEffect(new TriggeringPermanentToughness())`
  (Angelic Chorus, Trostani, Selesnya's Voice, Righteous Valkyrie, Wolverine Riders, Verdant Sun's Avatar, Orchard
  Warden in its `MayEffect`, Abattoir Ghoul), "… power" `GainLifeEffect(new TriggeringPermanentPower())` (Archon of
  Redemption's `MayEffect`). The enter collectors queue them as written: the default one already records the entering
  creature (`enqueue`), and `handleEnterMay` now records it (triggering permanent and card, power and toughness as it
  triggered) on every "you may" whose creature is on the battlefield, not only on one whose effect binds it as its target.
  Verdant Sun's Avatar's two trigger conditions (`enters(THIS)` and `enters(CREATURE, ANOTHER_YOU_CONTROL)`) are one
  `enters(CREATURE, THIS_OR_ANOTHER_YOU_CONTROL)`, Archon of Redemption's form, so its own entry is the same ability
  through the same collector. The damaged-creature death collector records the dying creature as the entry's triggering
  permanent snapshot with its last-known toughness. `GainLifeEqualToToughnessEffect`, `GainLifeEqualToPowerEffect`, the
  collector's handler, `EtbEffectResolver`'s registration and `materializeDamagedCreatureDiesEffect` are gone.
- Hamletback Goliath: `MayEffect(PutCountersOnSelfEffect(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, new TriggeringPermanentPower()))`; Quickbeast
  Amulet: `IntensifySourceCardByAmountEffect(new TriggeringPermanentPower())`; Cream of the Crop:
  `MayEffect(LookAtTopCardsEffect.putOneOnTopRestOnBottom(new TriggeringPermanentPower()))` (the factory gained a
  `DynamicAmount` overload). `PutCountersOnSourceEqualToEnteringPowerEffect`, `IntensifySourceByEnteringPowerEffect`,
  `LookAtTopCardsEqualToEnteringPowerPutOneOnTopRestOnBottomEffect` and their three collector handlers are gone.
- Wild Pair: `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(new TriggeringPermanentMatches(new PermanentAllOfPredicate(
  PermanentCastFromZonePredicate(HAND), PermanentCastBySourceControllerThisTurnPredicate())))` and the card's own
  `MayEffect` around `SearchLibraryForCreatureWithSameTotalPowerToughnessEffect()`, which lost its two fields; its handler
  reads the triggering permanent's power plus toughness as it resolves (live, else the departure's, else the recorded
  values). The collector's handler, with its cast-from-hand gate and rebuild, is gone.
- The "another creature enters" `GainLifeEffect` handler (Soul Warden, Essence Warden), which evaluated the amount as the
  ability triggered and queued a new `GainLifeEffect(amount)`, is gone: the default collector queues the effect as written.
- Land tap: `DealDamageOnLandTapEffect`, `GainLifeWhenOpponentTapsLandOfSubtypeEffect` and
  `OpponentTappedLandDoesntUntapEffect` stay trigger-condition records judged by class (their land filter, "an opponent"
  and the subtype aren't trigger filters the land-tap reader judges) and name the effect that goes on the stack,
  `triggeredEffect()`, as run 17x2's records do: `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(damage, TRIGGERING_PLAYER)` (the tapping
  player the entry's non-targeting player and triggering player), `MayEffect(GainLifeEffect(lifeAmount))`,
  `SkipNextUntapEffect(TapUntapScope.TRIGGERING)`. Each entry records the tapping player and the tapped land.
- `EnterTriggerCollectorService` lost its `AmountEvaluationService` dependency (nothing evaluates an amount as an ability
  triggers any more).

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17x3-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 13 card classes: Guardian
Project, Angelic Chorus, Abattoir Ghoul, Archon of Redemption, Cream of the Crop, Hamletback Goliath, Orchard Warden,

#### Run 17x3b: the enter family's "it / that creature" reads the stack entry's triggering permanent

Row 17x3b, split into 17x3b and 17x3c. The row's sites, re-checked by reading `EnterTriggerCollectorService`: nine
class-keyed handlers rewrote a marker into an effect aimed at the entering permanent as the entry's `targetId` (or bound
the permanent into the effect): Amulet of Vigor's `UntapEnteringPermanentEffect` (→ `UntapPermanentsEffect(TARGET)`
with a trigger-time tapped and controller check), Unstable Shapeshifter's `BecomeCopyOfEnteringCreatureEffect(
enteringPermanentId, entering)`, Renegade Doppelganger's and Sarkhan's `BecomeCopyOfEnteringCreatureUntilEndOfTurnEffect`
(→ `MayEffect(BecomeCopyOfTargetCreatureUntilEndOfTurnEffect)` aimed at the creature), Vildin-Pack Alpha's
`TransformEnteringCreatureEffect`, the ten `PutCountersOnEnteringCreatureEffect` cards (→ `PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect`
aimed at the creature, a `ConditionalEffect(TargetPermanentMatches)` for Ichorplate Golem, follow-ups spliced in), the
eight `BoostEnteringCreatureEffect` cards (→ `BoostTargetCreatureEffect` + `GrantKeywordEffect(TARGET)`), the sixteen
`AttachSourceEquipmentToEnteringCreatureEffect` and three `AttachSourceAuraToEnteringCreatureEffect` cards (→ the
`…ToTargetCreatureEffect` attach, a "you may" built by the collector), and the "another creature" / opponent-land
`DealDamageToPlayersEffect(…, TARGET_PLAYER)` rewrite. The "it" bindings the row did not name (`handleEnterMay`'s
`usesEnteringPermanentReference()` binding of twelve effects, and eight single-effect handlers that make the entering
permanent the entry's `targetId` or source) are row 17x3c (new): each needs its own effect's handler moved onto the
triggering permanent.

**When the value is read.** "It" / "that creature" is the permanent the trigger event was about, so it is the stack
entry's triggering permanent, which every enter collector already records, and the effect reads it as the ability
resolves: the permanent where it is then (a creature that changed control in response still gets the counters, the
pump, the Aura), nothing if it has left (counters, pump, untap, transform, attach), except a copy, which copies it as it
last existed on the battlefield (CR 608.2h and CR 707.2, checked; Renegade Doppelganger's ruling, checked with
`get_rulings`: "it can become a copy of that creature when the ability resolves even if that creature has left the
battlefield by then. If it has, its last existence on the battlefield is checked"; Unstable Shapeshifter's: "The copy
effect is not targeted"; Prison Term's: "works only if Prison Term is already on the battlefield"). None of these
abilities targets, so none can fizzle on "it". "A permanent you control enters tapped" is part of the trigger event, a
status the permanent has as it enters (Amulet of Vigor's rulings: "If it enters untapped, the ability won't trigger, even
if you tap that permanent afterward"), so it is the trigger's filter, judged on the permanent as it entered (CR 603.6a,
checked). Ichorplate Golem's "if it has one or more oil counters on it" follows the trigger condition, an intervening
"if" (CR 603.4, checked). Optional abilities go on the stack and ask as they resolve (CR 603.5, checked).

**The model.**

- "Put N counters on it / that creature" is `PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect.onTriggeringPermanent(counterType,
  amount)` (new factory), the existing predicate form with `PermanentIsTriggeringPermanentPredicate`, whose handler
  places the counters on the entry's triggering permanent through the same path as a target: the count evaluated
  against the source, the counter-replacement order offered (CR 616.1, checked), which `PutCounterOnReferencedPermanent
  Effect` would not do. "And it gains haste until end of turn" is a `SequenceEffect.of(…, new GrantKeywordEffect(HASTE,
  GrantScope.TRIGGERING_PERMANENT))` (Wartime Protestors, Surrak and Goreclaw), Mighty Emergence's "you may" a
  `MayEffect`, Railway Brawler's "X is its power" `TriggeringPermanentPower` (its ruling: "determined as … resolves"),
  Ichorplate Golem the intervening "if" `TriggeringPermanentMatches(PermanentHasCountersPredicate(OIL))` on a plain
  creature filter (before: the filter and a resolution `ConditionalEffect`).
- "That creature gets +X/+Y [and gains haste] until end of turn" is `BoostReferencedPermanentEffect(PermanentReference.
  TRIGGERING, X, Y)` and `GrantKeywordEffect(keywords, GrantScope.TRIGGERING_PERMANENT[, duration])` in one
  `SequenceEffect` (Ogre Battledriver, In the Web of War, Enduring Courage, Alex Wilder), the boost alone (Primal
  Forcemage), the grant alone (Rapid Augmenter, Dragon Tempest; Chainer's `UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN`). The grant stays the
  layer-6 floating effect the targeted form made; `BoostReferencedPermanentEffectHandler` now refreshes the
  last-known source snapshot of the boosted permanent's own stack entries, as `BoostTargetCreatureEffectHandler` does.
- Amulet of Vigor: `Triggers.enters(new PermanentIsTappedPredicate(), ObjectRelation.YOU_CONTROL)` with
  `UntapPermanentsEffect(TapUntapScope.TRIGGERING)`; the any-permanent default collector records the entering permanent.
- Vildin-Pack Alpha: `MayEffect(TransformTargetPermanentEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent(), "Transform it?")`;
  `TransformTargetPermanentEffect` gained `triggeringPermanent` (no target when set).
- The Equipment: `MayEffect(AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect.forTriggeringCreature(), "Attach this Equipment
  to it?")`, Ronin Warclub the bare form (the factory existed, Ancestral Katana's). The Auras: `MayEffect(
  AttachSourceAuraToTargetCreatureEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent(), "Attach this Aura to that creature?")`, Illusory Gains
  the bare form; `AttachSourceAuraToTargetCreatureEffect` gained `triggeringPermanent`.
- Renegade Doppelganger, Sarkhan: `MayEffect(new BecomeCopyOfTargetCreatureUntilEndOfTurnEffect([name, supertypes])
  .ofTriggeringPermanent(), …)`; the record gained `triggeringPermanent` (a ten-component canonical constructor, the old
  nine-component one kept), and its handler copies the triggering permanent, else its departure snapshot, else the
  entry's triggering card snapshot.
- Unstable Shapeshifter: `BecomeCopyOfEnteringCreatureEffect()` lost its two fields; its handler copies the triggering
  permanent (else its departure snapshot, else the entry's snapshot of it) onto the entry's source permanent (before:
  the source rode as the entry's `targetId`). The card is unchanged.
- The enter collectors put all of these on the stack as written: the default ones record the entering permanent
  (`enqueue`, `handleEnterMay`). `handleEnterMay` marks a "you may" with no target non-targeting (the opponent scans set
  its `targetId` to the entering creature's controller). The "enters from your graveyard" default
  (`handleCreatureEnterFromGraveyardDefault`, Dredging Claw) queues a non-targeting ability through `enqueue` instead of
  always asking for a target.
- The damage rewrite: its two cards' recipient was already `TARGET_PLAYER` (Invader Parasite; Tunnel Ignus reached the
  default collector through its intervening "if") and the others' `TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER` (Rampaging
  Ferocidon, Ankh of Mishra, Zo-Zu), which the handler kept, so it was an identity: the opponent-land default collector
  gives "that player" as the non-targeting player and the any-creature one records the creature.
- Gone: `UntapEnteringPermanentEffect`, `TransformEnteringCreatureEffect`, `PutCountersOnEnteringCreatureEffect`,
  `BoostEnteringCreatureEffect`, `AttachSourceAuraToEnteringCreatureEffect`, `AttachSourceEquipmentToEnteringCreatureEffect`,
  `BecomeCopyOfEnteringCreatureUntilEndOfTurnEffect`, and the nine class-keyed handlers of `EnterTriggerCollectorService`
  that read them (`handleAnyPermanentEnterUntapEntering`, `handleDealDamageToEnteringController`,
  `handleAnyCreatureBecomeCopyOfEntering`, `handleAllyBecomeCopyOfEnteringUntilEndOfTurn`, `handleAllyTransformEntering`,
  `handleAllyPutCountersOnEntering`, `handleAllyBoostEntering`, `handleCreatureAttachEquipment`, `handleCreatureAttachAura`).

#### Run 17x3c: the enter family's last "it" bindings read the stack entry's triggering permanent

Row 17x3c, done in one run. The row's sites, re-checked by reading the collectors: `CardEffect.usesEnteringPermanentReference()`
was bound in five places (`EnterTriggerCollectorService.handleEnterMay`, which made the entering permanent a "you may"'s
`targetId`; `handleEnterMayPay`, which gave Cadric's copy an attached-permanent snapshot; `TriggerCollectionService`'s two
graveyard enter paths, which made it the entry's `targetId`; `MayAbilityHandlerService`'s pending-may accept path), for twelve
effects (`CreateTokenCopyOfEnteringPermanentEffect`, `DiscardCardThenEffect` through its then-effect, `DiscoverEffect` with
`TriggeringPermanentToughness`, `DrawDiscardAndConniveEffect.forEnteringPermanent()`, `GrantSubtypeToTriggeringPermanentEffect`,
`ManaEchoesEffect`, the two move-counter effects, `PutCountersOnEnteringCreatureEqualToSourceCountersEffect`,
`ReturnSourceFromGraveyardAttachedToEnteringCreatureEffect`, `SetSelfBasePowerToAmountUntilEndOfTurnEffect` with `TargetPower`,
`SetSelfBasePowerToughnessFromEnteringCreatureEffect`); and ten class-keyed handlers of the enter collector made the entering
permanent the entry's `targetId` or source: endure, `handleEnteringPermanentSelfEffect` (Kolodin's saddle and vehicle), graft's and
Agent's Toolkit's pending may abilities (asked before the ability went on the stack), Aether Flash's damage, Marauding Raptor's
damage-then-boost, Madame Null's pay-life counters, Tribute to the World Tree's and Shelinda's power branches, soulbond.

**When the value is read.** "It" / "that creature" is the permanent the trigger event was about, the stack entry's triggering
permanent, read as the ability resolves: where it is then (counters, damage, pairing, saddling, connive, attach), nothing if it
has left, and its last-known information where the effect needs information from it (CR 608.2h, checked): Mana Echoes' creature
types, Eldrazi Mimic's and Belligerent Yearling's power and toughness, Pantlaza's "that creature's toughness", Madame Null's and the
branches' powers, a token copy's copiable values. Graft is "Whenever another creature enters, if this permanent has a +1/+1 counter
on it, you may move a +1/+1 counter from this permanent onto that creature" (CR 702.58a, checked): the counter is an intervening
"if" (CR 603.4, checked), checked as it triggers and again as it resolves, and the optional ability goes on the stack and its
controller chooses as it resolves (CR 603.5, checked); Agent's Toolkit's "you may move a counter" likewise. Soulbond's other half is
"Whenever another creature you control enters, if you control both that creature and this one and both are unpaired, you may pair
that creature with this creature" (CR 702.95a, checked); neither pairs if either is no longer a creature you control as it
resolves (CR 702.95c, checked). "This deals N damage to it" is damage from the source to that creature, which protection from the
source prevents (CR 702.16e, checked). Endure: "that permanent's controller creates an N/N white Spirit creature token unless they
put N +1/+1 counters on that permanent" (CR 701.63a, checked).

**The model.**

- `CardEffect.usesEnteringPermanentReference()`, its `MayEffect` / `ConditionalEffect` / `DiscardCardThenEffect` forwards, its
  twelve overrides and its five bindings are gone. `handleEnterMay` puts a "you may" on the stack with no target (non-targeting
  unless it targets), recording the entering permanent as the triggering permanent (with its card, power and toughness) while it is
  on the battlefield and the entering card's snapshot always (Mana Echoes' "as it entered" fallback). The graveyard enter paths
  record the entering permanent as the triggering permanent of every ability (`recordEnteringPermanent`), and Theoretical
  Duplication's until-end-of-turn watcher records it on its entry.
- The handlers read `StackEntry.getTriggeringPermanentId()`, not `getTargetId()`: Mana Echoes (else `triggeringPermanentLastKnownCard`,
  the remembered last-known card, the entering card's snapshot), both move-counter effects, Denry Klin's, the graveyard
  return-attached, Eldrazi Mimic's, `CreateTokenCopyOfEnteringPermanentEffect` (no `targetId` fallback), connive
  (`DrawDiscardAndConniveEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent()`, the component `triggeringPermanent`, replacing `forEnteringPermanent()` and
  `useEnteringPermanentReference`), endure's `TRIGGERING_PERMANENT` (its counter option `PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect
  .onTriggeringPermanent`), `BecomeSaddledUntilEndOfTurnEffect(GrantScope.TRIGGERING_PERMANENT)` (a new scope branch; `SELF` no longer
  falls back to the target), Madame Null's (`onTriggeringPermanent` counters, as many as the life paid), Tribute to the World Tree's
  power branch (last-known power from the entry or the departure), Shelinda's (each creature's last-known power from its departure
  snapshot first), soulbond's pairing.
- `TriggeringPermanentPower` gained `allowNegative` (`new TriggeringPermanentPower(true)`, `TargetPower(true)`'s form): Belligerent
  Yearling's "base power becomes equal to that creature's power" keeps a negative power. `TriggeringPermanentToughness` no longer
  reads the ability's target first (only Pantlaza's bound target used it).
- Graft (13 cards): `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(new SourceCounterThreshold(1, PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE))` and `new MayEffect(
  new MoveCounterFromSourceToEnteringCreatureEffect(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE), "Move a +1/+1 counter onto that creature?")`, Gatewatch
  Beacon's form. Agent's Toolkit: `MayEffect(MoveChosenCounterFromSourceToEnteringCreatureEffect(…))`.
- Soulbond's other half (25 cards): `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(new AllConditions(List.of(new NotCondition(new
  SourceIsPaired()), new TriggeringPermanentMatches(new PermanentAllOfPredicate(List.of(new
  PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate(), new PermanentNotPredicate(new PermanentIsPairedPredicate())))))))` and `new
  MayEffect(new SoulbondPairWithEnteringEffect(), "Pair X with that creature?")`. `PermanentIsPairedPredicate` is new (a permanent
  with a soulbond partner; both `PredicateEvaluationService` switches).
- `DealDamageToTriggeringAttackerEffect` is `DealDamageToTriggeringPermanentEffect` (renamed: it never read anything but the
  triggering permanent), which Aether Flash now uses; its handler checks `DamageSupport.isDamagePreventedForCreature` (protection
  from the source, "prevent all damage it would deal") as a targeted creature's damage does. Marauding Raptor's
  `DealDamageToTargetCreatureThenBoostSourceIfDamagedEffect` is `DealDamageToTriggeringPermanentThenBoostSourceIfDamagedEffect` (no
  `targetSpec()`, reads the triggering permanent).
- The default enter collectors put all of these on the stack as written (`enqueue` records the entering permanent, its controller,
  power and toughness and a source snapshot). Gone from `EnterTriggerCollectorService`: `handleAllyNontokenCreatureEndure`,
  `handleEnteringPermanentSelfEffect`, `handleAnyCreatureMoveCounterToEntering`, `handleAllyCreatureMoveChosenCounterToEntering`,
  `handleAnyCreatureDealDamageToEntering`, `handleAllyCreatureDealDamageThenBoost`,
  `handleAllyMayPayLifeAndPutCountersOnEnteringCreature`, `handleAllyEnteringCreaturePowerBranch`,
  `handleAllyEnteringCreatureSourcePowerBranch`, `handleAllySoulbondPairWithEntering`.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17x3c-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 52 card classes: the 13 graft cards (Vigean
Hydropon, Vigean Graftmage, Sporeback Troll, Simic Basilisk, Plaxcaster Frogling, Novijen Sages, Llanowar Reborn, Helium Squirter,

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix (CR 603.5): graft's and Agent's Toolkit's abilities go on the stack and ask as they resolve; before, the choice was

#### Run 17x4: the life, emblem, step and vote families read the stack entry

Row 17x4, done in one run. The row's sites, re-checked by reading the collectors (16): `MiscTriggerCollectorService`
rebuilt seven effects with event data bound in (Mindcrank's and The Master of Lake-town's `MillOpponentOnLifeLossEffect`
into `MillEffect(lifeLost, TARGET_PLAYER)`; Relic Putrescence's `GivePoisonCountersEffect(…, ENCHANTED_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)`
into a `TARGET_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER` copy aimed at the tapped artifact; Lorcan, Warlock Collector's `MayPayLifeEffect(0, …)`
with the card's mana value; Firesong and Sunspeaker's `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(damage)`; Cradle of Vitality's
`MayPayManaEffect(…, PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect(…, Fixed(lifeGained)))`; Nykthos Paragon's `MayEffect(…,
Fixed(lifeGained))`; Lich's Mastery's and Marina Vendrell's Grimoire's `DrawCardsEqualToLifeGainedEffect` into
`DrawCardEffect(EventValue)` with the value set), the emblem markers read by class (`DrawService`'s
`EmblemControllerLosesLifeOnAnyPlayerDrawEffect` into `LoseLifeEffect(amount, CONTROLLER)`; the cast collector's Jace,
Telepath Unbound `MillEffect` branch and `DealDamageToAnyTargetOnControllerSpellCastEffect` into
`DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(damage)` plus its additional effects), `LoyaltyCounterTriggerCollectorService`'s
`DealDamageToTargetPlayerOrPlaneswalkerEffect(removed, …)` (Chandra, Fire Artisan, whose card already wrote `EventValue`),
`VotingFinishedTriggerCollectorService`'s two `…Effect(result)` snapshots, Goblin Morale Sergeant's
`ConjureDuplicateOfEnlistedCreatureIntoTopFiveEffect(snapshot)`, and `StepTriggerService`'s two enchanted-player bakes
(Curse of Oblivion's `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect(…, enchantedPlayerId)`, Curse of Surveillance's
`EachTargetPlayerDrawsCardsEqualToAttachedCountEffect(filter, enchantedPlayerId)`).

**When the value is read.** "That many" (the life lost or gained, the loyalty counters removed) is the event's value,
fixed as the ability triggers: the entry's event value, which `EventValue` reads as the ability resolves (Cradle of
Vitality's ruling, checked with `get_rulings`: "the targeted creature will get a number of counters equal to the amount of
life you gained"). "That player" is the player the event was about (the player who lost life, the enchanted player whose
upkeep it is): the entry's non-targeting `targetId`, or its triggering player where the entry's targets are chosen
players (Curse of Surveillance's "other than that player"). "Its mana value" (Lorcan) is the card the event was about, as
it was in the event; "its controller" (Relic Putrescence) the tapped artifact's controller as the ability resolves, else as
it last existed (CR 608.2h, checked); "that creature" (Goblin Morale Sergeant's enlisted creature, CR 702.154a, checked)
the triggering permanent where it is, else as it last existed; the vote (Erestor of the Council, Model of Unity) as the
players finished it. "You may" abilities go on the stack and ask as they resolve (CR 603.5, checked); Nykthos Paragon's
"do this only once each turn" is used up as it is accepted (CR 603.2h, checked; its rulings: "If multiple instances of the
ability are on the stack, you will be able to put +1/+1 counters for only one of those instances"). Abilities of emblems
function in the command zone (CR 114.4, checked).

**The model.**

- Life loss: "that player mills that many cards" is `MillEffect(new EventValue(), MillRecipient.TRIGGERING_PLAYER)` (new
  recipient: the entry's non-targeting `targetId`, not a chosen target). The life-loss collector, now keyed by
  `MillEffect` on both the opponent and the controller life-loss watches, puts it on the stack as written with the player
  who lost life as "that player" and the life lost as the event value. `MillOpponentOnLifeLossEffect` is gone.
- Relic Putrescence: `GivePoisonCountersEffect(1, PoisonRecipient.TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)` on the stack as
  written (the tap collector already recorded the tapped permanent and its controller). `PoisonRecipient
  .ENCHANTED_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER` and `GivePoisonCountersEffect.affectedPlayerId`, which nothing set, are gone.
- Lorcan: `MayPayLifeEqualToAmountEffect(new TriggeringCardManaValue(), …)`; `TriggeringCardManaValue` is a new amount
  (the entry's triggering card as it was in the event, else where it is). The "creature card put into an opponent's
  graveyard" default collector gives every entry the card with its graveyard incarnation (CR 400.7, checked) and marks a
  non-targeting ability so; the class-keyed `MayPayLifeEffect` handler is gone.
- Life gain: the `DrawCardEffect` collector sets the life gained as the event value (Lich's Mastery's and Marina
  Vendrell's Grimoire's "draw that many" is `DrawCardEffect(new EventValue())`; `DrawCardsEqualToLifeGainedEffect` and its
  handler gone). The `MayEffect` collector (`LifeGainTriggerCollectorService.handleLifeGainMay`) puts the "you may" on
  the stack with the life gained and the limit's acceptance mark: Nykthos Paragon is `MayEffect(new
  PutCounterOnEachControlledPermanentEffect(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, new EventValue(), creature))` with its
  `DO_ONLY_ONCE_EACH_TURN` (`NykthosParagonLifeGainEffect` and its handler gone). The `MayPayManaEffect` collector carries
  the life gained into the entry, and into its target choice (`LifeGainTriggerAnyTarget.eventValue`), and a "you may
  pay" whose effect targets no player offers creatures: Cradle of Vitality is `MayPayManaEffect("{1}{W}",
  PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect.withTargetRestriction(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, new EventValue(), creature), …)` (a new
  `DynamicAmount` overload of the factory; `CradleOfVitalityLifeGainEffect` and its handler gone). The second, identical
  `MayPayManaEffect` life-gain handler in `MiscTriggerCollectorService` (registered for the same watch and class; the
  registry kept whichever bean it scanned last) is gone. Firesong and Sunspeaker's trigger-condition record names its
  `triggeredEffect()` (17x2's form).
- Emblems: Ob Nixilis Reignited's emblem is `CreateEmblemEffect(List.of(), text, TARGET_PLAYER, List.of(), List.of(new
  TriggeredAbility(Triggers.playerDrawsCard(), new LoseLifeEffect(2, CONTROLLER))))` (`Triggers.playerDrawsCard()` new,
  read only from an emblem); `DrawService.checkEmblemDrawTriggers` reads each emblem's draw abilities (any, you,
  opponent), puts each on the stack as one object with the drawing player as its triggering player, and throws on a
  filter, count, option or target it doesn't judge. Jace, Telepath Unbound's emblem is `new TriggeredAbility(
  Triggers.youCastSpell(), new MillEffect(5, TARGET_PLAYER)).withTargetFilter(opponent)`; Ral, Izzet Viceroy's, Narset of
  the Ancient Way's and Chandra, Torch of Defiance's are filtered cast triggers with `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect` (Ral's
  with `DrawCardEffect(2)` in the same ability), all read by the generic cast collector (run 17h's
  `collectEmblemCastAbilities`). `EmblemControllerLosesLifeOnAnyPlayerDrawEffect`,
  `DealDamageToAnyTargetOnControllerSpellCastEffect` and the cast loop's two branches are gone.
- Chandra, Fire Artisan: the loyalty collector queues the card's own effect, the counters removed as the choice's event
  value: `SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget` gained `eventValue` (`withEventValue(int)`; its 22-component constructor kept),
  which the entries it makes take as their event value.
- Voting: `StackEntry.triggeringVotingResult` (new, an immutable `VotingResult`, copied by the copy constructor and so by
  simulation copies); one default collector for "whenever players finish voting" puts the card's effect on the stack as
  written with the vote. `ErestorOfTheCouncilEffect` and `ModelOfUnityEffect` are fieldless; the two class-keyed handlers
  are gone.
- Goblin Morale Sergeant: `ConjureDuplicateOfEnlistedNontokenCreatureEffect.triggeredEffect()` is `MayEffect(new
  ConjureDuplicateOfEnlistedCreatureIntoTopFiveEffect())` (fieldless); the entry records the enlisted creature as its
  triggering permanent, which the handler duplicates (live, else its snapshot).
- Curses: Curse of Oblivion is `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect(2, GraveyardExileScope.TRIGGERING_PLAYER)` (new scope: "that
  player exiles N cards from their graveyard", the entry's non-targeting `targetId`); Curse of Surveillance's effect

#### Run 17x5: the departed source's links and the crew, untap and life-gain rebuilds read the stack entry

Row 17x5, split into 17x5 and 17x5b. The row's sites, re-checked by reading the collectors (16 done here):
`LegacyTriggerBindings` rebuilt twelve effects as they triggered: eleven "when this leaves the battlefield" handlers
(`ReturnLinkedCardToOwnerGraveyardEffect(linked card id)`, an identity rebuild of
`ReturnAllCardsExiledWithSourceToOwnerGraveyardEffect`, `ControllerLosesGameOnLeavesEffect` into
`TargetPlayerLosesGameEffect(controller)`, `RemoveLinkedPermanentEffect(mode, linked id, linked card id)`,
`DestroyTokensCreatedWithSourceEffect(…, source id)`, `ExileTokensCreatedWithSourceEffect(source id, …)`,
`MayCastCardsExiledWithSourceEffect(source id)`, `SacrificeEnchantedCreatureOnLeaveEffect(host id)`,
`DestroyEnchantedCreatureOnLeaveEffect(host id, …)`, `CreateTokenForImprintedCardOwnerEffect` with its power and
toughness frozen, `CreateTokensForExiledCardsWithSourceEffect(…, source id)`) and one death handler (Vodalian War
Machine's `DestroyMerfolkTappedForSourceAbilitiesEffect` into a `DestroyAllPermanentsEffect` over the snapshotted ids);
`MiscTriggerCollectorService` rebuilt Tiana, Angelic Mechanic's `PerpetuallyBoostCardEffect(vehicle card, …)` on crew,
and on untap Coffin Queen's `RemoveLinkedPermanentEffect(mode, chosen id, null)` and Tawnos's Coffin's
`ReturnCardsExiledWithSourceOnUntapEffect(card ids)`; `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect.affectedPlayerId` had no writer since
run 17x4. The rest of the row is split off: the copy-an-activated-ability `MayPayManaEffect` rebuilds are row 17x5b (13
cards whose ten record conditions need `AbilityTrigger` filters, a run of its own), and the tap-and-skip and
destroy-at-end-of-combat records went to row 17y with the rest of the damage family's trigger-condition records: their
effects carry no event data (the damaged creature is the entry's non-targeting target, which run 17u judged an entry
binding, not a rewrite), so what is left of them is the class-keyed record, as for the family's other records.

**When the value is read.** A leaves-the-battlefield ability looks back in time (CR 603.10a, checked): "the token",
"that creature", "the exiled card", "tokens created with this" are what the source was linked to as it last existed on
the battlefield, which its stack entry keeps as its source snapshot (`StackEntry.getSourcePermanentSnapshot()`, the
source's chosen permanent and host) and its source permanent id (the cards exiled and tokens created with it, CR 607.2a,
checked). The effects read them as they resolve; the objects they name are found where they are then (CR 608.2h,
checked). None of these abilities has an intervening "if" (CR 603.4, checked), so each triggers whether or not anything
is linked: Skyclave Apparition's ruling, checked with `get_rulings`, "If there's no exiled card when Skyclave Apparition
leaves the battlefield (most likely because its first ability hasn't resolved yet), no player creates a token". "That
Vehicle perpetually gets +1/+0" (Tiana, checked with `get_card`) is the crewed Vehicle, the entry's triggering permanent,
whose card as it was then gets the modifier. Tawnos's Coffin's "return that exiled card" is the card its linked ability
exiled as the ability triggered (the entry's triggering cards).

**Firesong and Sunspeaker.** Its Oracle text (checked with `get_card`, DOM 280) is "Whenever a white instant or sorcery
spell causes you to gain life, Firesong and Sunspeaker deals 3 damage to target creature or player." Run 17x4's record
put `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect` on the stack and the life-gain target choice offered planeswalkers and battles, which
"any target" adds (CR 115.4, checked) and "target creature or player" doesn't: a rules fix.

**The model.**

- The leave handlers above are gone from `LegacyTriggerBindings`: its default leave handler puts each effect on the stack
  as the card wrote it, with the source's id, its snapshot as it last existed and the triggering permanent. The
  handlers read the entry: `ReturnLinkedCardToOwnerGraveyardEffect` (now fieldless) the snapshot's chosen permanent;
  `RemoveLinkedPermanentEffect` the live source's link, else the snapshot's (its `linkedCardId` component, read by
  nothing, is gone; `linkedPermanentId` stays for Coffin Queen's engine-built "when you lose control" delayed trigger);
  `DestroyTokensCreatedWithSourceEffect`, `MayCastCardsExiledWithSourceEffect` and
  `CreateTokensForExiledCardsWithSourceEffect` (their source-id components gone) and `ExileTokensCreatedWithSourceEffect`
  (its id kept for its delayed end-step form and the token-copy handlers' entries) the entry's source permanent;
  `SacrificeEnchantedCreatureOnLeaveEffect` (fieldless) the snapshot's host, else its chosen permanent;
  `DestroyEnchantedCreatureOnLeaveEffect` (now `(boolean cannotBeRegenerated)`) the snapshot's host;
  `CreateTokenForImprintedCardOwnerEffect` its power and toughness against the snapshot (its handler already did). The
  `RemoveLinkedPermanentEffect` leave handler stays only to give a `SACRIFICE_PARTNER` ability the partner's controller
  and to decline an ability whose bond was never forged; it puts the effect on the stack as written.
- "You lose the game" when the source leaves (Lich's Mastery, Lich's Duel Mastery, Nine Lives, Nefarious Lich) is the
  existing `ControllerLosesGameEffect`; `ControllerLosesGameOnLeavesEffect` is gone.
- Vodalian War Machine: `DestroyAllPermanentsEffect(new PermanentAllOfPredicate(List.of(merfolk, new
  PermanentTappedForSourceAbilitiesThisTurnPredicate())))`. The predicate is new (the source's
  `getTappedPermanentsForAbilityThisTurn()`: the source on the battlefield, else the filter context's source snapshot;
  both `PredicateEvaluationService` switches); `DestroyMerfolkTappedForSourceAbilitiesEffect` and its death handler are
  gone.
- Tiana: `PerpetuallyBoostCardEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent(p, t)` (a `null` card: the entry's triggering permanent's card
  as it was then), the trigger-condition record's `triggeredEffect()` (run 17x2's form); the crew collector records the

- Untap: `MiscTriggerCollectorService.handleSelfBecomesUntapped` no longer rebuilds Coffin Queen's removal (the handler

- `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect` lost `affectedPlayerId` (the `OWN` scopes exile from the controller's graveyard; "that
