#### Run 17x5b: the copy-an-activated-ability abilities are activation triggers with filters and `CopyTriggeringSpellOrAbilityEffect`

Row 17x5b, as run 17x5 split it. The two sites, re-checked by reading the collectors:
`TriggerCollectionService.checkControllerActivatesAbilityCopyTriggers` ("whenever you activate an ability", mana
abilities included: Unbound Flourishing, Leori) and `checkControllerActivatesNonManaAbilityTriggers` (the other eleven)
read `CopyControllerActivatedAbilityTriggerEffect` by class, judged its eleven fields (a mana cost, a stack-entry
source filter, "equipped creature only", "loyalty only", a target predicate, "{X} in the cost", "exhaust only", a
source-permanent filter, "life paid", "a permanent sacrificed", "optional") and built
`CopyControllerActivatedAbilityEffect(snapshot, ability, copy controller)`, wrapped in a `MayPayManaEffect`, a
`MayEffect` or a `MayPayLifeEqualToAmountEffect(EventValue)` rebuilt from the fields (the prompt naming the copied
ability's card). `ChoiceHandlerService`'s temporary subtype choice also looked for the record (Leori's delayed copy).
The thirteen cards: Rings of Brighthearth, Kurkesh, Onakke Ancient, Illusionist's Bracers, Battlemage's Bracers,
Chandra's Regulator, Rowan's Talent, Sala, Deck Boss, Ertha Jo, Frontier Mentor, Leori, Sparktouched Hunter, Unbound
Flourishing, Locus of Enlightenment (The Enigma Jewel's back face), Verrak, Warped Sengir and Ashnod the Uncaring.
`CopyControllerActivatedAbilityEffect` itself stays: the engine builds it for the delayed and mana-linked copies (the
next loyalty, exhaust or {X} ability this turn, a chosen planeswalker type's delayed copy, Sunken Palace's mana),
Ulalek's `CopyControllerAllSpellsAndAbilitiesEffectHandler`, and `CopyTriggeringSpellOrAbilityEffectHandler` resolves
through its handler; no card names it.

**When the value is read.** Each ability is collected once the activated ability is on the stack (its costs paid,
targets and X chosen: the copy has them, CR 707.10, checked), and its entry keeps that ability's stack entry as its
triggering spell and the `ActivatedAbility` as its triggering activated ability (run 14's Bill Potts fields), which
`CopyTriggeringSpellOrAbilityEffect` copies as it resolves for the ability's controller. The conditions are facts of
the activation and are judged as it triggers: the kind, the permanent whose ability it is, the stack entry with its
targets, the life paid and the permanents sacrificed. "If life was paid to activate it" and "if one or more
permanents were sacrificed to activate it" are intervening "if"s (CR 603.4, checked) whose condition can't change,
so the check as it resolves is the same; they are payment filters like the "{X} in its activation cost" of Unbound
Flourishing. The "you may pay {2}" / "you may copy" / "you may pay that much life again" is asked as the ability
resolves (CR 603.5, checked), as before: the old path also put the may-pay effect on the stack; the "that much life"
is the entry's event value, the life paid to activate it. Illusionist's Bracers' ruling (checked with `get_rulings`):
"If Illusionist's Bracers somehow becomes equipped to a creature an opponent controls, and an activated ability … of
that creature is activated, you will control the copy of that ability" (the copy is controlled by the player under
whose control it was put on the stack, CR 707.10): the ability's controller, which `CopyTriggeringSpellOrAbilityEffect`
already uses.

**"An ability of an artifact".** CR 109.2 (checked): a description with a card type that doesn't name a zone or say
"card", "spell" or "source" means a permanent on the battlefield. Kurkesh's "an ability of an artifact" and Ashnod's
"an ability of an artifact or creature" are abilities of such a permanent. The record judged
`StackEntryCardTypeInPredicate` on the ability's stack entry, which falls back to the entry's card's types when the
ability has no source permanent, so cycling an artifact card from the hand (Ketria Crystal) triggered Kurkesh: a rules
fix, now the activation trigger's source filter (`withSource`), judged against the permanent whose ability it is (the
sacrificed source as it last existed, as the activation collectors pass it). Leori's and Chandra's Regulator's
planeswalker filters keep their stack-entry form: loyalty abilities are only activated on the battlefield, so the two
readings agree.

**The model.**

- `AbilityTrigger` gained `payment` (`ActivationPayment.LIFE`, `SACRIFICE`; `withPayment`, part of `unfiltered()`)
  and `AbilityKind` `EXHAUST` (`isExhaustAbility()`) and `WITH_X_IN_COST` (`{X}` in the activation's mana cost). The
  payment, like the stack-entry filter, is judged only by the collectors of the abilities that copy the activated
  ability; `activationEffects` throws for either on any other activation ability, and the mana-abilities-included copy
  collector throws for a payment (no card has one there; the life paid is tracked for the non-mana path).
- `Triggers.playerActivatesNonManaAbility()` (new, `PlayerRelation.ANY`) and its watch
  `SpellAbilityWatch.ON_ANY_PLAYER_ACTIVATES_NONMANA_ABILITY`: "whenever an ability of equipped creature is
  activated", whoever activates it, is this trigger with `withSource(new PermanentIsHostOfSourceAuraPredicate())`
  (the existing predicate, documented for Auras and Equipment). The non-mana collector reads it for every permanent and
  the "you activate" watch only for the activating player's permanents (the record's `equippedCreatureOnly` skipped
  that check by hand).
- Both collectors find the copy through new `copiesTheTriggeringObject(CardEffect)` (`CopyTriggeringSpellOrAbilityEffect`
  alone or behind a `MayEffect` without an else, a `MayPayManaEffect`, a `MayPayLifeEqualToAmountEffect` or a
  `ConditionalEffect`, as run 17b's `copiesThisSpell`), judge the stack-entry filter (`activationStackEntryMatches`,
  from the watcher's point of view) and the payment (`activationPaymentMatches`: life paid, or a sacrificed card id
  or a sacrifice-the-source cost, as the record did), and put the ability's own effects on the stack through
  `enqueueActivationCopyAbility` (one object, CR 603.3, checked; the triggering spell and activated ability; the life
  paid as event value; the limit marked). Bill Potts' branch is this path. `ActivationAbility.copiesTheAbility()` and
  `copyEffect()` are gone.
- `ChoiceHandlerService`'s temporary subtype choice registers Leori's delayed copy when the source has an activation
  ability with `CopyTriggeringSpellOrAbilityEffect` (it looked for the record by `getTriggerEffects` of the unfiltered
  trigger, which a filtered trigger isn't).
- Deleted: `CopyControllerActivatedAbilityTriggerEffect` and the two collector branches that read it by class.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17x5b-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), the 13 card classes:

- Rings of Brighthearth `youActivateNonManaAbility()` + `MayPayManaEffect("{2}", new CopyTriggeringSpellOrAbilityEffect(), …)`;
  Kurkesh `.withSource(new PermanentIsArtifactPredicate())` + `MayPayManaEffect("{R}", …)`;
- Illusionist's Bracers `playerActivatesNonManaAbility().withSource(new PermanentIsHostOfSourceAuraPredicate())` +

- Chandra's Regulator `.withKind(LOYALTY).withStackEntryFilter(planeswalker, Chandra)` + `MayPayManaEffect("{1}", …)`;

  predicates unchanged); Locus of Enlightenment unfiltered;
- Verrak `.withPayment(LIFE)` + `MayPayLifeEqualToAmountEffect(new EventValue(), copy, …)`; Ashnod

#### Follow-up: copied triggered abilities keep the trigger event

**Cause.** Step 15 moved what a trigger event was about off the effects and onto the stack entry (run 2 the departed
permanent's last-known snapshot and attachments, later runs the triggering cards, spell, player, vote, event payloads
and trigger-time facts). The stack entry's copy constructor copies those fields, but a copy of an ability is not built
by it: `CopySupport.createCopyStackEntry` builds a fresh entry, and each copy-an-ability handler then copied by hand
only the four fields it knew before step 15 (triggering permanent id, its controller, triggering card id, event value).
So a copy of a triggered ability (Strionic Resonator, Lithoform Engine, Tawnos, Kirol, Mirror-Shield Hoplite, Mister
Fantastic, Gogo, Return the Favor, Ulalek, …) resolved with no triggering permanent: The Ozolith's copied leave trigger
moved no counters, Havengul Mystery's copied leave trigger didn't transform the land back (only the original did, after
it), a copied Hangarback Walker death trigger made no Thopters.

**Bisect.** `TawnosUrzasApprenticeTest`'s "Copies a triggered ability from an artifact source" passes at `81d94633a6`
(run 1) and fails from `b1c7c4edcf` (run 2), where `PutLeavingCreatureCountersOnSourceEffect` and
`TransformSelfWhenChosenPermanentLeavesEffectHandler` started reading `StackEntry.getTriggeringPermanentSnapshot()`.
`HavengulLaboratoryTest#copiedLeaveTriggerDoesNotTransformTheLandTwice` (seen failing at run 17l / 17m) has the same
cause: its handler moved to the snapshot in the same commit.

**Fix.**

- New `StackEntry.copyTriggerEventFrom(StackEntry source)`: the one place that copies every trigger-event field (the
  triggering permanent with its snapshot, attachments, keywords and last-known card, ids, controller, owner and
  power/toughness at trigger; the triggering card, cards, spell, spell targets and cast indexes, activated ability,
  player and vote; the event value and the event player, card and mana-value payloads; the attack it was about; the
  granting permanent, linked exiled card, graveyard-target mana-value limit, source graveyard incarnation and power at
  trigger). The copy constructor calls it in place of its own assignments for those fields (unchanged deep copies).
- `CopySupport.createCopyStackEntry` calls it for an activated or triggered ability's copy (CR 707.10, checked: a copy
  of an ability copies its characteristics and the decisions made for it; the Strionic Resonator and Lithoform Engine
  rulings: the copy is "another instance of that ability"). Every copy-an-ability path builds its entry there, so
  `CopyTargetTriggeredAbilityEffectHandler`, `CopyTargetActivatedOrTriggeredAbilityEffectHandler`,
  `CopyTargetAbilityEffectHandler` and `CopyTriggeredAbilityFromSnapshotEffectHandler` lose their hand copies of the
  triggering permanent id, controller, card id, event value and attacked target;
  `CopyControllerActivatedAbilityEffectHandler` (which copied none of them) and `CopyTargetSpellOrAbilityEffectHandler`
  (which keeps its hand copies for spells) get the rest through the same call. Spell copies are unchanged.
- New `TriggerEventCopyCompletenessTest` (application, `architecture`): every `StackEntry` field named `triggering…`,
  `event…` or `…AtTrigger` must be copied in `copyTriggerEventFrom`, so a new trigger-event field can't be left to the
  copy constructor alone. `ARCHITECTURE.md`'s triggering-permanent paragraph says so.

**Rules fixes, with tests** (each new card test fails at HEAD `8bec926ede` in `/mnt/ramdisk/mv-head`, passes now):

- The Ozolith's leave trigger copied by Tawnos puts the counters on The Ozolith again (existing
  `TawnosUrzasApprenticeTest` case, failing since run 2).
- Havengul Mystery's leave trigger copied by Strionic Resonator transforms the land back as the copy resolves, and
  the original then doesn't transform it again (existing
  `HavengulLaboratoryTest#copiedLeaveTriggerDoesNotTransformTheLandTwice`).
- Hangarback Walker's death trigger copied by Strionic Resonator makes a Thopter per counter for each instance:
  new `StrionicResonatorTest#copiedDeathTriggerReadsTheCreatureThatDied` (at HEAD the copy made none).
- Felisa, Fang of Silverquill's death trigger copied by Lithoform Engine makes an Inkling per counter for each
  instance: new `LithoformEngineTest#copiedDeathTriggerCountsTheCountersTheCreatureDiedWith` (at HEAD none).
- Every other copied trigger whose effect reads the stack entry's trigger event (departed permanent's counters, name,
  attachments; triggering cards; triggering player or vote; the triggering spell once it has left the stack) is fixed
  by the same call. A Death Watch copy already drained the right amounts at HEAD (its amounts fall back to the
  permanent's id), so it got no test.

**Scripts.** `scripts/step15-copied-trigger-event-tests.py` (idempotent; optional repository-root argument, used for the
HEAD worktree): the two new card tests. `StackEntry`, `CopySupport`, the four handlers, `ARCHITECTURE.md` and the two
application tests were edited by hand.

**Tests changed.**

- Card (by script): `StrionicResonatorTest` and `LithoformEngineTest`, one new case each (above).
- Application: new `CopySupportAbilityCopyTest` (a copied triggered ability keeps the triggering permanent snapshot,
  cards, player and event value; a copied activated ability keeps its trigger-event fields) and
  `TriggerEventCopyCompletenessTest`.

**Test runs.**

- Card: the test class of every card that copies a triggered or activated ability (Strionic Resonator, Lithoform
  Engine, Tawnos, Kirol, Mirror-Shield Hoplite, Mister Fantastic, Adric, Abstruse Archaic, Echo, Peter Parker's Camera,
  Scientist Supreme, The Peregrine Dynamo, Weaver of Harmony, Gogo, Return the Favor, Ulalek, the 14

  Ozolith and Felisa (36 classes, 322 cases): all passing, Tawnos's and Havengul Laboratory's two failures too. Both new cases fail at
  HEAD `8bec926ede` in `/mnt/ramdisk/mv-head` (no Thopters / Inklings from the copy) and pass now.
- Application, engine and AI: the whole modules: application 608 of 5,023, engine 1 (`GameMutationBoundaryRatchetTest`),

  identical sets. The two new application test classes (3 cases) pass; `SimulationCopyCompletenessTest` fails as at

#### Run 17y: the "deals damage to a creature" abilities are trigger filters with effects reading the triggering permanent

Row 17y, split into 17y and 17y2 (below). The row's sites, re-checked by reading the collectors: the "deals damage to a
creature" watch (`DamageWatch.ON_ALLY_CREATURE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_CREATURE`, `Triggers.creatureYouControlDealsDamageToCreature()`)
was one trigger written for every card of the family, and the effect's class said which creature it watched and when.
`TriggerCollectionService.fireAllyDealtDamageToCreatureTrigger` judged and built, by class:
`TapAndSkipUntapDamagedCreatureEffect` (Matsu-Tribe Sniper: tap + skip-untap of the entry's target),
`DestroyDamagedCreatureAtEndOfCombatEffect` (Stone-Tongue, Serpentine and Lowland Basilisk, Ohran Viper, Simic Basilisk's
grant, Sosuke), `EquipmentTapsAndLocksDamagedCreatureEffect` (Neko-Te), `DamageDamagedCreatureControllerAndSelfEffect`
(Bellowing Fiend), `DestroyCreatureDamagedByMatchingCreatureEffect` (Toxin Sliver, with its own any-controller walk
`fireAnySourceDealtDamageToCreatureTriggers`), the `DamagedCreatureTriggerEffect` records' `triggeredEffect()`
(`DestroyDamagedCreatureEffect`: Vampire Slayer, Spider-Slayer, Dinosaur Hunter, Grotesque Hybrid, Dripping Dead, Cruel
Deceiver's grant; `CreateTokenWhenEquippedCreatureDealsCombatDamageToCreatureEffect`: Giant's Skewer;
`SacrificeNoncreatureNonlandPermanentIfExcessDamageEffect`, which no card wrote), `ReflectAllyDamageToDamagedCreatureControllerEffect`
(Greatbow Doyen, Flayed Nim) and `EquipmentDamagesOtherDefendingCreaturesEffect` (Kusari-Gama). `DamageTriggerCollectorService`
held the watch's class-keyed handlers: `ExileDamagedCreatureEffect` (Pit Spawn, Sword of Kaldra) and six keyed on the
card's own effect class, each deciding "this creature" or "combat damage" by that class: `MayEffect` (Quest for the
Gemblades, combat only), `MayPayManaEffect` (Ohabi Caleria), `PutCountersOnSourceEffect` (Strax, Spiritmonger, Mephidross
Vampire's grant: "this creature"), `CreateTokenEffect` (no card), `DealDamageToPlayersEffect` (Flesh Reaver: "this
creature") and `SacrificePermanentsEffect` (Maarika).

**The split.** The rest of the row is not this watch: `DamageTriggerCollectorService`'s "a source deals damage" records
(Justice's "a red creature or spell", Essence Sliver, Sower of Discord, The Red Terror, Ghyrson Starn) need a filter on
the damage source as a card or spell, which no damage trigger has; Mangara's Equity, Imodane, Lolth's emblem, the
damage-source destroy (No Mercy, Dread, Mikaeus) and the fight counters are other watches. They are row 17y2, with two
handlers this run kept on the watch (below).

**When the value is read.** "That creature" is the creature dealt the damage, the stack entry's triggering permanent, read
as the ability resolves: destroyed, exiled, tapped, locked, scheduled for end of combat only if it is still that object on
the battlefield (Sword of Kaldra's reminder: "exile it only if it's still on the battlefield"). "That creature's controller"
is read as the ability resolves (CR 608.2h, checked), its controller as it was dealt the damage the fallback once it has
left (Bellowing Fiend's old handler already read the live controller; Flayed Nim's since run 17x2). "That much" is the
damage, the entry's event value. "This creature", "equipped creature", "a [Warrior] you control", "a Sliver", "to a
Vampire", "to a blocking creature" and "combat damage" are facts of the event, judged as the ability triggers (CR 603.2,
checked). The rulings (checked with `get_rulings`): Toxin Sliver's two (a Sliver that stops being one stops being affected),
Giant's Skewer's ("triggers even if the equipped creature died, and even if the creature that was dealt damage didn't die":
the last-known attachment, as before); Matsu-Tribe Sniper, Neko-Te, Sosuke and Kusari-Gama have none. "Defending player"
(Kusari-Gama) is fixed by the combat (CR 506.2, checked); a blocking creature is controlled by it.

**The model.**

- `DamageTrigger` gained `damagedFilter` (`withDamagedFilter`: the creature dealt the damage) and `combatOnly`
  (`withCombatDamageOnly()`), both only for `DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_CREATURE` (the constructor throws otherwise) and dropped by
  `watchKey()` like the filter. The event's relation is the creature that deals the damage: new `Triggers.dealsDamageToCreature()`
  (`THIS`), `equippedCreatureDealsDamageToCreature()` (`EQUIPPED`), `creatureDealsDamageToCreature()` (`ANY`), with the
  existing `creatureYouControlDealsDamageToCreature()` (`YOU_CONTROL`); the filter is the dealer for all four. Three new
  `DamageWatch`es (`ON_SELF_…`, `ON_EQUIPPED_CREATURE_…`, `ON_ANY_CREATURE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_CREATURE`);
  `DamageAbilityReader.trigger(ability, watched)` returns the condition with its filters.
- One collector, `TriggerCollectionService.collectDealsDamageToCreatureAbilities`: the source's own abilities (this, you
  control, any; the ones a static ability grants it too, as before) before state-based actions, and every other permanent's
  (you control when its controller controls the dealer, equipped when it is the Equipment on the dealer, current or
  last-known, whoever controls it, any always). It judges the intervening "if" (CR 603.4, checked), the combat flag and the two
  filters, then puts each ability on the stack as one object (CR 603.3, checked) with the effects the card wrote: the
  watcher its source and controller, the creature dealt the damage its triggering permanent with that creature's controller,
  the damage its event value, the source's snapshot, non-targeting. It runs inside the collector's `dispatch`, so additional
  triggers (Roaming Throne) apply and the shadow recorder sees it. A one-effect ability whose effect class still has a handler
  on the watch (`TriggerCollectorRegistry.handles`, new) goes to it: Greatbow Doyen's record and Maarika's sacrifice.
- Existing effects, extended where they read only a target: `DestroyTargetPermanentAtEndOfCombatEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent()`
  and `ExileTargetPermanentEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent()` (a `triggeringPermanent` component, targeting nothing),
  `DoesntUntapEffect.triggeringWhileSourceOnBattlefield()` (`TRIGGERING` scope with `WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD`);
  `DestroyReferencedPermanentEffect(TRIGGERING[, true])`, `TapPermanentsEffect` / `SkipNextUntapEffect(TapUntapScope.TRIGGERING)`,
  `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(…, TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)`, `LoseLifeEffect(EventValue, TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)`

#### Run 17y2: the "a source deals damage", "deals damage to you", chosen-color creature and fight abilities are trigger filters with effects reading the triggering permanent

Row 17y2, split into 17y2 and 17y3 (below). The row's sites, re-checked by reading the collectors:
`DamageTriggerCollectorService` judged by the effect's class, and built the effect that went on the stack, for
Justice's `ReflectSourceDamageToItsControllerEffect` ("a red creature or spell", with `sourceHasColor`), Essence
Sliver's `SourceDamageGainLifeForSourceControllerEffect` (a `CardPredicate` on the source card; it queued `GainLifeEffect(
EventValue, TRIGGERING_PLAYER)` with the source's controller as the entry's target), The Red Terror's
`PutCountersOnSourceCardForColorSourceDamageEffect` ("a red source you control", building `PutCountersOnSourceCardEffect`),
Tamanoa's plain `GainLifeEffect` (the watch's `GainLifeEffect` handler judged "a noncreature source you control"), No
Mercy's, Dread's and Mikaeus's `DestroyDamageSourcePermanentEffect` (building `DestroyReferencedPermanentEffect(TRIGGERING)`),
Mangara's Equity's `ReflectDamageToChosenColorCreatureEffect` (the chosen color and the white-creature filter, its
`triggeredEffect()` aimed at the creature as a non-chosen target) and Foe-Razer Regent's `PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect`,
which the fight handler wrapped in a `RegisterDelayedCountersOnTriggeringPermanentEffect`. Tamanoa was not in the row: its
handler was the same kind (a filter judged by the effect's class on the same watch), so it moved with the others.

**The split.** The rest of row 17y2 needs more than a filter on the source: Sower of Discord ("damage is dealt to one of
the chosen players", once for each such player) and Ghyrson Starn ("exactly 1 damage to a permanent or player", once
for each such recipient) are events about each recipient, not about the source; Circle of Affliction's `MayPayManaEffect`
handler chooses its target as it triggers; Imodane ("a spell that targets only a single creature deals damage to that
creature", the damage to that creature its value) and Lolth's emblem are other watches; Greatbow Doyen and Maarika stay
as run 17y left them. The "deals damage to you" watch keeps four more class-keyed handlers that build their effect
(Dissipation Field's bounce, Contested War Zone's control change, Hixus's exile, Aurification's gold counter). They are
row 17y3.

**When the value is read.** "A red creature or spell", "a Sliver", "a red source you control", "a noncreature source you
control", "a creature / a Human deals damage to you" and "a creature of the chosen color deals damage to you or a white
creature you control" are facts of the event, judged as the ability triggers (CR 603.2, checked). The source is a
permanent or not as it dealt the damage: a permanent is judged as it is then (layered characteristics, so a Sliver that
stops being one stops counting, as Essence Sliver's ruling says), or on its card's characteristics once it has left (the
event keeps no last-known permanent for the source); a spell, or a card dealing damage from another zone, on its card.
The colors are the source's own: Ghostly Flame's ruling (checked with `get_rulings`): "It does not change the color of
the source, so that things that trigger on a red spell doing damage will still trigger. The damage itself thinks it came
from a colorless source". "Its controller", "that creature's or spell's controller" are read as the ability resolves
(CR 608.2h, checked), the controller as the event happened the fallback (a spell source's, a permanent that has left);
"destroy it" and "that much damage to that creature" read the entry's triggering permanent as the ability resolves
(nothing once it has left); "that much" is the entry's event value. "It" of the fight trigger is the fighting creature
(CR 701.14a, checked), and the delayed counters are created as the ability resolves (CR 603.7a, checked). The rulings
(checked with `get_rulings`): Justice's two (one summed reflection per source, a triggered ability), Essence Sliver's
three (above; the life is gained as the ability resolves), No Mercy's and Mikaeus's (any damage, your own creatures too;
a Human dealing damage as Mikaeus dies is still destroyed), Tamanoa's two (a creature card not on the battlefield is not
a noncreature source; any recipient), Foe-Razer Regent's three (the fight's target, the end-step timing); The Red Terror
and Mangara's Equity have none.

**The model.**

- `DamageTrigger` gained `spellFilter` (`withSpellFilter(CardPredicate)`: the source of the damage when it isn't a
  permanent), only on a `DEALS_DAMAGE` trigger about another source (`ANY`, `YOU_CONTROL`; the constructor throws
  otherwise) and dropped by `watchKey()`. On those triggers `filter` is the source when it is a permanent. A trigger with
  a filter or a spell filter triggers only for a source of a kind it has a filter for; one with neither for every source.
  `damagedFilter` is now also allowed on `CREATURE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_YOU_OR_YOUR_PERMANENT` (the damaged permanent; damage
  to you always counts); `combatOnly` stays only on `DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_CREATURE`.
- New `Triggers.sourceYouControlDealsDamage()` (`DEALS_DAMAGE`, `YOU_CONTROL`) and its `DamageWatch.ON_ALLY_SOURCE_DEALS_DAMAGE`,
  read by the same collector as `ON_ANY_SOURCE_DEALS_DAMAGE` for a watcher whose controller controls the source.
- `TriggerCollectionService.collectSourceDealsDamageAbilities` (from `queueSourceDealsDamageReflections`): each printed
  ability of the two watches whose filters match the source (`damageSourceMatches`) and whose intervening "if" holds
  (CR 603.4, checked) goes on the stack through the collector's dispatch as one object (CR 603.3, checked) with the card's
  effects: the watcher its source, the source permanent its triggering permanent (none for a spell), the source's
  controller as it dealt the damage the fallback, the summed damage its event value. A one-effect ability whose effect
  still has a class-keyed handler on the watch (`TriggerCollectorRegistry.handles`) goes to it (Sower, Ghyrson, Circle of
  Affliction). The "deals damage to you" loop (`checkDamageDealtToControllerTriggers`) and
  `checkCreatureDamageToYouOrYourPermanentTriggers` read the abilities the same way: the filter on the dealer, the damaged
  filter on the damaged permanent, the source or creature the triggering permanent (with the damage as the event value for
  the second). The shared `queueDamageEventAbility` builds the entry (non-targeting, with the watcher's snapshot).
- `GainLifeRecipient.TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER` (new value, handled by `GainLifeEffectHandler` like the other
  effects' `TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER`: the triggering permanent's controller as the ability resolves, then the
  entry's removed-permanent controllers, then its triggering-permanent controller).
- The fight watch's `PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect` handler became the watch's default (`CardEffect`) handler: the
  card's effect goes on the stack as written, non-targeting, the fighting creature its triggering permanent.
- Deleted: `ReflectSourceDamageToItsControllerEffect`, `SourceDamageGainLifeForSourceControllerEffect`,
  `PutCountersOnSourceCardForColorSourceDamageEffect`, `DestroyDamageSourcePermanentEffect`,
  `ReflectDamageToChosenColorCreatureEffect`; `DamageTriggerCollectorService`'s handlers for them and its `GainLifeEffect`
  handler on `ON_ANY_SOURCE_DEALS_DAMAGE`, and three banner comments around them.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17y2-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 9 card classes:

- Justice: `Triggers.sourceDealsDamage().withFilter(red creature).withSpellFilter(new CardColorPredicate(RED))` +

- Essence Sliver: `sourceDealsDamage().withFilter(Sliver).withSpellFilter(new CardSubtypePredicate(SLIVER))` +

- The Red Terror: `Triggers.sourceYouControlDealsDamage().withFilter(red).withSpellFilter(red)` +

- Tamanoa: `sourceYouControlDealsDamage().withFilter(not a creature).withSpellFilter(not a creature card)` + its

- No Mercy, Dread (`.withFilter(new PermanentIsCreaturePredicate())`), Mikaeus (`.withFilter(Human)`):

- Foe-Razer Regent: `RegisterDelayedCountersOnTriggeringPermanentEffect(new PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, 2))`.

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix: "whenever a red creature or spell deals damage" (Justice) and "whenever a red source you control deals
  damage" (The Red Terror) judged the damage's color through `getDamageSourceColors`, so under Ghostly Flame they didn't

  `EssenceSliverTest#sliversControllerAsTheAbilityResolvesGainsTheLife` (Act of Aggression on the attacking Essence

- Justice, Essence Sliver, The Red Terror, Tamanoa: a permanent source is judged on its layered characteristics (Essence
  Sliver's old filter read the card's subtypes), and the abilities reach the stack through the collector's dispatch

  entries carry the watcher's snapshot, the source as their triggering permanent and no target (Essence Sliver's had the

- No Mercy, Dread, Mikaeus, Mangara's Equity: the same entries as before but reached through the dispatch, with the
  damage source's controller recorded; Mangara's entry names the creature as its triggering permanent instead of a

  are judged as they trigger (no card on these watches has one).
- Foe-Razer Regent: the entry is non-targeting (it was already effectively so).

For step 16: no new `Card`, `StackEntry` or `GameData` state; `DamageTrigger` gained a component, `Triggers` a factory,

#### Follow-up: Ashnod sees a chosen sacrifice

**The bug.** Ashnod the Uncaring ("Whenever you activate an ability of an artifact or creature that isn't a mana
ability, if one or more permanents were sacrificed to activate it, you may copy that ability") didn't trigger when the
sacrifice was chosen: with Bloodthrone Vampire ("Sacrifice a creature: …") sacrificing Grizzly Bears, only the
Vampire's ability went on the stack. A self-sacrificing source (Aether Spellbomb) worked. It failed before run 17x5b
too (`47a28c2012`).

**Cause.** Not the timing: the activation trigger is collected in `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService.completeActivationAfterCosts`
after the costs are paid (the chosen permanents wait in `GameData.pendingActivationCostSacrificeIds` and are sacrificed
there, before the ability's stack entry is built). The sacrifice was never recorded: `StackEntry.sacrificedCardIds` was
filled only by `SacrificeAnyNumberOfPermanentsCost` (Sword of the Ages), and the payment check fell back to a
sacrifice-the-source cost read off the ability (`CostEffect.sacrificesSourcePermanent`). Every other sacrifice cost
(a creature, a permanent, several, distinct names, a sequence; the forage Food) was invisible to it.

**Fix.** CR 602.2b and 601.2h (checked): the costs are paid as the ability is activated; the BRO ruling (checked with
`get_rulings`): "sacrificed to activate it" means sacrificed to pay the ability's costs, not a Treasure sacrificed for
mana that paid them.

- `sacrificeCostPermanents` returns the card ids of the permanents its departure batch removed (the source and the
  chosen ones), and the granting Equipment of `SacrificeSourceEquipmentCost` (Blazing Torch) is added when
  `sacrificeAlone` removes it; `completeActivationAfterCosts` merges them with the "any number" ids into the stack
  entry's `sacrificedCardIds` (the field's documented meaning). `activationPaymentMatches`' `SACRIFICE` reads only that
  list; the `sacrificesSourcePermanent` fallback is gone (it also said yes for a Torch with no granting Equipment).
  Sword of the Ages' `ExileSacrificedCardsFromGraveyardEffect` now also lists the Sword, which its
  `ExileSourceCardFromGraveyardEffect` has exiled first (nothing changes).
- CR 109.2 (checked), now observable: an exiled (suspended), command-zone or emblem source has no controller on the
  battlefield, and the two non-mana activation collectors get no activated permanent for it, as a hand card's ability
  gets none, so a source filter ("an ability of an artifact or creature", Harsh Mentor's "on the battlefield") doesn't
  match the card. With the sacrifice now seen, a suspended Greater Gargadon's ability would otherwise have triggered
  Ashnod; it did trigger Harsh Mentor (a rules fix: the collectors were handed the exiled card as a `Permanent`). Run
  17x5b's rules-fix bullet is corrected: its Ashnod half changed nothing then.

No new `Card`, `StackEntry` or `GameData` state. `ARCHITECTURE.md`'s cost-sacrifice paragraph and the payment line in
`EFFECTS_QUICK_REFERENCE.md` say what the list holds (by hand, with the two engine files).

#### Run 17y3: the "deals damage to you", "a source of the chosen color deals damage to you" and "only target creature" abilities are trigger filters with effects reading the stack entry

Row 17y3, split into 17y3 and 17y4 (below). The row's sites, re-checked by reading the collectors: on the "a permanent
deals damage to you" watch (`DamageWatch.ON_ANY_PERMANENT_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_YOU`) `DamageTriggerCollectorService` held four
class-keyed handlers that judged part of the trigger condition by the effect's class and built the effect that went on
the stack: Dissipation Field's `ReturnDamageSourcePermanentToHandEffect` (built `ReturnToHandEffect.target()` aimed at the
source), Contested War Zone's `DamageSourceControllerGainsControlOfThisPermanentEffect(combatOnly, creatureOnly)` (built
`DamageSourceControllerGainsControlOfDamagedPermanentEffect` and an optional untap), Hixus's
`ExileDamageSourcePermanentUntilSourceLeavesEffect(filter, combatOnly, intervening)` (built
`ExileTargetPermanentUntilSourceLeavesEffect` wrapped in the intervening "if") and Aurification's
`PutCounterOnReferencedPermanentEffect` handler ("a creature", also the path of Stensia's planar ability). On "a source
deals damage" Circle of Affliction's `MayPayManaEffect` handler judged "deals damage to you" and "a source of the chosen
color" (the damage's color, `sourceHasColor` through `getDamageSourceColors`) and queued the target choice; on "an
instant or sorcery spell you control deals damage" Imodane's `DealDamageToEachOpponentWhenSingleTargetCreatureSpellDealsDamageEffect`
judged "that targets only a single creature … to that creature". Not in the row, but the same record: Contested Game
Ball wrote `DamageSourceControllerGainsControlOfThisPermanentEffect(true, true, true)` on `Triggers.creatureDealsCombatDamageToYou()`,
whose collector (`queueCreatureCombatDamageToYouTriggers`) built the control change with the active player bound in.

**The split.** The rest of the row needs more than a filter: Sower of Discord ("damage is dealt to one of the chosen
players", once for each such player, "the other chosen player" the recipient) and Ghyrson Starn ("exactly 1 damage to a
permanent or player", once for each such recipient, "that permanent or player" the recipient) are events about each
recipient, which no damage trigger has; Lolth's emblem needs a "one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to
an opponent" trigger the emblem collector reads, a condition and an amount on that player's life lost this turn (its
`triggeredEffect()` reads `OpponentLostLifeThisTurn` / `LifeLostThisTurn(OPPONENTS)` / `EACH_OPPONENT`, right only with
one opponent); Greatbow Doyen's "that Archer deals" needs an effect whose damage the triggering permanent deals; Maarika's
intervening "if" needs the damaged creature's excess damage judged with this event. They are row 17y4.

**When the value is read.** "A permanent / a creature deals damage to you", "deals combat damage to you", "a source of
the chosen color", "an instant or sorcery spell that targets only a single creature deals damage to that creature" are
facts of the event, judged as the ability triggers (CR 603.2, checked); the intervening "if" ("if Hixus entered this
turn") as it triggers and again as it resolves (CR 603.4, checked). "It" / "that creature" (the bounce, the gold
counter, the exile) is the stack entry's triggering permanent or non-targeting `targetId`, read as the ability resolves
(nothing once it has left); "that creature's controller" is read as the ability resolves (CR 608.2h, checked); "the
attacking player" is the active player (CR 506.2, checked) as the ability resolves; "that much" is the entry's event
value (the damage dealt to that creature). The colors are the source's own: Ghostly Flame's ruling (run 17y2) says the
source's color doesn't change. The rulings (checked with `get_rulings`): Circle of Affliction's four (once for each
source that deals damage to you, the target need not be the source's controller), Dissipation Field's (any permanent,
yours too, any damage), Hixus's six (no exile if Hixus left first; the return), Contested War Zone's four ("you" is the
current controller; one trigger per creature, the last to resolve decides), Aurification's; Imodane, Lolth and Maarika
have none.

**The model.**

- `DamageTrigger.DamageEvent` gained `SOURCE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_YOU` (any source, a permanent or not, once for each source
  that deals damage to you, the damage dealt to you its value; `withSpellFilter` allowed on it as on `DEALS_DAMAGE`) and
  `INSTANT_OR_SORCERY_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_ITS_ONLY_TARGET_CREATURE`; new `Triggers.sourceDealsDamageToYou()` and
  `instantOrSorceryYouControlDealsDamageToItsOnlyTargetCreature()`, with their `DamageWatch.ON_ANY_SOURCE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_YOU`
  and `ON_ALLY_INSTANT_OR_SORCERY_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_ITS_ONLY_TARGET_CREATURE`.
- `TriggerCollectionService.collectSourceDealsDamageAbilities` takes the event value (the total, or the damage dealt to
  the watcher's controller for the new watch, which `queueSourceDealsDamageReflections` reads for a player dealt damage
  by the source) and queues the target choice (`SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget` with the event value) for an ability with a
  target, through the dispatch. The new `collectInstantOrSorceryDealsDamageToItsOnlyTargetCreatureAbilities` (from
  `checkAllyInstantOrSorcerySpellDealsDamageTriggers`) puts each ability on the stack through the dispatch with the
  creature its triggering permanent and the damage dealt to it its event value (`queueDamageEventAbility`).
- `checkDamageDealtToControllerTriggers` judges the abilities' intervening "if" as they trigger (`TriggerJudge`; no card
  on the watch has one now). The planar reader of the watch (`checkPlanarPermanentDealsDamageToYouTriggers`, Stensia)
  puts the plane's effect on the stack as written through the dispatch (`queuePlanarDamageEventAbility`: the creature its
  triggering permanent), keeping the limit.
- `queueCreatureCombatDamageToYouTriggers` lost its `DamageSourceControllerGainsControlOfThisPermanentEffect` branch and
  puts its entry through the collector's dispatch with `enqueueTrigger` (it used `stack.add`); the entry already had the
  creature as its `targetId` and triggering permanent.
- `DamageSourceControllerGainsControlOfDamagedPermanentEffect`'s `UUID newControllerId` (only that branch set it) is now
  `boolean attackingPlayerGainsControl`, `attackingPlayer()`: the active player as the ability resolves.
- Deleted: `ReturnDamageSourcePermanentToHandEffect`, `DamageSourceControllerGainsControlOfThisPermanentEffect`,
  `ExileDamageSourcePermanentUntilSourceLeavesEffect`, `DealDamageToEachOpponentWhenSingleTargetCreatureSpellDealsDamageEffect`;
  `DamageTriggerCollectorService`'s six handlers (`handleBounceOnDamage`, `handleControlTheftOnDamage`,
  `handleCreatureDealsDamageToYouPutCounter`, `handleExileDamageSourceOnDamage`, `handleChosenColorSourceDamage`,
  `handleSingleTargetCreatureSpellDealsDamage`), `sourceHasColor`, its two then unused services, a banner comment; a
  stale banner and misplaced Javadoc in `TriggerCollectionService`.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17y3-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 7 card classes:

#### Run 17y4: the per-recipient damage, emblem combat damage and excess-damage abilities are trigger filters with effects reading the stack entry

Row 17y4, split into 17y4 and 17y5 (below). The row's sites, re-checked by reading the collectors: on "a source deals
damage" (`DamageWatch.ON_ANY_SOURCE_DEALS_DAMAGE`) `DamageTriggerCollectorService` held two class-keyed handlers that
built their effect once for each recipient: Sower of Discord's `OtherChosenPlayerLosesLifeEffect` (for each chosen
player dealt damage, `LoseLifeEffect(EventValue, TRIGGERING_PLAYER)` with "the other chosen player" bound as the
entry's target) and Ghyrson Starn's `GhyrsonStarnKelermorphEffect` (for each permanent and player another source the
watcher's controller controls dealt exactly 1 damage, `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(2)` aimed at it). Lolth's emblem was
`LoseLifeToThresholdOnCombatDamageEffect(8)`, an `EmblemCombatDamageTriggerEffect` that
`TriggerCollectionService.checkEmblemCombatDamageTriggers` read by class: it gated on the damaged player's life lost and
put the record's `triggeredEffect()` on the stack, a `ConditionalEffect(Not(OpponentLostLifeThisTurn(8)), LoseLifeEffect(8 -
LifeLostThisTurn(OPPONENTS), EACH_OPPONENT))`. On the deals-damage-to-a-creature watch Maarika's
`SacrificePermanentsEffect` handler (`handleSelfDealsDamageToCreatureAfterExcessDamage`) judged "Maarika deals the
damage" and "if that creature was dealt excess damage this turn" (the turn's record, or this event's damage against the
creature's lethal damage) and bound the creature's controller as the target player.

**The split.** Greatbow Doyen's "that Archer deals that much damage" needs an effect whose damage the trigger event's
dealer deals (CR 608.2h, checked: "it's the object as it exists — or as it most recently existed — that does it"):
the dealer's lifelink, infect, deathtouch and colors for protection, which today only the handler's rebuilt entry (the
Archer as the entry's source) gives. The combat collector has the same need under a class-keyed marker,
`CombatDamageDealerReferencingEffect` (Saskia's `DealDamageToChosenPlayerEffect`, `DealDamageToEachOtherOpponentEffect`
with `dealerIsSource`: Amarant Coral, Hydra Omnivore, Kosei, Kediss, Parapet Thrasher, Vincent). One form for both is row
17y5.

**When the value is read.** "Damage is dealt to one of the chosen players", "another source you control deals exactly 1
damage to a permanent or player", "an opponent is dealt combat damage by one or more creatures you control" and "Maarika
deals damage to a creature" are facts of the event, judged as the ability triggers (CR 603.2, checked); Ghyrson's
"exactly 1" is an event condition on the event's value, never checked again. Each recipient is an occurrence of its own
(CR 603.2c, checked; Ghyrson's ruling: "deals exactly 1 damage to multiple permanents and/or players simultaneously, …
triggers that many times"). The intervening "if"s ("if that player lost less than 8 life this turn", "if that creature
was dealt excess damage this turn", CR 120.10, checked) are judged as the ability triggers and again as it resolves
(CR 603.4, checked). "The other chosen player" is read as the ability resolves from the source or its last-known
information (Sower's ruling: lethal damage to Sower at the same time still makes the other player lose life); "that
player" and "that permanent or player" are the entry's non-targeting `targetId`; "that creature's controller" is read as
the ability resolves (CR 608.2h). Emblem abilities function in the command zone (CR 114.4, checked). The rulings
(checked with `get_rulings`): Sower's four, Ghyrson's one, Greatbow Doyen's two (permanents only, combat or not); Lolth
and Maarika have none.

**The model.**

- `DamageTrigger.DamageEvent` gained `DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_PERMANENT_OR_PLAYER` (once for each source and each permanent and
  player it deals damage to, that recipient the event's, the damage dealt to it the event's value) and `DamageTrigger`
  the component `damagedPlayerFilter` (`withDamagedPlayerFilter`, only on that event; `damagedFilter` is allowed there
  too, on a permanent recipient; a trigger with either recipient filter triggers only for a recipient of a kind it has a
  filter for; `watchKey()` drops it). The spell filter is allowed on the new event and with `ANOTHER_YOU_CONTROL`. New
  `Triggers.sourceDealsDamageToPermanentOrPlayer()` (`ANY`) and `anotherSourceYouControlDealsDamageToPermanentOrPlayer()`
  (`ANOTHER_YOU_CONTROL`) with their `DamageWatch.ON_ANY_SOURCE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_PERMANENT_OR_PLAYER` and
  `ON_ANOTHER_ALLY_SOURCE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_PERMANENT_OR_PLAYER`; new `Triggers.creaturesYouControlDealCombatDamageToOpponent()`
  (`CombatTrigger(ONE_OR_MORE_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_OPPONENT, YOU_CONTROL)`, read only by the emblem collector).
- `TriggerCollectionService.queueSourceDealsDamageReflections` calls the new
  `collectSourceDealsDamageToPermanentOrPlayerAbilities` for every permanent (the "another" watch when its controller
  controls the source and it isn't the source): for each recipient it judges the intervening "if" and event condition
  with the recipient as the context's target (and triggering permanent) and the damage dealt to it as the event value,
  the source filters (`damageSourceMatches`) and the recipient filters (`damageRecipientMatches`: a player by
  `TargetLegalityService.matchesPlayerPredicate` with the watcher as the source, a permanent on its snapshot), and puts
  the ability on the stack through the dispatch with the effects the card wrote: the recipient its non-targeting
  `targetId`, a player also its triggering player, a permanent its triggering permanent with its controller, the damage
  its event value, the watcher's snapshot.
- `checkEmblemCombatDamageTriggers` reads the emblems' `TriggeredAbility`s on that trigger: it judges the ability's
  options with the damaged opponent as the context's target, wraps the intervening "if" around each effect, and puts one
  entry on the stack (`enqueueTrigger`) with that player as its non-targeting `targetId` and triggering player, the combat
  damage as its event value; a limit or multiplicity throws.
- `collectDealsDamageToCreatureAbilities` judges the intervening "if" with the creature dealt the damage as the
  context's triggering permanent. The excess-damage record is written before these collectors run (combat:
  `checkCombatExcessDamageTriggers` before the deals-damage-to-a-creature triggers; noncombat:
  `DamageSupport.recordExcessDamageToCreatureIfAny` before them), so the old handler's "by this event" fallback is not
  needed.
- New `PlayerChosenBySourcePredicate` (the source's `rememberedTargetPlayerIds`, live or its departed snapshot),
  `PermanentDealtExcessDamageThisTurnPredicate` (`GameData.permanentsDealtExcessDamageThisTurn`) and
  `LoseLifeRecipient.OTHER_CHOSEN_PLAYER` (the source's chosen players, live or its snapshot, but the triggering player).
  `TargetPlayerLostLifeThisTurn` gained `minimumAmount` (its no-argument form is 1, as before).
- Deleted: `OtherChosenPlayerLosesLifeEffect`, `GhyrsonStarnKelermorphEffect`, `EmblemCombatDamageTriggerEffect`,
  `LoseLifeToThresholdOnCombatDamageEffect`; `DamageTriggerCollectorService`'s `handleOtherChosenPlayerLosesLife`,
  `handleGhyrsonStarnKelermorph` (with `queueGhyrsonTrigger`), `handleSelfDealsDamageToCreatureAfterExcessDamage` (with
  `wasDealtExcessDamageByThisEvent`), three unused imports and a banner comment.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17y4-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 4 card classes:

- Sower of Discord: `Triggers.sourceDealsDamageToPermanentOrPlayer().withDamagedPlayerFilter(new
  PlayerChosenBySourcePredicate())` + `LoseLifeEffect(new EventValue(), LoseLifeRecipient.OTHER_CHOSEN_PLAYER)`;
- Ghyrson Starn: `Triggers.anotherSourceYouControlDealsDamageToPermanentOrPlayer()`,
  `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withEventCondition(new NotCondition(new EventValueAtLeast(2)))`, `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(2)`;
- Lolth, Spider Queen: `CreateEmblemEffect(new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.creaturesYouControlDealCombatDamageToOpponent(),
  TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(new NotCondition(new TargetPlayerLostLifeThisTurn(8))), new LoseLifeEffect(new
  Sum(new Fixed(8), new Scaled(new LifeLostThisTurn(CountScope.TARGET_PLAYER), -1)), TRIGGERING_PLAYER)), text)`;
- Maarika: `Triggers.dealsDamageToCreature()` (it was "a creature you control" narrowed by the handler),
  `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(new TriggeringPermanentMatches(new PermanentDealtExcessDamageThisTurnPredicate()))`,
  `SacrificePermanentsEffect(1, noncreature nonland, TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)`.

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix: Lolth's emblem counted every opponent's life lost this turn, made every opponent lose life, and at
  resolution checked whether any opponent had lost 8; with two opponents an opponent dealt combat damage lost too little
  and the other opponent lost life too. "That player" is the opponent dealt the combat damage. New card test
  `LolthSpiderQueenTest#emblemReadsOnlyTheDamagedOpponentsLifeLost` (Shock the second opponent, one Grizzly Bears hits the
  first: they go to 12, the second stays at 18), failing at HEAD `fa4e7f0c08` in `/mnt/ramdisk/mv-head` (14 instead of 12)
  and passing now.
- Maarika's intervening "if" is checked again as the ability resolves (it wasn't); within a turn the excess-damage
  record only grows, so nothing observable changes. "That creature's controller" is read as the ability resolves (it was
  bound as it triggered).
- Sower's and Ghyrson's entries carry the watcher's snapshot, and Sower reads its chosen players from it as the ability
  resolves (they were bound as it triggered): the same players. Lolth's emblem entries carry the damaged player and the
  combat damage.

#### Run 17y5: "that creature deals that much damage" is `DealDamageToPlayersEffect` with the trigger event's damage source

Row 17y5, the two sites run 17y4 split off, re-checked by reading the collectors and handlers. On the
deals-damage-to-a-creature watch `DamageTriggerCollectorService.handleAllyDealtDamageToCreatureReflection` (Greatbow
Doyen's `ReflectAllyDamageToDamagedCreatureControllerEffect`, the only class-keyed handler left on those watches) built
the stack entry with the Archer as its card and source, so the record's `triggeredEffect()` dealt its damage from the
Archer. `CombatDamageService`'s "a creature you control deals combat damage to a player" collector read the
`CombatDamageDealerReferencingEffect` marker by class and stamped the creature that dealt the combat damage on the entry
(`damageSourceCard`, the watcher's snapshot), and the marked effects' handlers rebuilt a second entry with that creature
as its card and source: `DealDamageToChosenPlayerEffectHandler` (Saskia) and `DealDamageToEachOtherOpponentEffectHandler`
with `dealerIsSource` (Kediss; Hydra Omnivore, Amarant Coral, Kosei and Vincent, whose dealer is the ability's own
source; Parapet Thrasher's `int` form had `dealerIsSource` false). Kosei's effect (in a `SequenceEffect`) and Vincent's
(in a `ConditionalEffect`) never showed the marker to the collector, which read the outer effect's class.

**When the value is read.** "That Archer", and "it" of "whenever a creature / commander you control deals combat damage
to a player, it deals that much damage", is the creature that dealt the event's damage, a fact of the event. The ability
says that object does something, so "it's the object as it exists — or as it most recently existed — that does it, not
the ability" (CR 608.2h, checked). It is the damage's source, so the damage has its characteristics (CR 120.3, checked):
its lifelink gains its controller life (CR 120.3f and 702.15b, checked), and protection from its colors prevents the
damage (CR 702.16e, checked). It is read as the ability resolves: the live permanent with its current controller, or,
once it has left the battlefield, as it last existed there (the keywords it had as it left, or the copy taken as it
dealt the event's damage when it left before the ability reached the stack). "That much" is the entry's event value,
"that creature's controller" (Greatbow) the controller of the entry's triggering permanent as the ability resolves, "the
chosen player" (Saskia) the entry's target, "each other opponent" every opponent but the entry's target. Rulings
(checked with `get_rulings`): Greatbow Doyen's two (permanents only; combat or not), Saskia's four (the chosen player is
dealt the damage again; not combat damage; no effect once the chosen player has left the game; a new choice after Saskia
returns), Kediss's (not combat damage, not tracked as commander damage), Hydra Omnivore's (not combat damage). Vincent's
"if Vincent's power is 7 or greater" follows the effect, so it is no intervening "if" and stays the effect's
`ConditionalEffect`.

**The model.**

- New `DamageSource` enum (`model/effect/`): `ABILITY_SOURCE` (the default) and `EVENT_DAMAGE_SOURCE`.
  `DealDamageToPlayersEffect` gained the component `damageSource` (`null` is `ABILITY_SOURCE`; the six-component
  constructor keeps the old meaning) and the wither `dealtByEventDamageSource()`; `recordingDamageDealt()` and
  `withTriggeredTargetFilter` keep it.
- `StackEntry` gained the trigger-event fields `eventDamageSource` (a `Permanent` copy, set with
  `setEventDamageSource(dealer, controllerId)`), `eventDamageSourceControllerId` and `eventDamageSourceKeywordsAtLeave`,
  copied by `copyTriggerEventFrom` (so the copy constructor, simulation copies and copies of the ability keep them), and
  `requireEventDamageSource()`, which throws when an ability that names the dealer reached the stack without one.
- The collectors that record it: `TriggerCollectionService.queueDealsDamageToCreatureAbility` (every "deals damage to
  a creature" ability: the creature that dealt it) and `CombatDamageService`'s "this creature deals combat damage to a
  player" entries and "a creature you control deals combat damage to a player" entries (not "one or more", which has
  several dealers). `PermanentRemovalService.snapshotTriggeringPermanentKeywords` records the dealer's keywords as it
  leaves on every stack entry that names it, as it already did for the triggering permanent.
- `DamageSupport.entryDealtByEventDamageSource` builds the entry the damage is dealt through (the dealer its card,
  source permanent, damage source card and controller; its keywords at leave, or its copy, once it has left);
  `DealDamageToPlayersEffectHandler` deals every recipient's damage, and checks its prevention, through it, and reads the
  recipients and the amount from the resolving entry.
- `collectDealsDamageToCreatureAbilities` lost its class-keyed branch (`registry.handles` on the watch): no handler is
  left on the deals-damage-to-a-creature watches.
- Deleted: `ReflectAllyDamageToDamagedCreatureControllerEffect`, `CombatDamageDealerReferencingEffect`,
  `DealDamageToChosenPlayerEffect`, `DealDamageToEachOtherOpponentEffect`, `DealDamageToChosenPlayerEffectHandler`,
  `DealDamageToEachOtherOpponentEffectHandler`, `handleAllyDealtDamageToCreatureReflection` and the combat collector's
  marker block. The existing `EACH_OTHER_OPPONENT` and `CHOSEN_PLAYER` recipients of `DealDamageToPlayersEffect` (Human
  Torch, Stuffy Doll) already read the entry's target the way the two records did.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17y5-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 8 card classes:

- Greatbow Doyen: `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new EventValue(), TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER).dealtByEventDamageSource()`;
- Saskia the Unyielding: `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new EventValue(), CHOSEN_PLAYER).dealtByEventDamageSource()`;
- Kediss, Emberclaw Familiar: `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new EventValue(), EACH_OTHER_OPPONENT).dealtByEventDamageSource()`;
- Hydra Omnivore, Amarant Coral, Kosei (inside its granted `SequenceEffect`), Vincent (inside its `ConditionalEffect`):
  `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new EventValue(), EACH_OTHER_OPPONENT)`, "it" the ability's own source;
- Parapet Thrasher's mode: `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(4, EACH_OTHER_OPPONENT)`.

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix: Kediss's rebuilt entry kept only the commander's card once the commander had left the battlefield, so its
  damage had the card's printed keywords, not the lifelink it had as it left (Saskia's handler alone copied the keywords
  at leave). New card test `KedissEmberclawFamiliarTest#departedCommanderDealsTheDamageWithItsLifelink` (a Grizzly
  Bears commander with Loxodon Warhammer hits, Terror on it in response to the trigger, the commander left in the
  graveyard: the other opponent goes to 15 and its controller to 30), failing at HEAD `50646fcede` in
  `/mnt/ramdisk/mv-head` (25 instead of 30) and passing now.
- Greatbow Doyen's entry's source is Greatbow Doyen (it was the Archer): "Greatbow Doyen's ability" on the stack, the
  ability's source for anything that reads it; the damage's source is still the Archer.
- Saskia's entry no longer carries the dealer as its own damage source card or Saskia's snapshot; the chosen player is
  the entry's target, recorded by the combat collector from Saskia as the ability triggers (it was read from Saskia, or
  its snapshot, as the ability resolved: the same player, since a Saskia that returned is a new object).

For step 16: `StackEntry` gained three trigger-event fields (in `copyTriggerEventFrom`), `DealDamageToPlayersEffect` a
component, one new enum; three records, one marker, two effect handlers and one class-keyed collector handler gone;
nothing new is slot-keyed.

**Left, and noted.**

  or more creatures deal combat damage" don't record the event's damage source. No card writes
  `dealtByEventDamageSource()` there; one that did would fail as it resolves (`requireEventDamageSource`).
- The other damage collectors ("a source deals damage", "deals damage to you", "is dealt damage") name the source as

- Only `DealDamageToPlayersEffect` takes the option; a "that creature deals damage to any target / to a creature" card

#### Follow-up: Lolth's and Sower's multiplayer triggering

Two multiplayer checks of run 17y4's conversions, asked for by the user.

**Lolth, Spider Queen's emblem** ("Whenever an opponent is dealt combat damage by one or more creatures you control,
if that player lost less than 8 life this turn, they lose life equal to the difference"). The user's
`scripts/step15-lolth-multiplayer-tests.py` adds `LolthSpiderQueenTest#emblemTriggersForEachDamagedOpponent` (one
Grizzly Bears attacks the first opponent and another the second at once: both end at 12). It passes at HEAD
`bffb471e0c`: `CombatDamageService` calls `checkEmblemCombatDamageTriggers` once for each player dealt combat damage
(and each controller of the creatures that dealt it), and each entry reads only its player (run 17y4). No engine
change. At `fa4e7f0c08` (before run 17y4), in `/mnt/ramdisk/mv-head` with run 17y4's and this script's tests applied, it
fails: 14 instead of 12. The emblem already triggered once for each damaged opponent there, but each trigger counted
every opponent's life lost and made every opponent lose life (`LifeLostThisTurn(OPPONENTS)`, `EACH_OPPONENT`), so both
opponents ended at 14: the values, not the triggering, were wrong, and run 17y4's rules fix corrected them. The test is right as written; the script is unchanged.

**Sower of Discord** ("Whenever damage is dealt to one of the chosen players, the other chosen player also loses that
much life"). Run 17y4 put it on `Triggers.sourceDealsDamageToPermanentOrPlayer()`, once for each source and recipient,
so two creatures hitting a chosen player in one combat damage step made two triggers (run 17y4's Findings noted it).
CR 603.2c (checked): "An ability triggers only once each time its trigger event occurs. However, it can trigger
repeatedly if one event contains multiple occurrences"; the event is damage being dealt to the player, and all combat
damage of a step is dealt simultaneously (CR 510.2, checked). The analogous Boros Reckoner ruling (checked with
`get_rulings`, GTC 215): "If Boros Reckoner is dealt damage by multiple sources at once, such as by two creatures
blocking it, its ability triggers once and one target is dealt that much damage." So it triggers once for each chosen
player and damage event, "that much" the total. Sower's four rulings (checked) are unchanged by this; Ghyrson Starn
("whenever another source you control deals exactly 1 damage to a permanent or player") is about each source and stays
on the per-source-and-recipient trigger.

**The model.**

- `DamageTrigger.DamageEvent` gained `PLAYER_DEALT_DAMAGE` (damage is dealt to a player, whoever deals it: once for
  each player and damage event, the total the event's value); `damagedPlayerFilter` is allowed on it too, and a
  `PLAYER_DEALT_DAMAGE` trigger takes no relation but `ANY` and no `filter` (it names no source). New
  `Triggers.playerDealtDamage()` and `DamageWatch.ON_PLAYER_DEALT_DAMAGE`.
- New `TriggerCollectionService.checkPlayerDealtDamageTriggers(gameData, playerId, damage)`: every permanent's printed
  abilities on the watch, the damaged-player filter judged with the watcher as the predicate's source, the intervening
  "if" and event condition with the player as the context's target and the damage as the event value, then
  `queueDamageRecipientAbility` (the player the entry's non-targeting `targetId` and triggering player, the damage its
  event value, the watcher's snapshot), as the per-recipient collector does.
- Combat: `CombatDamageService.finishCombatDamageStep` calls it for each player dealt combat damage in the step
  (`combatDamageByPlayer`: the damage assigned to each player recipient and the damage redirected to one, summed over
  the sources), right after the "a source deals damage" reflections, before the state-based actions, so a Sower dealt
  lethal damage at the same time still triggers (its ruling); the entries go on the stack with those reflections, where
  Sower's were.
- Noncombat: `PendingSourceDamage` records the resolution damage event its damage was first dealt in
  (`rememberDamageEvent(GameData.openDamageEvent)` as `DamageSupport.accumulateSourceDamageForReflection` creates the
  batch; `getDamageEvent()`, kept by `copy()`), and `DamageSupport.flushSourceDamageReflections` sums each player's
  damage over the batches that share an event (a batch dealt outside a resolution damage event is one of its own) and
  calls the collector once for each player and event, after the batches' other reflections.
- No new `Card`, `StackEntry` or `GameData` state; `PendingSourceDamage` gained an immutable field, copied.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-sower-per-event-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module): Sower of Discord
`Triggers.playerDealtDamage().withDamagedPlayerFilter(new PlayerChosenBySourcePredicate())` + the same
`LoseLifeEffect(new EventValue(), LoseLifeRecipient.OTHER_CHOSEN_PLAYER)`. Other cards: only Sower and Ghyrson Starn
wrote the per-source-and-recipient triggers, and Ghyrson's Oracle text is about a source; no other card class names
"damage is dealt to …" as a trigger on that form (the grep's other hits are prevention and redirection shields, and
Vengeful Pharaoh's combat trigger).

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix: Sower of Discord triggers once for each chosen player and damage event, the other chosen player losing
  the total, not once for each source. The other player's life total is the same either way; the number of triggers
  (and what a trigger copier or a "triggers an additional time" effect does with them) changes. New card tests,
  failing at HEAD `bffb471e0c` in `/mnt/ramdisk/mv-head` and passing now:
  `SowerOfDiscordTest#combatDamageFromTwoCreaturesTriggersOnceForTheTotal` (two Grizzly Bears hit a chosen player at
  once: one "Sower of Discord's ability triggers." log line, two at HEAD; both chosen players end at 16) and
  `SowerOfDiscordTest#noncombatDamageFromTwoSourcesAtOnceTriggersOncePerPlayer` (Rakdos Charm's "each creature deals 1
  damage to its controller" with Sower and Grizzly Bears under the first chosen player and Grizzly Bears under the
  second: two triggers, three at HEAD; both end at 17). The harness resolves combat damage triggers with the step, so
  the trigger count is read from the game log, not the stack.
- Combat damage redirected to a chosen player (`CombatDamageState.redirectedCombatDamageToPlayers`) is now summed into
  the event, as the other per-recipient combat collectors sum it; the old per-source collector read only the damage
  assigned to players. Not covered by a test.

**Left, and noted.**

- A non-spell source's noncombat batch is keyed by its card for the whole resolution, so two separate damage events
  from one ability's source to the same player in one resolution still sum into one trigger (as they did for the old
  per-source trigger); no card is known to need them apart.
- The other "you / an opponent / enchanted player is dealt damage" collectors (`checkControllerDealtDamageTriggers`,
  `checkOpponentDealtDamageTriggers`, `checkEnchantedPlayerDealtDamageTriggers`) are still called once for each
  source in places; they are not in this follow-up's scope.

**The "done" check.** `scripts/step15-run17u-audit.py`: 123 lines, as at HEAD. Step 15 stays open: rows 17z and 17z2.

#### Run 17z: the cast family's trigger-condition records are filtered cast triggers with existing effects

Row 17z, split into 17z and 17zb. Read by site, the row is two families of different weight: the cast records, which a
filtered cast trigger and an existing effect express once the generic cast collector judges the filter and the effect
reads the stack entry's triggering spell (this run), and the emblems' enter and tap markers (Lukka, Chandra, Spark
Hunter, Koth, Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh), which need emblem readers for the enters and tap triggers that don't exist
yet (row 17zb). Reading `SpellCastTriggerCollectorService` whole also found class-keyed handlers that build their
effect from the event and that the row's count (and `step15-run17u-audit.py`, which doesn't match `manaValue`) missed:
they go to row 17zb too.

**When the value is read.** As the ability resolves (CR 608.2h, checked): the triggering spell is the live spell while
it is on the stack, else the entry's snapshot of it; the source's chosen colors are the source's on the battlefield,
else as it last existed there. "Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen color" (Prism Ring, Diamond Mare, Diamond
Knight) and "a [color] spell" (Titania's Chosen, Quirion Dryad) are trigger conditions (CR 603.2, checked), judged once,
as the spell is cast. Tablet of the Guilds' "if it's at least one of the chosen colors, you gain 1 life for each of the
chosen colors it is" is an intervening "if" (CR 603.4, checked): the filter judges it as the ability triggers, and the
count, read as it resolves, gains no life for a spell that is none of the colors any more (what the record's handler
did). Casualty's "when you cast this spell, if a casualty cost was paid for it, copy it" (CR 702.153a, checked) is an
intervening "if" as well; the payment can't change once the spell is cast, but it is written as the card says and
checked again from the trigger's entry, which records the spell's payment. Bloodbond March's "the same name as that
spell" and Don't Worry About It's "copy it" read the triggering spell as it resolves. Rulings (checked with
`get_rulings`): Tablet of the Guilds' (two different colors), Prism Ring and Diamond Mare have none; the casualty
rulings of A Little Chat and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary (one copy; the copy isn't cast; Ob Nixilis' copy has loyalty X,
isn't legendary and becomes a token).

**The model.**

- The cast records are the generic cast collector's filtered triggers (`Triggers.…CastsSpell().withFilter(…)`,
  `.withStackEntryFilter(…)`, `.anySpell()`, `.nthThisTurn(1)`): the collector judges the filter and puts the card's
  effect on the stack as written, the triggering spell recorded on the entry.
- `CardHasSourceChosenColorPredicate` matches a card of any of the source's chosen colors (`getChosenColors()`, which
  `setChosenColor` keeps in sync), so Tablet of the Guilds' two colors and the one-color cards share it.
- `TriggeringSpellChosenColorCount` lost its bound colors: it counts the triggering spell's effective colors among the
  context source's chosen colors (the live permanent, else the entry's snapshot). The generic cast collector snapshots
  the source for an effect that reads it (`effectReadsSourceChosenColors`, next to the existing snapshot rule), so the
  count survives the source leaving the battlefield.
- `EachPlayerReturnsCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffectHandler` reads its filter through
  `AmountEvaluationService.bindTriggeringSpellName` (now public), so `CardSharesNameWithTriggeringSpellPredicate` is the
  triggering spell's name as the ability resolves.
- New `StackEntryIsCardEnchantedBySourcePredicate` (sealed `StackEntryPredicate`): the spell whose card the source Aura
  is attached to, judged by `TargetLegalityService` with the source; `PredicateEvaluationService` matches nothing.
- New condition `CasualtyCostPaid`, read from the new `ConditionContext.casualtyCostPaid` (`forStackEntry` reads
  `StackEntry.isCasualtyCostPaid()`; the 39-component constructor keeps `false`). `TriggerCollectionService
  .recordTriggeringSpell` copies the spell's casualty payment onto the self-cast copy trigger's entry, as it copies the
  X and the repeatable payments, so the wrapped `ConditionalEffect` sees it as it resolves.
- `CopyTriggeringSpellEffect` gained the component `startingLoyaltyFromX` (the 14-component constructor keeps `false`)
  and the wither `withStartingLoyaltyFromX()`, which its handler passes to `CopyControllerCastSpellEffect`.
- `GivePoisonCountersEffect` lost its `spellFilter` component (the trigger-descriptor use was Hand of the Praetors').
- Emblems: Jace, Unraveler of Secrets' emblem is `new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.opponentCastsSpell().nthThisTurn(1),
  new CounterSpellEffect())`, Garruk, Caller of Beasts' `new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.youCastSpell().withFilter(
  creature), new MayEffect(new SearchLibraryEffect(creature, BATTLEFIELD), prompt))`, both read by run 17h's
  `collectEmblemCastAbilities` (abilities of emblems function in the command zone, CR 114.4, checked); the cast loop's
  two marker branches are gone (Venser's marker stays).
- Discord, Lord of Disharmony's `DiscordCopyCastTriggerEffect` never triggered: `SpellCastingService
  .queueDiscordCopyAbility` puts the copied ability on the stack and removes the copy's link before the cast triggers
  are collected, so the handler always found no link. Jodah, the Unifier's `JodahTheUnifierTriggerEffect` had no card

- Gone: `PutPlusOnePlusOneCounterOnSourceOnColorSpellCastEffect`, `PutPlusOnePlusOneCounterOnSourceOnChosenColorSpellCastEffect`,
