#### Run 17zb: the emblems' enter and tap abilities are emblem `TriggeredAbility`s, and Sunbird's Invocation and Kiora, Sovereign of the Deep read the triggering spell

Row 17zb, split into 17zb and 17zb2. Read by site, the row is the emblems' markers, which need two emblem readers and
then convert as run 17h's cast abilities did, and the cast collector's class-keyed handlers that build their effect from
the event. Two of those (Sunbird's Invocation, Kiora, Sovereign of the Deep) are the shape run 17w gave Rashmi: a mana
value bound into the reveal effect, which a fieldless effect reads from the stack entry's triggering spell. The other six
each need a model of their own (a graveyard target restricted by the triggering spell's name and chosen as the ability
goes on the stack; a token copy of the spell's targets with their last-known cards; "targets only a single creature" and
"that creature"; the Aura's enchanted card; the card-advantage snapshot the spell's resolution reads back; Flurry's effect
"if"), so they go to row 17zb2. Reading the emblem loops also found two enter markers the row didn't name, Kiora, Master
of the Depths' and Nissa, Vital Force's, read by the same class-keyed loops; they are done here, so no emblem has an
enters or tap marker left.

**When the value is read.** Abilities of emblems function in the command zone (CR 114.4, checked); an emblem is a marker
in the command zone (CR 114.1, checked), not a card or token on the battlefield, so it isn't a permanent (CR 110.1,
checked). "Whenever a [filter] you control enters" triggers as the permanent enters (CR 603.6a, checked), the filter
judged on the permanent as it is then; a targeted ability's target is chosen as it goes on the stack (CR 603.3d,
checked); a "you may" is asked as it resolves (CR 603.5, checked). Lukka, Wayward Bonder's "it deals damage equal to its
power" is the entering creature dealing the damage with its power as the ability resolves (CR 608.2h, checked), as
Pyrogoyf's ability already is. Sunbird's Invocation's and Kiora's X is the triggering spell's mana value as the ability
resolves: the live spell, else as it last existed on the stack (CR 608.2h). Rulings (checked with `get_rulings`): Sunbird's
Invocation's (the ability resolves even if the spell is countered; an X spell's mana value uses the chosen X; mana value
0 does nothing), Koth, Fire of Resistance's (the emblem is colorless: protection from red stops neither its target nor
its damage). Ancient Greenwarden's Oracle text (checked with `get_card`): "If a land entering causes a triggered ability
of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time."

**The model.**

- `TriggerCollectionService.checkEmblemEntersTriggers` (new), called by `EtbTriggerService.collectEntersTriggers` once for
  each entering permanent, right after the creature collector whose emblem loop it replaces: for each emblem's
  `TriggeredAbility` with an enters-the-battlefield `ZoneChangeTrigger`, the trigger's relation (`YOU_CONTROL`,
  `ANOTHER_YOU_CONTROL`, `OPPONENT_CONTROLS`, `ANY`, `ANOTHER`) is judged against the emblem's controller and its filter
  on the entering permanent (the filter context has the emblem's controller and source card). A matching ability goes on
  the stack once as one object of its effects (CR 603.3), the emblem's source card as its source (an emblem without one,
  which only a test builds, uses the entering card, as the removed branches did): a targeted one through the generic
  `SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget` choice with the entering permanent as its triggering permanent, any other one as a
  non-targeting entry described as "<card>'s emblem" with the triggering permanent, its controller and its card. An
  origin, cause, "during your turn", option or other relation throws.
- `collectEmblemTapTriggers` (replacing `collectEmblemArtifactTapTriggers` and its `@CollectsEmblemTrigger` handler): an
  emblem's `TapTrigger.TapEvent.BECOMES_TAPPED` ability, its relation, filter and qualifier judged on the tapped
  permanent, goes on the stack as a non-targeting entry with the tapped permanent as its triggering permanent; an option
  or a target throws.
- `checkAllyArtifactEntersTriggers` and the three emblem loops (creature, artifact, land) are gone, with the land
  collector's `countETBExtraTriggers` count, which only its emblem loop read, and `enteringLandHasEffectiveSubtype`.
- `SunbirdsInvocationRevealAndCastEffect` and `KioraSovereignOfTheDeepRevealAndCastEffect` lost their mana-value
  component: their handlers evaluate `TargetSpellManaValue` against the stack entry (the triggering spell the generic cast
  collector records, live or as its snapshot).
- `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffectHandler`: an effect whose source is the triggering permanent
  (`DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect.fromEnteringPermanent`, `sourceIsTriggeringPermanent`) whose permanent has left the
  battlefield is dealt by its departure snapshot (`GameData.departedPermanentSnapshots`, the last-known power
  `SourcePower` reads) before any snapshot the entry took as the ability triggered, and the damage's controller falls back
  to the permanent's departed controller (`departedPermanentControllerIds`).
- `PermanentChoiceTriggerHandlerService.handleSpellTargetTrigger` returns once input is awaited after the entry went on
  the stack: the becomes-the-target check there already begins the next waiting spell-target choice, and beginning
  another one replaced it, so with three or more waiting one was lost (see Behaviour changes).

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17zb-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 8 card classes:

- Lukka, Wayward Bonder (Mila, Crafty Companion's back face): `new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.enters(Triggers.CREATURE,
  ObjectRelation.YOU_CONTROL), DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect.fromEnteringPermanent(new SourcePower()))`;
- Chandra, Spark Hunter: `Triggers.enters(Triggers.ARTIFACT, YOU_CONTROL)` + `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(3)`; Koth, Fire
  of Resistance: `Triggers.enters(new PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(MOUNTAIN), YOU_CONTROL)` +
  `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(4)`;
- Kiora, Master of the Depths: `Triggers.enters(Triggers.CREATURE, YOU_CONTROL)` + `MayEffect(new
  EnteringCreatureFightsTargetCreatureEffect(), "Have it fight target creature?")`; Nissa, Vital Force:
  `Triggers.enters(Triggers.LAND, YOU_CONTROL)` + `MayEffect(new DrawCardEffect(1), "Draw a card?")`;
- Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh: `Triggers.permanentYouControlBecomesTapped().withFilter(Triggers.ARTIFACT)` +
  `DrawCardEffect(1)`;
- Sunbird's Invocation: `Triggers.youCastSpell().castFrom(Zone.HAND)` + `SunbirdsInvocationRevealAndCastEffect()`;
  Kiora, Sovereign of the Deep: the Kraken / Leviathan / Octopus / Serpent `CardAnyOfPredicate` filter,
  `.castFrom(Zone.HAND)` + `KioraSovereignOfTheDeepRevealAndCastEffect()`.

**Gone.** `DealDamageToAnyTargetOnAllyCreatureEntersEffect`, `EmblemArtifactEntersTriggerEffect`,
`DealDamageToAnyTargetOnControllerArtifactEntersEffect`, `DealDamageToAnyTargetOnAllyLandEntersEffect`,
`EmblemArtifactTapTriggerEffect`, `MayFightTargetCreatureOnAllyCreatureEntersEffect`, `DrawCardOnAllyLandEntersEffect`,
`SunbirdsInvocationTriggerEffect`, `KioraSovereignOfTheDeepTriggerEffect`; the cast collector's two handlers for the last
two, the emblem tap handler and the emblem loops above.

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix: Koth's and Nissa's emblems trigger once for a land entering under Ancient Greenwarden. The emblem land loop
  multiplied its triggers by `countETBExtraTriggers`, the number of "a triggered ability of a permanent you control
  triggers an additional time" effects, but an emblem isn't a permanent (CR 110.1). New card tests
  `KothFireOfResistanceTest#emblemTriggersOnceWithAncientGreenwarden` and
  `NissaVitalForceTest#emblemTriggersOnceWithAncientGreenwarden`, failing at HEAD `f7f57a8e16` in `/mnt/ramdisk/mv-head`
  (Koth's: a second target choice waits, 20 life instead of 16; Nissa's: a second "draw a card?") and passing now.
- Rules fix: three spell-target choices waiting together each put their ability on the stack (CR 603.3). After the first
  answer the becomes-the-target check began the second choice and the answer handler then began the third over it, so
  one triggered ability was lost. Reached at HEAD by Chandra, Spark Hunter's emblem with Confirm Suspicions' three Clues;
  with this run's emblem reader also by Kiora, Master of the Depths' three Octopuses, whose two emblem card tests failed
  until the fix. New card test `ChandraSparkHunterTest#emblemTriggersForEachOfThreeArtifactsEnteringInOneResolution`,
  failing at HEAD (the third choice never asked) and passing now.
- Lukka's emblem: the creature that entered and left the battlefield before the ability resolves still deals the damage,
  equal to its power as it last existed there (CR 608.2h, CR 113.7a, both checked: "the object as it exists—or as it most
  recently existed—that does it"; Lukka has no ruling on it). At HEAD the removed branch's entering-permanent choice
  snapshotted the creature as the ability went on the stack and dealt the damage; the generic choice took no snapshot, so
  before the handler change above this run dealt none (a regression caught by the new
  `MilaCraftyCompanionTest#lukkaEmblemCreatureThatLeftStillDealsDamageEqualToItsLastKnownPower`: Shock kills the Grizzly
  Bears in response, 2 damage; it passes at HEAD, failed here at 20 life, and passes now). The handler now reads the
  departure snapshot, the last-known information proper, where HEAD read the creature as it was when the ability went on
  the stack; they differ only if its power changed in between. Pyrogoyf's path already snapshotted its creature; the same
  handler change reads the departure snapshot for it too, guarded by the new
  `PyrogoyfTest#entryDamageUsesLastKnownPowerWhenPyrogoyfLeavesFirst` (Doom Blade in response, 3 damage; passes at HEAD
  and now). Wrathful Red Dragon and Wrathful Raptors, whose damage source is also the triggering permanent, deal the
  entry's X ("that much damage"), so the snapshot changes only which object deals it as it last existed.
- Lukka's and Kiora's (Master of the Depths) emblem abilities go through the generic spell-target choice instead of the
  entering-permanent and enters-target choices, and Nissa's "you may draw a card" is asked as the ability resolves from
  the stack (CR 603.5) instead of through the may queue. The converted cards' tests pass unchanged but Lukka's, which
  named the old choice class.
- The emblems' filters read the entering or tapped permanent through `PredicateEvaluationService`, where the branches
  read `isArtifact`, the effective subtypes or the creature check by hand; the same result in every case the tests cover.
- Sunbird's Invocation's and Kiora's X is read as the ability resolves; a spell's mana value doesn't change on the stack,
  so no test sees a difference.
- Otherwise none intended.

For step 16: no new `Card`, `StackEntry` or `GameData` state, two effect components removed, nothing new is

#### Run 17zb2: Loki, Spellweaver Volute, flurry and the targeted-spell token copies are filtered cast triggers reading the triggering spell

Row 17zb2, split into 17zb2 and 17zb3. Read by site, the row is four handlers whose effect an existing effect (or one
losing its bound component) expresses once it reads the stack entry's triggering spell (this run), and two that need a
model of their own: Harness the Storm's graveyard target restricted by the spell's name is chosen on a
`SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger` that carries no triggering spell (the choice, the graveyard target operation and the
entry it builds would all have to carry it, and the resolution check bind it), and Toofer, Keeper of the Full Grip's
"whenever a spell you control causes you to gain card advantage" is an event of the spell's resolution that the cast
collector only approximates (it binds a snapshot into the spell's post-resolution effects as the spell is cast, so a
spell you control but didn't cast, or a Toofer that arrives after the cast, is missed). Both go to row 17zb3, with
two rebuilds of the cast collector the row didn't name (Spellweaver Helix's bound exiled card, Bucket List's bound card
types).

**When the value is read.** "That spell" is the stack entry's triggering spell: the live spell while it is on the
stack, else as it last existed there (CR 608.2h, checked). An effect "if" ("copy that spell if it targets a permanent
or player") has its normal meaning and is checked as the ability resolves; an intervening "if" (Orvar's "if it targets
one or more other permanents you control") is checked as the ability triggers and again as it resolves (CR 603.4,
checked). Rulings (checked with `get_rulings`):

- Vesuvan Duplimancy: "If the target of the spell is changed after the triggered ability is put on the stack, the token
  that is created is a copy of the spell's original target, not the new target"; a token is created even if the spell
  was countered; a target that left is copied as it last existed on the battlefield.
- Orvar, the All-Form: the spell and its targets are checked again as the ability resolves, a target that left is
  ignored, a spell that left the stack is judged by the targets it had then; the token copies only permanents you
  control that are targets of the spell (the trigger says "other permanents").
- Loki, God of Lies has no rulings. "That creature" is the creature of the trigger event, the one the spell targeted
  as the ability triggered, read the way Vesuvan Duplimancy's ruling reads "that artifact or creature"; HEAD did the
  same (it bound the target as the ability triggered). Dack Fayden's emblem's "those permanents" (no ruling on a
  retargeted spell either) now reads the same targets, see Behaviour changes.
- Spellweaver Volute: the enchanted card is identified from the Aura as it last existed on the battlefield (both
  rulings of 2007-05-01), what the resolution handler already did.
- Shiko and Narset, Unified: a spell that targets a permanent or player must be copied; the ability and the copy
  resolve even if the original spell is countered before the copy is created.

**The model.**

- New condition `TriggeringSpellMatches(StackEntryPredicate)`: an effect "if" on the triggering spell, judged by
  `EffectResolutionService.isConditionMet` (it has the entry) against `CopySupport.triggeringSpell` with
  `TargetLegalityService.matchesStackEntryPredicate`, from the ability's controller and source (live, else its
  snapshot). `ConditionEvaluationService` has no triggering spell in its context and returns `false`, so the condition
  works on an ability's top-level `ConditionalEffect`s only.
- New condition `SpellCopiedThisWay` with `ResolutionResults.copiedSpell` (a fifth component) and
  `StackEntry.recordCopiedSpell`: `CopyTriggeringSpellEffectHandler` records `false` as it starts and `true` once it goes
  on to copy (no spell, or one that can't be copied, records `false`). With `NotCondition` it is "if you don't copy a
  spell this way".
- `CreateTokenCopyOfTargetedSpellPermanentEffect` is `(copyEffect, requiresTargetStillControlled)`: `spellSnapshot`,
  `triggerCondition`, `instantOrSorceryOnly` and `withSpellSnapshot` are gone. The handler reads the stack entry: with
  `requiresTargetStillControlled` (Orvar) the spell as it resolves (`CopySupport.triggeringSpell`) and only a target
  other than the source still under the controller's control; otherwise (Vesuvan Duplimancy) the entry's
  `getTriggeringSpellSnapshot()` (its targets as the ability triggered), a target that left copied from its departure
  snapshot (`GameData.departedPermanentSnapshots`, looked up by the permanent's id) where the collector used to remember
  its card as the ability triggered.
- `CopyEnchantedInstantAndMayCastCopyEffect` gained a no-argument constructor (the card's form); the resolution
  handler no longer falls back to the effect's bound id, so the id is only the copy's may ability's, which the handler
  queues.
- `GainControlOfAllPermanentsMatchingEffectHandler`: `PermanentIsTargetOfTriggeringSpellPredicate`'s targets are the
  entry's triggering spell snapshot's (as the ability triggered), the live spell's only when no snapshot was kept; a
  `SequenceEffect` rider runs its steps and a `ConditionalEffect` rider runs when its condition holds
  (`ConditionEvaluationService` with the entry's context), so "if it's your turn, untap that creature and it gains
  haste" is a rider of the control effect.
- `TargetLegalityService.targetsAnyMatchingPermanent` (`StackEntryTargetsPermanentPredicate`) judges its filter with the
  ability's source in the filter context (`withSourcePermanentId`, `withSourceCardId`), so "another permanent you
  control" (`PermanentNotPredicate(new PermanentIsSourcePermanentPredicate())`) can be a stack-entry filter. The
  filter context had no source before, so a predicate on the source matched nothing there.
- `SpellCastTriggerCollectorService`: the handlers of `SpellweaverVoluteTriggerEffect`, `FlurryCopyOrDrawTriggerEffect`,
  `GainControlOfTargetCreatureWhenSingleTargetSpellCastEffect` and `CreateTokenCopyOfTargetedSpellPermanentEffect`, and
  `soleCreatureTargetId`, are gone; the generic cast collector puts each card's ability on the stack as written, the
  triggering spell recorded on the entry.
- Gone: `SpellweaverVoluteTriggerEffect`, `FlurryCopyOrDrawTriggerEffect`,
  `GainControlOfTargetCreatureWhenSingleTargetSpellCastEffect`.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17zb2-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 5 card classes:

- Loki, God of Lies: `Triggers.youCastSpell().withStackEntryFilter(new StackEntryTargetsOnlySingleCreaturePredicate())`
  + `GainControlOfAllPermanentsMatchingEffect(new PermanentIsTargetOfTriggeringSpellPredicate(), END_OF_TURN, new
  ConditionalEffect(new ControllerTurn(), SequenceEffect.of(new UntapPermanentsEffect(TARGET), new
  GrantKeywordEffect(HASTE, GrantScope.TARGET))))`;
- Spellweaver Volute: `Triggers.youCastSpell().withFilter(new CardTypePredicate(SORCERY))` + `MayEffect(new
  CopyEnchantedInstantAndMayCastCopyEffect(), …)` (the prompt the collector wrote);
- Shiko and Narset, Unified: `Triggers.youCastSpell().nthThisTurn(2)` + `ConditionalEffect(new TriggeringSpellMatches(
  targets a permanent or a player), new CopyTriggeringSpellEffect())` + `ConditionalEffect(new NotCondition(new
  SpellCopiedThisWay()), new DrawCardEffect())`;
- Vesuvan Duplimancy: `withStackEntryFilter(its single-target condition)` + `CreateTokenCopyOfTargetedSpellPermanentEffect(
  CreateTokenCopyOfTargetPermanentEffect.nonLegendary(…))`;
- Orvar, the All-Form: `withFilter(instant or sorcery).withStackEntryFilter(new StackEntryTargetsPermanentPredicate(
  another permanent you control))` + `CreateTokenCopyOfTargetedSpellPermanentEffect()`.

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix: Vesuvan Duplimancy copies the spell's original target when the spell is redirected before the ability
  resolves (its ruling above). The handler read the live spell's targets, so it copied the new one. New card test
  `VesuvanDuplimancyTest#copiesTheOriginalTargetAfterTheSpellIsRedirected` (Giant Growth on your Grizzly Bears,
  Deflection to the opponent's Isamaru), failing at HEAD `b1767b0491` in `/mnt/ramdisk/mv-head` (an Isamaru token) and
  passing now.
- Rules fix: Orvar, the All-Form doesn't offer itself as the permanent to copy when the spell targets it and another
  permanent you control ("other permanents"). The collector excluded Orvar only from the trigger condition, and the
  resolution handler offered every target still under your control. New card test
  `OrvarTheAllFormTest#copiesTheOtherTargetWhenTheSpellAlsoTargetsOrvar` (Into the Void on Orvar and Grizzly Bears),
  failing at HEAD (a permanent choice of both) and passing now.
- Dack Fayden's emblem's "those permanents" are the spell's targets as the ability triggered, where the handler read
  the live spell first (the same reading as Loki's "that creature" and Vesuvan Duplimancy's ruling). It differs only
  when the spell is redirected before the ability resolves; no test covered it, and none does now.
- Flurry's "if it targets a permanent or player" is read as the ability resolves (an effect "if"), not as it triggers:
  a spell redirected, or whose permanent target left the battlefield, before the ability resolves is judged as it is
  then. A countered spell is judged as it last existed on the stack (the new guard
  `ShikoAndNarsetUnifiedTest#copiesASpellTargetingAPermanentAfterItIsCountered`, passing at HEAD and now).
- Spellweaver Volute triggers on any sorcery you cast and goes on the stack; whether the Aura enchants an instant card
  is read as it resolves (its "you may" is still asked, then no copy is made), where the handler didn't trigger at all. A sorcery copy you
  cast also triggers it now (a cast copy is a cast spell).
- Vesuvan Duplimancy copies a departed target from its departure snapshot, the permanent as it last existed on the
  battlefield, where the collector remembered its card as the ability triggered; they differ only if its copiable
  values changed in between.
- The entries are the generic collector's (the caster as the non-targeting "that player", the triggering spell
  recorded); Loki's entry no longer has the creature as its `targetId`.
- Otherwise none intended.

For step 16: `ResolutionResults` gained a component, `CreateTokenCopyOfTargetedSpellPermanentEffect` lost three; two new
conditions; no new `Card`, `StackEntry` (beyond the scratchpad component) or `GameData` state; nothing new is slot-keyed.

**Left, and noted.**

- Row 17zb3 (new): Harness the Storm, Toofer, Keeper of the Full Grip, Spellweaver Helix and Bucket List (above).
- `TriggeringSpellMatches` is judged only on an ability's top-level `ConditionalEffect`; inside a `MayEffect` or a

- The departure snapshots are keyed by card, so a target whose card left the battlefield twice this turn finds only the

#### Run 17zb3: Harness the Storm, Toofer, Spellweaver Helix and Bucket List read the triggering spell

Row 17zb3, not split. Read by site, the row is the cast collector's last four class-keyed handlers that built their
effect from the event: two markers whose effect an existing effect expresses once a choice or a condition reads the
triggering spell (Harness the Storm, Spellweaver Helix), one effect losing its bound component (Bucket List), and one
marker standing for an event the cast collector only approximated (Toofer, Keeper of the Full Grip), which needs a
trigger of its own.

**When the value is read.** "That spell" is the stack entry's triggering spell: the live spell while it is on the
stack, else as it last existed there (CR 608.2h, checked). A target is chosen as the ability goes on the stack
(CR 603.3d, checked), so Harness the Storm's "target card with the same name as that spell" is chosen against the spell
as it was cast and checked again, with the cast it offers, against the spell as the ability resolves. Spellweaver
Helix's "if it has the same name as one of the cards exiled with this artifact" is an intervening "if" (CR 603.4,
checked): checked as the ability triggers and again as it resolves. Bucket List's "a spell of a type showing" is the
trigger condition (CR 603.2, checked), judged once, as the spell is cast; "that type" is the spell's as the ability
triggered. Toofer's "whenever a spell you control causes you to gain card advantage" triggers when that event happens
(CR 603.2): as the spell finishes resolving (CR 608.2n, checked, for an instant or sorcery; CR 608.3, checked, for a
permanent spell), with Toofer on the battlefield then, whoever cast the spell and whether it was cast at all (a copy
of a spell isn't cast but is a spell, CR 707.10, checked). Rulings (checked with `get_rulings`):

- Harness the Storm: the target is chosen immediately after the spell is cast; if the spell from hand is countered in
  response, the target card can still be cast as the ability resolves; the cast is chosen as it resolves, costs paid.
- Toofer, Keeper of the Full Grip (read on MB2 554; the MB2 318 printing isn't in the data feeds): card advantage is determined by what
  actually happens as the spell resolves, comparing the cards you and your opponents have with those before it
  resolved (Divination from hand: one card lost, two gained); "abilities that cause you to gain card advantage won't
  cause Toofer's ability to trigger, even if those abilities trigger from casting spells".
- Spellweaver Helix: the copy and the cast are both optional; one copy when both imprinted cards have the same name;
  nothing when only one card is imprinted or the card to copy left exile; the Helix leaving the battlefield doesn't
  stop the copy (last-known information); "a split card has the same name as a spell if either of its names is that
  spell's name".
- Bucket List (read on CMB1 89; MB1 89 isn't in the data feeds): the tracker list isn't on the permanent's characteristics and its counters can't be moved; a
  copy starts with an empty list; a spell with several card types puts a counter over each of them.

**The model.**

- New `SpellTrigger.SpellEvent.CAUSES_CARD_ADVANTAGE` and `Triggers.yourSpellCausesYouToGainCardAdvantage()`, read
  by the new `SpellAbilityWatch.ON_CONTROLLER_SPELL_CAUSES_CARD_ADVANTAGE`: `TriggerCollectionService
  .checkSpellCardAdvantageTriggers` dispatches it to the permanents the spell's controller controls, and
  `dispatchSpellWatch` hands such an ability (printed or granted, ability loss judged) to `collectCardAdvantageAbility`,
  which judges its limit around `SpellCastTriggerCollectorService.collectCardAdvantageAbility`: the ability goes on the
  stack as written, one non-targeting object (CR 603.3, checked), the spell its triggering spell
  (`TriggerContext.SpellCardAdvantage`). An intervening "if", event condition, multiplicity or target throws.
- `StackEntry.postResolutionEffects` is now `cardCountsBeforeResolution` (immutable, shared by copies):
  `CardAdvantagePostResolutionService.snapshotBeforeResolution` records each player's cards in hand and nontoken
  permanents as every spell (not an ability) begins to resolve, one more for its owner when it was cast from hand
  (`GameData.wasSpellCastFromHandThisTurn`, a copy never), what the cast collector used to bind into Toofer's marker;
  `causedCardAdvantage` takes them as the spell finishes resolving (the three completion paths that read the marker
  before), and `StackResolutionService.collectCardAdvantageTriggers` calls the new reader when the controller's gain is
  greater than the opponents' together.
- `PermanentChoiceContext.SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger` gained `triggeringSpell` (a copy of the spell's stack entry) and
  `withTriggeringSpell`; the generic cast collector's graveyard-target branch sets it. `TriggeredAbilityQueueService
  .processNextSpellGraveyardTargetTrigger` binds the target filter's `CardSharesNameWithTriggeringSpellPredicate` to it,
  `GraveyardTargetOperationState.triggeringSpell` (copied by `simulationFrameCopy`) keeps it through the choice, and
  `GraveyardChoiceHandlerService` (and the no-target path) records it on the entry as its triggering card and spell.
- `AmountEvaluationService.bindTriggeringSpellName` is static, with an overload for a spell not yet on an entry (its
  card id, else the snapshot's); a filter without the predicate comes back as the same instance.
  `CastTargetInstantOrSorceryFromGraveyardEffect` gained `withFilter`: its resolution handler offers the cast with the
  filter bound to the spell as it resolves, and `TargetLegalityService.isTargetCardLegalOnResolution` checks the target
  the same way (the validators had no entry, so the predicate matched nothing there).
- The generic cast collector judges a `TriggeringSpellMatches` intervening "if" on the triggering spell as it triggers
  (`matchesCastSpellPredicate`, from the ability's source), where `ConditionEvaluationService` has no spell and read
  `false`; the `ConditionalEffect` around each effect checks it again as the ability resolves, the source live or as
  the entry snapshotted it.
- `CopyImprintedCardAndMayCastCopyEffect` lost `matchingExiledCardId`: `otherExiledCard()` copies every card exiled
  with the source but the first with the triggering spell's name, read as it resolves, and nothing when none has it.
- `TrackCastSpellCardTypesEffect` lost `castTypes`: its handler marks the tracked types of the entry's triggering spell
  as it was when the ability triggered; it is a `SourcePermanentSnapshotRequiredEffect`, so the generic collector
  snapshots the source as the handler collector did. New `StackEntryHasTypeShowingOnSourceTrackerPredicate(types)`
  (sealed `StackEntryPredicate`, judged by `TargetLegalityService` with the source; `PredicateEvaluationService` matches
  nothing): a spell with a tracked type the source's tracker list has no counter over, a list kept for another card
  empty, as the handler resets it.
- `SpellCastTriggerCollectorService`: the handlers of `TrackCastSpellCardTypesEffect`, `SpellweaverHelixTriggerEffect`,
  `CardAdvantageSpellCastTriggerEffect` and `CastSameNameCardFromGraveyardOnSpellCastEffect`, and
  `snapshotCardResources`, are gone.
- Gone: `CardAdvantageSpellCastTriggerEffect`, `SpellweaverHelixTriggerEffect`,
  `CastSameNameCardFromGraveyardOnSpellCastEffect`.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17zb3-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 4 card classes:

- Harness the Storm: `Triggers.youCastSpell().withFilter(instant or sorcery).castFrom(Zone.HAND)` +
  `CastTargetInstantOrSorceryFromGraveyardEffect(CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD, false, false, new
  CardSharesNameWithTriggeringSpellPredicate())`;
- Toofer, Keeper of the Full Grip: `Triggers.yourSpellCausesYouToGainCardAdvantage()` + `LoseLifeEffect(2,
  LoseLifeRecipient.EACH_OPPONENT)`;
- Spellweaver Helix: `Triggers.playerCastsSpell().withStackEntryFilter(new StackEntryNotPredicate(new
  StackEntryIsCopyPredicate(true)))` (a cast copy isn't a card), `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(new
  TriggeringSpellMatches(new StackEntrySharesNameWithCardExiledWithSourcePredicate()))` + `MayEffect(
  CopyImprintedCardAndMayCastCopyEffect.otherExiledCard(), …)` (the prompt the handler wrote);
- Bucket List: `Triggers.youCastSpell().withStackEntryFilter(new StackEntryHasTypeShowingOnSourceTrackerPredicate(
  types))` + `TrackCastSpellCardTypesEffect(types)`.

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix: Toofer triggers for a copy of a spell you control that gives you card advantage. The marker was bound as
  the spell was cast, and a copy isn't cast. New card test `TooferKeeperOfTheFullGripTest
  #triggersForACopyOfASpellYouControl` (Twincast on Divination: both resolve with card advantage, 16 life), failing at
  HEAD `f887e9a647` in `/mnt/ramdisk/mv-head` (18) and passing now.
- Rules fix: Toofer triggers when it is on the battlefield as the spell resolves though it wasn't as the spell was cast.
  New card test `#triggersWhenItArrivesAfterTheSpellWasCast` (18 life), failing at HEAD (20) and passing now.
- Rules fix: Spellweaver Helix does nothing when the exiled card with the cast card's name left exile before the
  ability resolves (the intervening "if", CR 603.4). The handler checked it only as the ability triggered and bound the
  card's id, so it still copied the other. New card test `SpellweaverHelixTest
  #doesNothingIfTheMatchingImprintedCardLeavesExileFirst`, failing at HEAD (its "you may copy" asked) and passing now.
- Rules fix: Bucket List doesn't trigger for a spell of no type showing on it (CR 603.2). The handler put the ability on
  the stack for every spell you cast, and it did nothing. New card test `BucketListTest
  #doesNotTriggerForASpellOfNoShowingType` (a second Darksteel Relic: only the spell on the stack), failing at HEAD
  (the ability too) and passing now.
- Toofer's ability goes on the stack through the dispatch path, so an effect that makes a triggered ability of a
  permanent trigger an additional time applies to it; no test covers it.
- Harness the Storm's choice is the generic graveyard-target choice (with the source permanent and the limit flags);
  the name is read from the spell as it resolves, so a spell countered in response is read as it last existed on the
  stack (the guard `HarnessTheStormTest#castsTheTargetAfterTheHandSpellIsCountered`, its ruling, passing at HEAD and now).
- Spellweaver Helix's "the other" is chosen as the ability resolves by the spell's name, where the handler bound the
  matching card as it triggered; they differ only when the exiled cards changed in between.

#### Run 17z2: the death, life-gain and crew trigger-condition records are abilities with existing effects reading the stack entry

Row 17z2, split into 17z2 and 17z3 to 17z6. Read by site, the row is seven families that share nothing but the shape
of the rebuild, and most need plumbing of their own: the death records (an existing effect expresses each once it
reads the entry's triggering permanent controller), the life-gain and crew records (their condition is a filter the
trigger couldn't write yet: "a white instant or sorcery spell causes you to gain life", "Tiana or another legendary
creature you control crews a Vehicle"), `DiscardCardThenEffect.useEntryTarget()`'s bindings (dead code by now), and
four that need a model or a reader of their own: the attack and enlist records (an emblem attack reader, an enlist
trigger, and Aradesh, the Founder's ability, which its Oracle text writes as an attack trigger with an intervening
"if", not an enlist trigger), the played-name and land-tap records (a cast or land-play filter on a card exiled with
the source, and the triggered mana abilities' rebuilds), and the draw records (Rowen's and Booby Trap's static reveals
with an ability `DrawService` builds, and the draw collector's drawn-card bindings the row didn't name). This run takes
the first four; rows 17z3 to 17z6 take the rest. Reading the death collector whole also found Fecundity's
dying-controller draw, the same rebuild as Bereavement's and Earthlink's (`MayEffect.forPlayer` with the dying
creature's controller bound in); it moved with them.

**When the value is read.** "Its controller" / "that creature's controller" of a creature that died is the controller
of the creature as it last existed on the battlefield (CR 608.2h, checked): the death collector records the dying
creature as the entry's triggering permanent and its controller as it died, so the effect reads the player the
records' handlers bound as the ability triggered (a permanent that comes back is a new object with a new id, so the
live lookup finds nothing). "Whenever a white instant or sorcery spell causes you to gain life" and "when Tiana or
another legendary creature you control crews a Vehicle" are trigger conditions (CR 603.2, checked), judged once, as
the life is gained or the crew cost is paid (CR 702.122a, checked), as the records' handlers judged them. "That
Vehicle" is the entry's triggering permanent, read as the ability resolves (live, else as it last existed).
Fecundity's "may" was already asked as the ability resolved (its handler put a `MayEffect` on the stack, CR 603.5,
checked), and still is; no card of this run moves its may question. Rulings (checked with `get_rulings`):

- Bereavement: a player with no cards in hand discards nothing.
- Fecundity: in a multiplayer game, a player who loses the game takes their triggered abilities off the stack with
  them, so the dying creature's controller doesn't draw.
- Firesong and Sunspeaker: the ability can't target a planeswalker or battle; a spell causes the life gain when its
  cost or effect instructs you to gain life or a source with lifelink it instructs to deal damage does; a white spell
  you don't control triggers it; "for each" life is one event; a red and white spell that deals damage and gains life
  triggers it twice; a triggered ability of a white instant or sorcery card (Renewed Faith cycled) doesn't trigger it.
- Earthlink, Burning Sands, Tiana, Angelic Mechanic: no rulings.

**The model.**

- New `DiscardRecipient.TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER`: the controller of the stack entry's triggering permanent
  (`GameQueryService.findTriggeringPermanentController`: live on the battlefield, else as it last existed there)
  discards without targeting; `DiscardEffectHandler` and `DiscardCardThenEffectHandler.resolveDiscardPlayer` read it
  (`DiscardHandEffect` doesn't take it).
- `LifeTrigger` gained the component `spellFilter` and the wither `causedBySpell(CardPredicate)` ("whenever a [filter]
  spell causes you to gain life"; only `GAINS` takes one; the three-component constructor keeps `null`); `watchKey()`
  drops it. `LifeAbilityReader.LifeEffect` carries it (`spellFilter()`), the reader rejects it on a trigger of a
  player other than "you", and `requireNothingToJudge` throws on it (new `requireNoSpellFilter`).
  `TriggerCollectionService.checkLifeGainTriggers` judges it as the ability triggers (`lifeGainCausedBySpell`): the
  life gain's source card matches the filter and its source isn't a triggered or activated ability, what the record's
  handler judged.
- `ObjectActionTrigger` gained the component `objectFilter` (a `PermanentPredicate` on the object that takes the
  action; only `CREWS_VEHICLE` takes one; the four-component constructor keeps `null`) and the wither
  `withObjectFilter`; `watchKey()` drops it. `MiscAbilityReader.MiscEffect` carries it (`objectFilter()`), one
  ability's conditions must agree on it, and `requireNothingToJudge` throws on it. `TriggerCollectionService
  .dispatchMiscAbility` judges it for `MiscWatch.ON_ALLY_CREATURE_CREWS_VEHICLE` on the crewing creature, from the
  ability's source as the record's handler did, and the new `collectCrewAbility` puts the ability on the stack as

- `DiscardCardThenEffect.useEntryTarget()`: `EnterTriggerCollectorService.handleEnterMay`'s binding of the entering

- `DeathTriggerCollectorService.handleAnyCreatureDeathMay` records the creature that died (its card, snapshot,

- Gone: `DyingCreatureControllerDiscardsCardEffect`, `DyingCreatureControllerSacrificesPermanentsEffect`,
  `DyingCreatureControllerMayDrawCardEffect`, `DealDamageOnSpellLifeGainEffect`,
  `PerpetuallyBoostVehicleWhenMatchingCreatureCrewsEffect`; the death collector's three handlers of them and

#### Run 17z3: the attack and enlist records are abilities, and the triggering permanent's mana value is read as the ability resolves

Row 17z3, split into 17z3 and 17z3b. Read by site, the row is five families: an emblem marker whose ability
`CombatAttackService` built from its fields (Garruk, Apex Predator), three records that rode the "an attacking
creature's ability triggers" event to find an enlistment (Guardian of New Benalia, Goblin Morale Sergeant, and
Benalish Knight-Counselor, which the row missed), Aradesh, the Founder's record, which its Oracle text writes as an
attack trigger, the `TriggeringPermanentManaValueEffect` binding, and the class-keyed equipment-attach routing. The
first four convert; the routing is a choice-flow question of its own (see Left, and noted), so it goes to row 17z3b.

**When the value is read.** Enlist is an optional cost to attack paid as the creature attacks (CR 702.154a, 702.154b,
508.1g, all checked), and "a creature enlists another creature when you pay the cost of the creature's enlist ability
by tapping the other creature" (CR 702.154c, checked): "whenever this creature enlists a creature" triggers then, the
enlisted creature its triggering permanent ("that creature", read as the ability resolves, else as it last existed,
CR 608.2h, checked). "Whenever a creature you control attacks" triggers as the creature is declared an attacker
(CR 508.3a, checked); Aradesh's "if it enlisted a creature this combat" is an intervening "if" (CR 603.4, checked),
judged as the ability triggers and again as it resolves, where the record triggered on the enlist ability and moved
its entry below it. Both abilities trigger during the declaration and go on the stack together, their controller
ordering them (CR 603.3b, checked). Abilities of emblems function in the command zone (CR 114.4, checked) and an emblem
isn't a permanent (CR 110.1, checked). "Its / that creature's mana value" is read as the ability resolves: the
permanent as it is, else as it last existed on the battlefield (CR 608.2h). Rulings (checked with `get_rulings`):

- Aradesh, the Founder: "Aradesh's last ability has an intervening if clause. If a creature that attacks hasn't
  enlisted a creature this combat, the ability won't trigger at all for that creature"; "it doesn't matter what
  happens to the enlisted creature after Aradesh's last ability triggers"; the enlist choice is made immediately after
  the attackers are tapped; the enlist boost is a triggered ability that goes on the stack after attackers are
  declared.
- Guardian of New Benalia: the scry "triggers whenever its controller taps another creature for Guardian of New
  Benalia's enlist ability"; one creature per enlist ability, and a creature can't be tapped for two.
- Garruk, Apex Predator: "the emblem's ability won't trigger if a creature attacks a planeswalker"; the emblem is the
  target opponent's.
- Arni Metalbrow: an attacking creature that isn't on the battlefield as the ability resolves uses its mana value from
  when it was last on the battlefield.
- Kodama of the East Tree: {X} in a mana cost is 0.
- Isshin, Two Heavens as One: it affects triggered abilities "with conditions that are directly related to
  attacking"; the ability triggers twice, it isn't copied. Delney, Streetwise Lookout: an ability that triggers an
  additional time isn't copied, and its choices are made separately for each instance.
- Goblin Morale Sergeant, Benalish Knight-Counselor, Junkyard Scrapper, Brainstealer Dragon: no rulings.

**The model.**

- New `CombatTrigger.CombatEvent.ENLISTS`, `Triggers.enlists()` and `CombatWatch.ON_ENLISTS`: "whenever this
  creature enlists a creature", `withFilter` the enlisted creature. `CombatAttackService.collectEnlistAbilities`, called
  by `addEnlistmentTriggers` right after each enlist trigger, reads the attacker's printed, temporary, persistent and

#### Run 17z3b: the equipment-attach routing reads the target groups, and the attach's "you may" is skipped by a property

Row 17z3b, not split. Read by site, the row is two class-keyed reads of `AttachTargetEquipmentToTriggeringPermanentEffect`:
`CombatAttackService`'s self-attack collector sent an ability with that effect (or a `MayEffect` wrapping it) to the
slot-by-slot `ETBTokenMultiTargetTrigger` choice where any other single static "up to N" group takes the
multi-permanent `AttackTriggerTargets` choice, and `MayEffectHandler` skipped that effect's "you may" when the entry had
no target. Of the six cards that construct the effect, only Armory Automaton reached the routing: Super-Soldier Serum's
ability is an Aura's, collected by `CombatTriggerService`; Amy Rose has two target groups, which take the slot-by-slot
choice anyway; Kemba, Kha Enduring's and Sokka and Suki's are enters abilities; Captain America, First Avenger only
imports it.

**What run 17z3's failures were.** Re-measured with the routing removed and the old tests: the six failing Armory
Automaton cases are exactly the six attack cases, and each fails because it answers a slot-by-slot prompt
(`handlePermanentChosen` per Equipment, the player's own id to stop) where the multi-permanent choice asks for one
answer; with the `MayEffectHandler` skip also removed, `canChooseZeroEquipmentOnEntering` (the slot-by-slot enters
choice) fails too, the "you may" asked with nothing to attach. So the multi-permanent attack choice did not need to
declare its targets per group: for a single group `StackEntry.targetsForGroup` reads the whole flat list, and another
ability's groups are skipped by `isTargetGroupActive`. A per-group declaration (`targetGroupSizes` on the
`AttackTriggerTargets` entry) was written and reverted as observably inert, and a skip keyed on it ("the entry declared
its group sizes and has no target") was written and reverted as wrong: Aetherstorm Roc's "you may pay {E}{E}. If you
do, put a +1/+1 counter on it and tap up to one target creature" and Glorifier of Suffering's "you may sacrifice another
creature or artifact. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures" take the slot-by-slot
choice, record a group of none when no target is chosen, and must still be asked, since the payment or sacrifice and
Roc's counter happen without a target.

**The rules.** A triggered ability's targets are chosen as it goes on the stack, as for a spell (CR 603.3d, checked),
and a variable number of targets is announced before the targets (CR 601.2c, checked), so "any number of target
Equipment" may be none. The "you may" is chosen as the ability resolves (CR 603.5, checked); with no Equipment targeted
the choice changes nothing. Rulings (checked with `get_rulings`): Armory Automaton: "You can choose to target no
Equipment if you don't want to attach any … Because the ability is optional, you also don't have to attach the
Equipment it targets as you resolve the ability. However, you must either attach all of the target Equipment or attach
none of them"; "If Armory Automaton leaves the battlefield before its ability resolves, nothing happens to any of the
Equipment it targeted"; the enters and attack triggers are both its ability. Super-Soldier Serum and Amy Rose: no
rulings.

**The model.**

- `CombatAttackService`'s self-attack collector: `attachesEquipment` (the class check and its `MayEffect` unwrap) is
  gone; a single static "up to N" group takes `AttackTriggerTarget` and its multi-permanent choice whatever its effect,
  every other optional, dynamic or multi-group ability the slot-by-slot choice, as before.
- New `CardEffect.actsOnlyOnItsTargets()` (default `false`): everything the effect does is done to its declared
  targets, so with none chosen it does nothing. `AttachTargetEquipmentToTriggeringPermanentEffect` returns `true`.
  `MayEffectHandler` skips a "you may" whose wrapped effect says so when the entry has no declared target and no
  single target, the condition its class check used, so the skip covers the same entries. A composite (a
  `SequenceEffect`, a "pay / sacrifice … then" effect) keeps the default and is asked.

**Cards.** No card class changed (no script): Armory Automaton keeps `MayEffect(new
AttachTargetEquipmentToTriggeringPermanentEffect(), …)` on both triggers; its enters ability keeps the slot-by-slot
choice of the enters collector, its attack ability takes the multi-permanent one.

**Behaviour changes.**

- Armory Automaton's attack ability asks for all its Equipment in one multi-permanent choice (up to every legal
  Equipment, none allowed) instead of one prompt per Equipment; the same targets, the same "you may" on resolution,
  and the same skip when none was chosen. No card moves its "you may" question.
- No rules fix; nothing read as the ability triggers is read differently as it resolves, so there's no new
  last-known-information case (the departed-Automaton case, `equipmentStaysOnItsPreviousCreatureWhenAutomatonLeavesBeforeResolution`,
  passes on the new choice).

For step 16: `CardEffect` gained `actsOnlyOnItsTargets()`; no new `Card`, `StackEntry` or `GameData` state, no record
or collector gone (two class-keyed sites).

#### Run 17z4: the played-name and land-tap records are abilities whose existing effects read the stack entry

Row 17z4, split into 17z4 and 17z4b. Read by site, the row is two families: the trigger-condition records
`PlayedCardNameTriggerCollectorService` and `LandTapTriggerCollectorService` read by class (four played-name records
and wrappers, three land-tap `triggeredEffect()` records), which only need a trigger filter the collectors can judge and
the card's effect on the stack as written; and the land-tap collector's `AddManaOfTypeProducedByTappedPermanentEffect`
rebuilds for a colour choice in progress, which need the triggered mana abilities' own mana effects resolved by
handlers that read the entry's produced mana colours (today the collector resolves each inline, by class), plus a rules
question (below). This run takes the first; row 17z4b the second, with Sasaya's Essence's rebuild the row missed.

**When the value is read.** "Whenever a player plays a card exiled with this" and "whenever you play a card with the
same name as one of the exiled cards" are trigger conditions (CR 603.2, checked), judged once, as the card is cast or
the land played, as the handlers judged them: the card has left exile by then, so the cast and land-play collectors
read the source it was exiled with from the event (`TriggerContext.SpellCast` / `LandPlayed.exiledSourcePermanentId`).
"That name" and "that card's owner" are the triggering card's, read as the ability resolves: the triggering spell live
on the stack or as it last existed there (CR 608.2h, checked; the entry's snapshot), else the land played, which the
land-play collector now records as the entry's triggering card (`StackEntry.setTriggeringCards`). A name and an owner
don't change, so nothing the handlers baked as the ability triggered is read differently. The land-tap conditions
("an opponent taps", "an Island", "a nonbasic land", "a Mountain") are judged as the land is tapped, as the records'
handlers judged them; "that player" is the tapping player, "that land" the tapped land, as before. A triggered mana
ability (CR 605.1b, checked) doesn't use the stack and resolves at once (CR 605.4a, checked): Overabundance's and
Barbflare Gremlin's mana and damage still resolve inside the collector; Manabarbs', Tember City's, Scald's, Burning
Earth's, Sanctimony's and Vorinclex's abilities can't add mana, so they use the stack (Manabarbs' ruling). Only a
permanent's controller activates its mana abilities (CR 602.2, checked), so "an opponent taps a land" is judged on the
tapping player, who controls the land. Sanctimony's "you may" was already asked as the ability resolved (CR 603.5,
checked), and still is; no card of this run moves its may question. Rulings (checked with `get_rulings`):

- Prowl, Stoic Strategist: the draw ability triggers only while Prowl is on the battlefield as Prowl, Stoic Strategist
  (its back face has no such ability); convert is transform.
- Search the City: to "play a card" is to play it as a land or cast it as a spell; one card per card played; if it isn't
  sacrificed (destroyed in response), there is no extra turn.
- Voltaic Visionary: a spell played this way transforms it before the spell resolves.
- Share the Spoils, The Matrix of Time: normal timing for the exiled cards; one land or one spell per turn (Share the
  Spoils).
- Manabarbs, Burning Earth: not a mana ability, it uses the stack; one trigger per land tapped; triggers from taps while
  casting wait and go on the stack above the spell.
- Overabundance: the damage is dealt even if the land produced no mana; it's a mana ability and can't be responded to.
- Barbflare Gremlin: its last ability is a mana ability.
- Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger: one of several types produced; if it leaves after its second ability triggered, the
  ability still resolves.
- Sanctimony: gaining life is optional. Scald, Tember City: no rulings.

**The model.**

- New `SpellTrigger.exiledWithThis()`: `castFrom(Zone.EXILE)` with the stack-entry filter
  `StackEntryIsCardExiledWithSourcePredicate`, which the cast collector judges from the cast event's exile source; it
  now takes a face-up plane as the source too (`match.sourcePlanarObject()`), where it took only a permanent.
- `LandPlayTrigger` gained the component `exiledWithSource` and the wither `exiledWithThis()` (`playedFrom(Zone.EXILE)`
  and exiled with the ability's source; the four-component constructor keeps `false`; another zone with it throws);
  `filtered()` counts it, so the land-play collector reads such an ability itself.
  `PlayedCardNameTriggerCollectorService.collectLandPlayAbility` judges it from the event (the permanent or the face-up
  plane), and its entries record the land played as their triggering card and cards; the source snapshot for a
  transform (CR 701.27f, checked) is taken for a nested `SourcePermanentSnapshotRequiredEffect` too.
- New `CardSharesNameWithCardExiledWithSourcePredicate`: a card with the name of a card exiled with the source
  permanent, judged by `PredicateEvaluationService` with the source (Search the City's cast and land-play filters).
- `PutCardExiledWithSourceIntoHandEffect`: the `String requiredName` component the handler baked in is gone; the new
  `sameNameAsTriggeringCard` (`withTriggeringCardNameToOwnersHand()`) narrows the pool to the name the handler reads from
  the entry (the new `AmountEvaluationService.triggeringCardName`), nothing when it has none. Ethereal Forager's
  constructor call lost the `null` name.
- New `StackEntry.triggeringSpellOrCard()` (the triggering spell's card, else the first triggering card),
  `GameQueryService.findTriggeringCardOwner`, `LoseLifeRecipient.TRIGGERING_CARD_OWNER` and
  `ExileTopCardOfTriggeringPlayerLibraryEffect.ofTriggeringCardOwner()` (its new component `triggeringCardOwner`).
- New `LibraryScope.TRIGGERING_PLAYER`: the non-targeting "their library" of the player the event was about, the
  entry's `targetId` the cast and land-play collectors set. Share the Spoils' follow-up was `TARGET_PLAYER`, which
  declares a player target; the wrapper's handler set the player without asking, but on the stack as written the cast
  collector asked for a target (its four tests failed), so the card says what it means. The four `LibraryScope` switches
  read it as `TARGET_PLAYER` does (`ExileBottomCardsToSourceEffect`'s as no player).
- New `Triggers.opponentTapsLandForMana()` (`TAPPED_FOR_MANA`, `OPPONENT_CONTROLS`, a land); `TapTrigger.watchKey()`
  maps it to `playerTapsLandForMana()` (the new `opponentTapsLand()`). `TapAbilityReader`: `TapEffect` gained the
  component `opponentTaps`, the land-tap watch judges a filter (`judgesFilter`), one ability's conditions must agree on
  the tapping player, `requireNothingToJudge` throws on it, and the new `readPrintedAsJudged` replaces
  `printedEffectsAsJudged` (the effects as judged, with their filter and tapping player). `TriggerCollectionService
  .checkLandTapTriggers` judges both for the battlefield and the planar readers (`landTapMatches`) before any handler:
  the filter on the tapped land on the battlefield, with the ability's source as the filter's source; a land that left
  as its mana ability resolved matches no filter, as the records' handlers judged it (below).
- `LandTapTriggerCollectorService`: a default handler (`CardEffect.class`) puts an effect no handler of its own reads on
  the stack as written, the tapping player its non-targeting "that player" and triggering player, the land its
  triggering permanent, the source snapshot and planar source kept (`landTapEntry`); the mana-and-damage sequence reads
  the card's `DealDamageToPlayersEffect` step and records the tapped land, as it is or as it last existed, as the entry's
  triggering permanent. `handleDealDamageOnLandTap`, `createLandTapDamageEntry`, `handleGainLifeWhenOpponentTapsSubtypeLand`
  and `handleOpponentLandDoesntUntap` are gone.
- New `DamageSource.TRIGGERING_PERMANENT` and `DealDamageToPlayersEffect.dealtByTriggeringPermanent()`: the entry's
  triggering permanent, as it is or as it last existed (CR 608.2h), deals the damage
  (`DamageSupport.entryDealtByTriggeringPermanent`); no damage when the entry names none. Barbflare Gremlin's "then that
  land deals 1 damage", where the handler built the entry with the land as its source card and controller.
- `AddManaOfTypeProducedByTappedPermanentEffectHandler` adds the mana to the entry's triggering player when it names
  one, else to its controller: the parked mana-and-damage entry is now controlled by the ability's controller (Barbflare's
  was the tapping player's), so "that player adds" keeps going to the player who tapped the land.
- Gone: `PlayedCardExiledWithSourceDrawAndTransformTriggerEffect`, `PlayedCardNameMatchesCardExiledWithSourceTriggerEffect`,

  `GainLifeWhenOpponentTapsLandOfSubtypeEffect`, `OpponentTappedLandDoesntUntapEffect`; the played-name collector's

**Behaviour changes.**

- Otherwise none intended: each filter, the tapping player and the exile source are judged where and when the handlers

#### Run 17z4b: the triggered mana abilities' produced-mana effects resolve by their own handlers

Row 17z4b, not split. Read by site, the row is the land-tap collector resolving the triggered mana abilities' mana
inline, by class, and parking a rebuilt `AddManaOfTypeProducedByTappedPermanentEffect` in place of the card's effect
while the land's own color choice is open: `AddOneOfEachManaTypeProducedByLandEffect` (15 cards), the Overabundance /
Barbflare Gremlin sequence's mana step, `AddProducedManaWhenSnowLandTappedEffect` (Winter's Night) and, the row's
addition, Sasaya's Essence's `AddManaForEachOtherLandWithSameNameEffect` (one rebuilt effect per matching land, counted
as the ability triggered). Keeper of Progenitus's `AddProducedManaWhenLandOfSubtypeTappedEffect` (the third of
`EFFECT_MERGE_PLAN.md`'s land-tap trio, inline, never parked) and Winter's Night's `TappedSnowLandDoesntUntapEffect`
(a second ability applied by class) were the same family. Forsaken Monument's `AddManaOfTypeProducedByTappedPermanentEffect`
handler parks the card's own effect already, so it stays.

**When the value is read.** A triggered mana ability (CR 605.1b, checked) doesn't use the stack and resolves
immediately after the mana ability that triggered it (CR 605.4a, checked), so "as it triggers" and "as it resolves" are
the same moment, except for an ability parked until the land's own color choice settles what the land produced; then
it resolves inside the choice's answer, with nothing else happening in between. "Any type that land produced" is the
tap's produced mana (the stack entry's produced mana colors, as the parked path already read them), or the colors the
land's basic land types give it (CR 305.6, checked) when the tap reported none; "that land" is the entry's triggering
permanent, as it is or as it last existed (CR 608.2h, checked): the tap reports what a land sacrificed for its mana
produced, and Sasaya's Essence reads that land's name as it last existed. "Whenever you tap", "while you're the
monarch" and "a land with the imprinted card's name" are trigger conditions, judged as the land is tapped, as before;
"a basic land", "a snow land", "a Mountain, Forest, or Plains" are the trigger's filter, judged on the tapped land by
`TriggerCollectionService.landTapMatches` (the layer-aware predicate path the merge plan asked for). Rulings (checked
with `get_rulings`):

- Mana Flare, Heartbeat of Spring, Mirari's Wake, Nikya of the Old Ways, Zendikar Resurgent, Vorinclex, Voice of
  Hunger: the types of mana are white, blue, black, red, green and colorless; a land tapped for more than one type
  adds one mana of one type that was produced, of the player's choice, without the land's restrictions or riders.
- Sasaya's Essence: a triggered mana ability; it counts the other lands with the same name and adds that much mana of
  the type the land just produced (four Mossfire Valleys tapped for {R}{G}: three mana of any combination of {R}
  and {G}; two Brushlands tapped for {W}: another {W}, never {G} or {C}).
- Regal Behemoth: its last ability is a triggered mana ability; the monarch rulings don't touch it.
- Winter's Night: the "doesn't untap" does nothing if the land is untapped as its controller's next untap step
  begins, and doesn't track controllers (a new controller's untap step is the one affected).
- Overabundance: the damage is dealt even when the land produced no mana; a mana ability, not respondable to.
- Barbflare Gremlin, Lavaleaper: mana abilities that don't use the stack.
- Selesnya Loft Gardens: the chaos ability is cumulative (two chaos rolls, two mana abilities).
- Dictate of Karametra, Zhur-Taa Ancient, Extraplanar Lens, Keeper of Progenitus: no rulings. The Fertile Lands of
  Saulvinia: its ruling concerns the chaos ability only.

**The rules question: Regal Behemoth.** "Add an additional one mana of any color" is a choice of the five colors
(CR 106.1a, checked: "There are five colors of mana"; CR 106.1b, checked, makes colorless the sixth type, not a
color), independent of what the land produced. The collector offered the tap's produced types together with the five
colors (colorless among them for a land that tapped for {C}), and, while the land's own color choice was open, parked
the ability as "a type the land produced", so the land's color became the extra mana's. Now `anyColor` offers exactly
the five colors and never waits for the land's choice: its own choice is begun, or queued behind the open one.

**The model.**

- `AddOneOfEachManaTypeProducedByLandEffect` is resolved by the new `AddOneOfEachManaTypeProducedByLandEffectHandler`:
  the produced types (the entry's produced mana colors, else the tapped land's basic-land-type colors as it is or as it
  last existed), or the five colors for `anyColor`, added to the entry's triggering player; with one, it is added; with
  several, a choice (`ManaColorChoice.fixedColorCombination`, as before) — and, when effects follow it in the entry,
  they move to a `FixedManaColorThenEffectsChoice` follow-up so they wait for the choice (Overabundance's and
  Barbflare's damage, as the collector's sequence path did, and Winter's Night's untap lock). The `landFilter` component
  is gone (the trigger's `withFilter`), and `anyColor(controllerOnly, monarchOnly)` lost its filter argument.
- `AddManaForEachOtherLandWithSameNameEffect` is resolved by the new `AddManaForEachOtherLandWithSameNameEffectHandler`:
  the tapped land as it is or as it last existed, the other lands with its name the tapping player controls counted as
  it resolves, that many mana of the produced type, one choice per mana when it produced several (as before).
- New `TappedLandManaSupport` (engine `normalfx`): the tapped land, the produced types and "that player" read from the
  entry, and the basic-land-type colors the collector used privately.
- `LandTapTriggerCollectorService`: the three produced-mana handlers (`AddOneOfEachManaTypeProducedByLandEffect`, the
  mana-first sequence, Sasaya's Essence) judge the trigger conditions, build the entry as the default handler does
  (`landTapEntry`: the tapping player its triggering player, the land its triggering permanent, now also for a player's
  granted ability with no source card, Selesnya Loft Gardens' chaos) and `resolveOrAwaitProducedMana`: the entry parked
  with the card's own effects while the land's color choice is open and the tap reported no mana (resolved by
  `ChoiceHandlerService.resolveProducedManaTriggers` through the effects' handlers, as the rebuilt effect was), else
  resolved at once, each effect by its handler from `EffectHandlerRegistry` (in place of the injected damage handler).
  A sequence whose first step is that effect is any sequence now (Winter's Night's mana and untap lock), not only the
  mana-and-damage pair. The snow, subtype and untap-lock handlers are gone.
- `PredicateEvaluationService.hasTriggeredManaAbility` reads a sequence's first step, so Winter's Night (now one
  sequence) keeps counting as having a mana ability, and Overabundance and Barbflare Gremlin count too (their abilities
  are mana abilities by their rulings).
- Gone: `AddProducedManaWhenSnowLandTappedEffect`, `AddProducedManaWhenLandOfSubtypeTappedEffect`,
  `TappedSnowLandDoesntUntapEffect`, and the collector's three handlers of them and its three
  `AddManaOfTypeProducedByTappedPermanentEffect` rebuilds.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17z4b-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 4 card classes:

- Winter's Night: one ability, `Triggers.playerTapsLandForMana().withFilter(new PermanentHasSupertypePredicate(SNOW))`
  + `SequenceEffect.of(new AddOneOfEachManaTypeProducedByLandEffect(false), new SkipNextUntapEffect(TapUntapScope
  .TRIGGERING))` (it was two);
- Keeper of Progenitus: `withFilter(new PermanentHasAnySubtypePredicate(Set.of(MOUNTAIN, FOREST, PLAINS)))` +
  `AddOneOfEachManaTypeProducedByLandEffect(false)`;
- Lavaleaper: `withFilter(new PermanentHasSupertypePredicate(BASIC))` + `AddOneOfEachManaTypeProducedByLandEffect(false)`;
- Regal Behemoth: `AddOneOfEachManaTypeProducedByLandEffect.anyColor(true, true)`.

The other 14 cards of the row (Mana Flare, Heartbeat of Spring, Dictate of Karametra, Zhur-Taa Ancient, Mirari's
Wake, Nikya, Zendikar Resurgent, Vorinclex, Extraplanar Lens, The Fertile Lands of Saulvinia, Selesnya Loft Gardens,
Overabundance, Barbflare Gremlin, Sasaya's Essence) keep their constructors; their effects now resolve by handler.

**Behaviour changes.**

- Rules fix: Regal Behemoth's extra mana is one of the five colors when the land produced colorless mana (Reliquary

  handler required the land on the battlefield and added nothing.
  `SasayaTest#landSacrificedForItsManaStillCountsOtherLandsWithItsName` fails at HEAD (no color choice).
- Regal Behemoth's ability no longer waits for the land's own color choice and no longer takes that color as its own
  (its five-color choice is queued behind the land's). No engine test reaches the parked path (a land tapped while a
  color choice of another permanent is open; see "Left"), so this is covered by `LandTapTriggerCollectorServiceTest`
  and claimed as a latent fix, not a tested one.
- Keeper of Progenitus and Winter's Night: a land that produced several types lets its player choose one (the effects
  took the first); Winter's Night's untap lock is a step of its one mana ability, waiting for that choice, and, while
  the land's color choice is open, is parked with the mana (it was applied at once). No test land produces two types
  in one tap with a Mountain, Forest or Plains type or the snow supertype, so this is untested.
- The parked entries are controlled by the ability's controller, the tapping player their triggering player (they were
  controlled by the tapping player); the mana goes to the tapping player as before.
- Overabundance, Barbflare Gremlin: counted by `hasTriggeredManaAbility` (above).
- Otherwise none intended: each condition and filter is judged where and when it was, and the mana is added at once or
  after the same choice.

For step 16: `AddOneOfEachManaTypeProducedByLandEffect` lost a component; two handlers and one support class added; no
new `Card`, `StackEntry` or `GameData` state; three effects and three class-keyed collector handlers gone; nothing new
is slot-keyed.

**Left, and noted.**

- The parked path is reached by a land tapped while another color choice is open with the tap reporting no mana
  (`AbilityActivationService`'s Piracy path for a land with several overridden colors begins a
  `SpellOnlyManaColorChoice` and checks the land-tap triggers before the mana is added), but
  `ChoiceHandlerService.handleSpellOnlyManaColorChosen` doesn't call `resolveProducedManaTriggers`, so such a parked

#### Run 17z5: the draw records are a static reveal and filtered draw or reveal abilities

Row 17z5, not split. Read by site, the row is two kinds of record: Rowen's and Booby Trap's static markers
(`RevealFirstDrawDrawOnBasicLandEffect`, `BoobyTrapEffect`), for which `DrawService.checkRevealFirstDrawTriggers` and
`checkBoobyTraps` built the triggered ability (`DrawCardEffect(1)`, `SacrificeSelfThenEffect(DealDamageToPlayersEffect(10,
TARGET_PLAYER))`) and logged the reveal, and the draw collectors' drawn-card bindings: `FirstDrawRevealTriggerEffect.effectFor`
(Keranos's `RevealFirstDrawEffect`, Primitive Etchings' `RevealFirstDrawCreatureEffect`, Kefnet's and Eisenhorn's
`RevealFirstDrawInstantOrSorcery…Effect`, which built `RevealDrawnCardIfInstantOrSorceryEffect(drawnCard, …)` and
`CopyDrawnInstantOrSorceryAndMayCastCopyEffect(drawnCard)`), `DrawRevealTriggerEffect.effectFor` (Sea of Sand's
`RevealEachDrawEffect`, the eighth card, read by the controller, opponent and planar collectors),
`DrawnCardTriggerEffect.effectForDrawnCard` (Darigaaz's Whelp's `PerpetuallyBoostDrawnDragonEffect`) and the reveal
handlers' `triggeredEffect()`, which put a hand-built entry on the stack. Each card's Oracle text has two abilities
here: a static reveal ("reveal the first card you draw each turn", "the chosen player reveals each card they draw") and
a triggered ability whose condition is about the drawn or revealed card. About 8 sites, 8 cards.

**When the value is read, and the reveal's timing.** A card is drawn by putting it into the hand (CR 121.1, checked),
one at a time (CR 121.2, checked); a revealed card is shown to all players (CR 701.20a, checked). The reveal is a
static ability, done as the card is drawn, during whatever draws it, and the triggered ability waits until the draw has
finished (Rowen's ruling). "Whenever you reveal a [card] this way" is a trigger event (CR 603.2, checked) of the
source's own reveal, and "whenever you draw a Dragon card", "whenever a player draws a land card", "when the chosen
player draws a card with the chosen name" are draw events with a condition on the drawn card: each is judged once, on
the card as it is drawn, as the collectors and markers judged it. "You may reveal the first card you draw each turn as
you draw it" (Kefnet, Eisenhorn) is an option of the static ability, not a "may" of a triggered ability: the player
looks at the card and chooses as they draw it (CR 121.9, checked), before the next draw of the instruction, and only a
revealed card can trigger "whenever you reveal … this way". So the choice stays where it was, during the draw, and
CR 603.5 (checked) doesn't move it to resolution; no card of this run changes its may timing. "Copy that card"
(Kefnet) reads the stack entry's triggering card, the card as it was revealed: the rulings say a card that left the
hand before the ability resolves is copied from its last-known information (CR 608.2h, checked), which is what the
bound card was and what the entry's card is. Eisenhorn's Cherubael is created whether or not the card is still in the
hand (its ruling). Darigaaz's Whelp's "it perpetually gets +1/+1" boosts the drawn card's identity, as the bound card
did (an Alchemy card; no ruling). Booby Trap's "that player" is the drawing player, the entry's non-targeting player,
as before. Nothing the old path baked as the ability triggered is read differently. Rulings (checked with
`get_rulings`):

- Rowen: the first sentence is a continuous ability; the card is revealed as it is drawn during any draw effect; the
  triggered ability waits until the whole draw effect finishes.
- Primitive Etchings: two of them reveal the same card, and both trigger for a creature (two draws).
- Keranos, God of Storms: a revealed land makes it draw another card; the rest are the God rulings.
- God-Eternal Kefnet: the reveal (or not) is chosen as the card is drawn, after looking at it, before it is mixed into
  the hand; it may be declined; on any player's turn, the first card drawn that turn; only the first card of a
  multi-card draw; the card stays revealed until the ability resolves; a card that left the hand is copied from its
  last-known information; the copy is cast only as the ability resolves, for {2} less; two Kefnets each copy it.
- Inquisitor Eisenhorn: the same reveal rulings; Cherubael is created even if the card left the hand.
- Booby Trap: each card of a multi-card draw is revealed as it is drawn, and the ability goes on the stack after the
  draw; a trap that triggers several times is sacrificed and deals damage only once; countered, the trap stays.
- Sea of Sand: the planar rulings only. Darigaaz's Whelp: no rulings.

**The rules question: additional triggers.** Roaming Throne's "if a triggered ability of another creature you control
of the chosen type triggers, it triggers an additional time" applies to Eisenhorn's and Kefnet's reveal abilities as to
any other: they are triggered abilities of those creatures. The draw collector already put Primitive Etchings',
Keranos's and Darigaaz's Whelp's abilities on the stack once more for each such effect
(`countAdditionalDrawTriggeredAbilityTriggers`); the reveal handlers and Rowen's and Booby Trap's builders put one
entry by hand. Now every one of them goes through the draw collector's queueing.

**The model.**

- New `RevealDrawnCardsEffect(Revealer, firstCardEachTurn, yourTurnsOnly, optional)`: the static reveal, with the
  factories `firstEachTurn()` (Rowen, Primitive Etchings), `firstOnEachOfYourTurns()` (Keranos),
  `mayRevealFirstEachTurn()` (Kefnet, Eisenhorn; `pausesDrawInstruction()`), `eachByChosenPlayer()` (Booby Trap, the
  source's `ChooseOpponentOnEnterEffect` player) and `eachByEveryPlayer()` (Sea of Sand, read from the face-up plane).
- New `LibraryTrigger.LibraryEvent.REVEALS_CARD_THIS_WAY`, `Triggers.youRevealCardThisWay()` and
  `LibraryWatch.ON_CONTROLLER_REVEALS_CARD_THIS_WAY`: "whenever you reveal a [card] this way", its `withFilter` the
  revealed card's filter (the `qualifier`, now documented for drawn and revealed cards too).
- `DrawService`: `checkRevealFirstDrawTriggers` and `checkBoobyTraps` are gone; the new `revealDrawnCardByStaticAbilities`
  runs where they ran, after the draw collectors: each active `RevealDrawnCardsEffect` of a face-up permanent that
  applies to the draw (its player, turn and first-card count) reveals the card at once (`revealDrawnCard`: the log line,
  then the source's `youRevealCardThisWay()` abilities, their filter judged on the card and their options with the
  drawing player as "that player"), or, when optional, asks during the draw (a `PendingMayAbility` of the effect itself,
  the drawn card as its card), and a face-up plane's every-player reveal is logged. The controller draw collector's
  queueing is the new `queueControllerDrawAbility` (the "you may", any-target, permanent-target, self-target and plain
  branches, once more for each additional trigger), which the reveal abilities use too. The controller, opponent and
  planar collectors judge a draw ability's filter on the drawn card (`drawnCardMatches`, through
  `PredicateEvaluationService`, now a constructor dependency, with the source permanent; no card, no match), record the
  drawn card as the plain entries' triggering card (`recordDrawnCard`: the triggering card id and cards), and the
  controller collector's condition context names the drawing player (`withTargetId`), as the opponent collector's did.
  The graveyard draw collectors throw on a filter (`requireNoFilter`; none has one).
- New `RevealDrawnCardsHandler` (`mayfx`): the optional reveal's answer; accepting reveals the drawn card (found in the
  player's hand by the question's card id) through `DrawService.revealDrawnCard`; the paused draw then continues.
- New condition `TargetPlayerIsChosenPlayer`: the context's player is one of the source's chosen player ids, judged
  with the source as it is or as it last existed (`ConditionEvaluationService.sourcePermanent`). Booby Trap's event
  condition, on `opponentDrawsCard()` and `youDrawCard()` both, so the chosen player triggers it whoever controls the
  trap (as `checkBoobyTraps` did).
- `CardHasSourceChosenNamePredicate` reads the source permanent by the passed id first, then by its card id, then the
  passed snapshot (it read only the card-id lookup).
- `CopyDrawnInstantOrSorceryAndMayCastCopyEffect` is fieldless; its handler copies the entry's triggering card
  (`triggeringSpellOrCard()`).
- `PerpetuallyBoostCardEffect.ofTriggeringCard(p, t)` (the same record as `ofTriggeringPermanent`): the handler boosts
  the triggering permanent's card, else the entry's triggering card.
- Gone: `RevealFirstDrawDrawOnBasicLandEffect`, `BoobyTrapEffect`, `FirstDrawRevealTriggerEffect`,
  `DrawRevealTriggerEffect`, `DrawnCardTriggerEffect`, `RevealFirstDrawEffect`, `RevealFirstDrawCreatureEffect`,
  `RevealFirstDrawInstantOrSorceryEffect`, `RevealFirstDrawInstantOrSorceryCreateTokenEffect`, `RevealEachDrawEffect`,
  `RevealDrawnCardIfInstantOrSorceryEffect`, `PerpetuallyBoostDrawnDragonEffect`; the two
  `RevealDrawnCardIfInstantOrSorcery…Handler`s; the draw collectors' five class-keyed branches and the two builders.

**Cards (by script).** `scripts/step15-run17z5-cards.py` (idempotent, per letter module), 8 card classes:
