- `LegacyTriggerBindings.handleDeathMayPayMana` read the `MayPayManaEffect`'s wrapped effect for the target kind.

**When the value is read.**

- "That creature's power" of an ally death (Minn, Wily Illusionist's mana value bound; Pelt Collector's and Yorvo's
  comparison): the entry records the creature's actual last-known power, which can be negative (CR 107.1b, checked), as
  its triggering power whatever its effects are, and the power counted as at least 0 as its event value. An amount reads
  the triggering power as at least 0 unless it allows a negative (`TriggeringPermanentPower(true)`, which Minn's bound
  now is), a comparison as it is. Minn's ruling (the Illusion's last-known power) agrees.
- Liliana's emblem's "it": the emblem's ability is a `TriggeredAbility` (`Triggers.creatureDies(ObjectRelation.ANY)`);
  the emblem death reader (`emblemSeesCreatureDie`, `putEmblemDeathAbilityOnStack`) puts it on the stack as one object
  (abilities of emblems function in the command zone, CR 114.4, checked) and records the creature that died (its card,
  last-known permanent and controller) whatever the effects are; it judges the trigger's filter on the creature as it
  last existed and throws on options or another relation.
- The clash: a "whenever you clash" ability's event value is the clash's outcome, 1 if its controller won (CR 701.30d,
  checked), else 0, recorded on every entry and carried by the target choice (`ClashTriggerTarget.eventValue`).
  "Whenever you clash and win" / "whenever you win a clash" (Sylvan Echoes, Marvo, Deep Operative) is the event
  condition `EventValueAtLeast(1)`, judged as the ability triggers (the reader now takes a `TriggerJudge` with the
  outcome); "if you won" (Entangling Trap, Rebellion of the Flamekin) a `ConditionalEffect` read from the entry as the
  ability resolves, so a clash in between can't change it.
- A modal ability's mode is chosen as it goes on the stack (CR 603.3c, checked): the land-enter and tap readers find the
  modal with `TriggeredModalEffect.choiceMadeAsTriggered`, the rule the other readers use; nothing is unwrapped.
- Havengul Mystery and Zenos yae Galvus: "when the chosen creature leaves the battlefield" is the trigger's filter
  (`PermanentIsChosenPermanentPredicate`), judged as the creature leaves, looking back (CR 603.10a, checked); the effect
  is `TransformSelfEffect`, which rejects an outdated face by the source's snapshot, now recorded on every "another
  permanent leaves" entry.
- Noble Purpose: `Triggers.creatureYouControlDealsCombatDamage()` + `GainLifeEffect(new EventValue())`; the ally combat
  damage collector records the damage dealt as the event value. Kaito Shizuki's emblem: a `TriggeredAbility` on
  `Triggers.creatureYouControlDealsCombatDamageToPlayer()` with the card's `SearchLibraryEffect`; its reader records the
  creature, the player dealt damage and the damage whatever the effects are, and throws on options.
- Power Pack ("target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard chosen at random"): the target is picked at random as
  the ability goes on the stack and is the entry's `targetId` (graveyard zone); the effect reads it. The class still
  picks the random-target path (reclassified ROUTE).
- A death `MayPayManaEffect`'s target is its declared target (`MayPayManaEffect.targetSpec()`: its paid effect's, else
  its "if you don't" effect's), chosen as the ability goes on the stack (CR 603.3d, checked).

**May timing.** No "you may" moved: Minn's, Sylvan Echoes', Rebellion's and the death may-pays are asked as they resolve

the per-target share branch the gate also picks by class). That changes how those tests stage their divisions and needs

The sites:

**What the probe found.** A temporary log in the may handler's class branch and in the skip check's
`CreateTokenCopyOfChosenPermanentYouControlEffect` branch, over Calix, Guided by Fate's, Summon: Good King Mog XII's and
Invasion of Alara's test classes (all passing): every accepted class-branch mark also had the entry's own mark (Calix's
`TriggerLimit.DO_ONLY_ONCE_EACH_TURN`), and no code builds a `CopyControllerCastSpellEffect` with the flag set (it was
dead). The skip check's special branch differed from the generic rule once, in "Accepting one combat-damage copy
consumes the ability for the turn": the `asAccepted()` rebuild replaced the "you may" in the parked entry with the bare
effect, so the accepted answer (`GameData.resolvedMayAccepted`) was never consumed and was still `true` when the second
ability resolved; the special branch hid that. Without the rebuild the answer is consumed by its own "you may", and the
generic rule (used this turn and no answer pending) skips the second one; the test passes.

**When the value is read.**

- Apple of Eden, Isu Relic ("until end of turn, whenever you play a land or cast a spell this way, its owner draws a
  card"): the abilities the activation registers have the Apple as their source (CR 603.7e, checked), so "this way" is
  "a card exiled with this": `Triggers.youCastSpell().exiledWithThis()` and `Triggers.youPlayLand().exiledWithThis()`.
  Every `RegisterGlobalTriggeredAbilityUntil…` registration records the registering source permanent
  (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.sourcePermanentId`) and the player the resolving ability names (`watchedPlayerId`:
  its target player, or for the next-turn form the defending player of an attack trigger, a planeswalker's controller
  included) whatever the ability's effects are. The controller cast and land-play collectors read a registered ability
  as the printed ones are read (`SpellCastTriggerCollectorService.collectCastAbility`,
  `PlayedCardNameTriggerCollectorService.collectLandPlayAbility`), with the registering permanent as the match context's
  new `registeringPermanentId`, which `TriggerMatchContext.exiledWithSourceId()` names after the source permanent and the
  face-up plane. "Its owner" is the played card's owner, read as the ability resolves
  (`DrawCardForTargetPlayerEffect.ofTriggeringCardOwner(1)`, `GameQueryService.findTriggeringCardOwner`); a hand holds
  only its owner's cards (CR 400.3, checked), so it is the targeted opponent, as the bound target was.
- Nuka-Nuke Launcher ("until the end of defending player's next turn, that player gets two rad counters whenever they
  cast a spell"): "whenever they cast a spell" is the filter `StackEntryControlledByWatchedPlayerPredicate` (new), judged
  by the registered any-player cast collector against the recorded player (it throws on any other spell filter); the
  duration is `RegisterGlobalTriggeredAbilityUntilEndOfNextTurnEffect.untilWatchedPlayersNextTurn`, not the class. "That
  player" is the caster, whom the collector records as the entry's non-targeting player and triggering player, with the
  spell as its triggering spell, whatever the effects are.
- Balthier and Fran: "whenever a Vehicle crewed by Balthier and Fran this turn attacks, if it's the first combat phase
  of the turn, you may pay {1}{R}{G}" is Balthier's own `Triggers.creatureAttacks()` ability; its filter is a Vehicle the
  source crewed this turn (`PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(VEHICLE)` and the new `PermanentCrewedThisTurnBySourcePredicate`,
  read from `GameData.creaturesThatCrewedPermanentThisTurn`; a Vehicle is crewed by a creature tapped to pay its crew cost,
  CR 702.122c, checked), judged as the Vehicle is declared an attacker, and "the first combat phase" is the intervening
  "if" `FirstCombatPhase`.
- Cephalid Constable: "return up to that many target permanents that player controls" is declared by the card
  (`ReturnPermanentsOnCombatDamageToPlayerEffect.upToThatManyTargets()`), so the damage collectors' targeted branch, which
  comes first, queues its target choice with the damage as the choice's event value and the player dealt damage as its
  attacked and triggering player (CR 603.3d, checked); the multi-permanent choice reads "that many" from the event value.
- Strict Proctor: "whenever a permanent entering causes a triggered ability to trigger, counter that ability unless its
  controller pays {2}" is a triggered ability (`Triggers.permanentEnteringCausesAbilityToTrigger()`, a new
  `ObjectActionTrigger` action read by the new `MiscWatch.ON_PERMANENT_ENTERING_CAUSES_ABILITY_TO_TRIGGER`).
  `queueTriggeredAbilityCounters` reads the watchers' printed abilities as each own enters ability goes on the stack (a
  face-down watcher or one that lost its abilities doesn't trigger) and puts them on the stack as written after that
  ability (the ruling), recording it as the triggering spell, its controller as the triggering player and its stack
  object as the non-targeting "that ability", whatever the effects are.
- Calix, Guided by Fate's "do this only once each turn" (CR 603.2h) is its `TriggerLimit.DO_ONLY_ONCE_EACH_TURN`, which
  marks the entry as its collector puts it on the stack; accepting the "you may" uses the limit up from the resolving
  entry's mark, read from no effect.

**May timing.** No "you may" moved: Balthier's may-pay and Calix's copy are asked as they resolve (CR 603.5, checked),
as before; Strict Proctor's "unless" is dealt with as it resolves too. Intervening "if"s: Balthier's first-combat check
is now also checked as the ability resolves (CR 603.4, checked); nothing between the declaration and the resolution in

#### Run 17z11f7: a divided triggered ability announces its division as it goes on the stack; the registrations record their linked exiled card

Row 17z11f7, done.

The sites:

- `EtbTriggerService.queueMandatoryETBEffects` took a division staged in `GameData.pendingETBDamageAssignments` for the
  enter ability whose effects were a `DealDividedDamageEffect`, `PreventDividedDamageEffect` or
  `DistributeCountersAmongTargetsEffect` with `etbAssignments`, or a (wrapped) `SacrificeArtifactThenDealDividedDamageEffect`,
  used its keys as the ability's targets (skipping the target choice) and built the entry with it, extra trigger copies
  included; and a per-target share branch (a restricted `DealDividedDamageEffect` with several entering-event targets)
  queued the division prompt by class.
- `StackedDividedDamageTriggerService.announceNextDivision` took a staged division over instead of asking (a death
  trigger's counter distribution checked first); `ETBTokenTargetService.pushMultiTargetETBStackEntry` took a staged
  counter distribution instead of asking; the `DealDividedDamageEffect`, `PreventDividedDamageEffect` and
  `DistributeCountersAmongTargetsEffect` handlers read the buffer when their entry had no division.
- Kuldotha Flamefiend's `SacrificeArtifactThenDealDividedDamageEffect` had no announcement at all: its handler, the
  "you may" handler `SacrificeArtifactForDividedDamageHandler` (`MayMiscHandlerService`) and the sacrifice choice read
  the staged buffer, so outside card tests it dealt no damage.
- `RegisterGlobalTriggeredAbilityUntilEndOfTurnEffectHandler` rebuilt Surge to Victory's
  `CopyImprintedCardAndMayCastCopyEffect` with `boundTo(imprinted card)` as it registered (row 17z11f6's find).
- Found by this run's grep of the register handlers: `RegisterDelayedCreatureDeathTriggerEffectHandler` rebuilt
  Massacre Girl's `BoostAllCreaturesEffect` by class, its `PermanentIsSourceCardPredicate` replaced by the registering
  permanent's id.

**What the probe found.** A temporary log at each site above (removed since), over the test classes of every card with a
divided-damage, divided-prevention, counter-distribution or sacrifice-divided effect and of every test that uses one (319
classes, 3,166 cases, all passing): no production path staged the buffer. The gate took it for 15 cards' enter
abilities, only in their tests (Angel of Salvation, Armament Dragon, Bogardan Hellkite and its copies in the Strionic
Resonator, Mister Fantastic and Adric tests, Broodlord, Dragonlord Atarka, Fury, Gandalf, Spark Starter, Glint Weaver,
Inferno Titan, Jade Seedstones, Kuldotha Flamefiend, Rhino, Terrible Trampler, Ureni, the Song Unending, Verdurous
Gearhulk, Wurmskin Forger); for Fury, Atarka, Ureni and Bogardan it skipped the target choice. The stacked service's
takeover served Gang of Devils', Grand Ossuary's, Inferno Titan's attack, Jugan's, Orca's and Quirion Beastcaller's
tests; the enter target service's preset Armament Dragon's, Broodlord's, Jade Seedstones', Rhino's, Gearhulk's,
Wurmskin Forger's and Yannik's. The per-target share branch and the damage and prevention handlers' buffer reads were
reached by no test; the counter handler's only by entries with no division (one, a Gearhulk test that chose no target,
read a staged map it then ignored). Kuldotha's resolution went through the effect handler (the CR 603.5 "you may" on the
stack); its "you may" handler was reached by no test.

**When the value is read.** A divided triggered ability's targets and division are chosen as it is put on the stack
(CR 601.2d, 603.3d, checked), never taken from anything staged before it triggered:

- An ability with no declared target group (Inferno Titan, Gang of Devils, Angel of Salvation, Glint Weaver, Jugan,
  Kuldotha Flamefiend) is announced by `StackedDividedDamageTriggerService` before priority, as before for all of them
  but Kuldotha, whose `SacrificeArtifactThenDealDividedDamageEffect` (also inside a `MayEffect`) it now announces too:
  "any number of targets" among any targets, zero targets allowed (its ruling), which divides nothing
  (`StackedDividedDamageTargets.allowsNoTargets`, new; the entry's new `divisionAnnounced`, set by
  `announceDamageAssignments` and kept by copies, marks an announcement of no target). The sacrifice is chosen as it
  resolves, from the entry's division; with every target illegal it doesn't resolve (CR 608.2b).
- An ability whose card declares its targets as a target group (Fury, Bogardan Hellkite, Dragonlord Atarka, Ureni, the
  counter distributions) chooses them through the enter target choice and divides among them in
  `ETBTokenTargetService` as it is put on the stack, as before when nothing was staged. The restricted form needs no
  announcement of its own in the stacked service: no path puts such an ability on the stack without its targets.
- The handlers read only the entry's division. The buffer stays as the scratch of the divisions made as an ability
  resolves (Vastwood Hydra's untargeted distribution, `MoveCountersFromSourceToOtherCreaturesEffect`, a restricted
  `DealDividedDamageEffect` resolving with targets but no division).
- A cast-supplied division is a test's declaration, not engine state: `harness.declareDivision(Map.of(...))` (new
  `DeclaredDivisions`, as `DeclaredEtbTargets` does for ETB targets) answers the ability's target choice and each
  per-target amount once they open, one declaration per announced division in order; a target group's targets come
  from the cast helper's target list. The engine takes no division with a permanent spell.
- Surge to Victory: every `RegisterGlobalTriggeredAbilityUntil…` registration records the card its source exiled
  (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.linkedExiledCardId`, the resolving spell's own exiled card) whatever the effects
  are, the generic registered collector (`enqueueTemporaryGlobalTrigger`) puts it on the entry as its linked exiled card,
  and `CopyImprintedCardAndMayCastCopyEffectHandler` copies that card (CR 603.7c, checked: a delayed ability that refers
  to a particular object). `boundImprintedCardId` and `boundTo` are gone.
- Massacre Girl: a delayed creature-death registration records the source permanent of the ability that made it
  (CR 603.7e, checked) whatever the effect is, and its triggers keep it as their source permanent, which
  `PermanentIsSourceCardPredicate` already judges first, so "other than Massacre Girl" is that object and never a
  returned one; "another creature dies" is the watcher's `onlyOthers`, no longer the presence of the source id.

**May timing.** No "you may" moved: Kuldotha's is asked as it resolves (CR 603.5), as before. Intervening "if"s:
unchanged.

#### Run 17z12: an independent verification of the done condition

Row 17z12, done; rows 17z12b to 17z12e opened. Step 15 is open again.

**What was checked.** The condition: no `…AwareEffect` is left, the trigger pipeline doesn't rewrite, unwrap or
class-bind a card's effect (the effects a card declares are what goes on the stack; a class may route an ability to its
target choice or queue, and an engine-made effect is step 16's), and `OncePerTurnTriggerEffect` is gone. Checked
without trusting the audits' labels:

- `scripts/step15-run17z6-audit.py` and `scripts/step15-run17z11-audit.py`, full output; every ENGINE and STATIC read
  read by hand (the STATIC reads of the legality services are static abilities, `TriggerCollectionService`'s two the
  "as this Equipment becomes attached" replacement choices; the ENGINE egg-counter read is the engine's own ability for
  a card exiled with egg counters).
- A scan of every engine service (the effect handlers but the may and registration ones excluded) for an `if` whose
  condition reads an effect's class and whose body sets stack-entry data; a grep of the pipeline services for
  `new MayEffect(`, `new ConditionalEffect(`, `new SequenceEffect(` and `.wrapped()` / `.steps()` reaching the stack.
- Every `@Collects…Trigger` handler and the registration handlers, read against their watch's
  `CardEffect.class` default (by a subagent, its findings re-checked where they are cited here).

**What it found.** The condition didn't hold. The audits label by file and class (17z11) or by a body heuristic that
sees only a value read from the effect's own fields (17z6), so neither sees a class-keyed record of event data, a
default handler branching on a class, or a later read of an already classified class:

- Rewrites: the upkeep collector's `new MayEffect(mayReveal, …)` for Priest of the Wakening Sun (labelled ENGINE: it
  was the card's effect), and the reveal handler wrapping itself in a `MayEffect` as it resolved for Invasion of the
  Giants and Armored Kincaller; the land-play collector's `ConditionalEffect(TriggeringCardMatches(filter), …)` keyed
  by the filter's class (Cemetery Gatekeeper, Cemetery Protector); the rest are row 17z12e's.
- Unwraps: the self-untap collector (`MiscTriggerCollectorService.handleSelfBecomesUntapped`) judged every
  `ConditionalEffect` as the ability triggered and put its inner effect on the stack, dropping an intervening "if"'s
  check as it resolves (CR 603.4) and judging a card's own conditional early; no card with that trigger writes one, so
  nothing played differently. `GraveyardTargetingSupport.withoutOptionalWrapperWhenNoCards` is row 17z12e's.
- Class-keyed records: the source snapshot for `SourcePermanentSnapshotRequiredEffect` (an `…AwareEffect` under another
  name) in the cast, land-play and creature-card-to-graveyard collectors, and in the cast collector for a chosen-player
  mill or a chosen-colors amount; the triggering spell's targets for `GrantKeywordEffect(TARGETS)`; the life lost for
  two classes; the departed triggering permanent's controller for a `MayEffect` of `TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER` and
  as `targetId` for `EnchantedCreatureDealsDamageEqualToDealtDamageToControllerEffect`; and the handlers of rows
  17z12b to 17z12d.

**What this run fixed.**

- "You may reveal a [subtype] card from your hand. If you do, …": `RevealSubtypeFromHandEffect(subtype, thenEffect)`
  (was `MayRevealSubtypeFromHandEffect`, its prompt gone) inside the card's `MayEffect`. The ability goes on the stack
  whenever it triggers and the choice is made as it resolves (CR 603.5, the cards' rulings), unchanged; the upkeep
  collector's branch and the handler's self-wrap are gone, the handler reveals (choosing among several) and performs
  the effect. Invasion of the Giants' chapter II is one ability ("Draw a card. Then you may reveal …"), as the saga
  collector already put it on the stack. Rulings checked: Priest of the Wakening Sun, Armored Kincaller, Invasion of
  the Giants.
- The self-untap collector puts the judged abilities' effects on the stack as written, the intervening "if" around them.
- Cemetery Gatekeeper's and Cemetery Protector's land-play abilities write their intervening "if" as their cast
  abilities do (`ConditionalEffect(TriggeringCardMatches(sharedType), …)`); the collector's recheck is gone.
- The cast, land-play and creature-card-to-graveyard collectors record the source snapshot whatever the effects are
  (its last known information, CR 608.2h, and what a transform instruction compares, CR 701.27f);
  `SourcePermanentSnapshotRequiredEffect` is gone (five implementers), as are the cast collector's
  `containsChosenPlayerMill` and `effectReadsSourceChosenColors`. The cast collector records the spell's targets, and
  the controller-life-loss collector the life lost, whatever the effects are.
- The departed triggering permanent's controller: `PermanentRemovalService` records it in the entry's removed
  permanent controllers for every entry whose triggering permanent leaves (both departure paths), and the may handler's
  `TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER` and `EnchantedCreatureDealsDamageEqualToDealtDamageToControllerEffectHandler` read it
  once the creature has left (CR 608.2h); the two class-keyed binds are gone.

No rules fix: each site played as before for the cards that reach it. No may timing moved; no intervening "if" moved.

**Not violations.** The intervening-"if" wraps done for every ability by rule (the readers, `withInterveningIf`, the
stacked modal's per-mode copy) and the entry facts removed (`EntryFactCondition`, the declared-attack facts, a
triggered mana ability's "if"); the engine-made abilities step 16 lists (delayed actions, keyword grants, Beck's and
the voyage registrations, the delayed returns and mana); the upkeep graveyard branches (every branch records the

**What changed.**

- The enchanted-creature-dealt-damage default is the watch's only handler. The ability is the Aura's or Equipment's
  (CR 113.7) and its controller's (CR 113.8), whatever the effects are; its entry records the creature as the triggering
  permanent (id, card id, controller, power as it was dealt the damage, a snapshot with the damage keywords it had: its
  last known information once it has left, CR 608.2h) and the damage as the event value. A targeted ability's target is
  chosen as it goes on the stack (CR 603.3d), the `SpellTargetTriggerAnyTarget` choice carrying the same record. Backfire's
  collector records the same (and the damaged player as the triggering player), no `targetId` or `xValue` baked.
- `queueAnyPermanentDealtDamageTrigger`: the watcher is the ability's source (CR 113.7: Wrathful Raptors' ability is
  Raptors', not the damaged Dinosaur's); the choice records the damaged permanent as the triggering permanent, its snapshot
  and power, and the damage as the event value. "It deals that much damage" is the card's:
  `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect.dealtByTriggeringPermanent(new EventValue())`.
- The any-creature-death default records the source snapshot for every ability (the target path already passed it to the
  choice): Yoke of the Damned's and Sadistic Glee's "enchanted creature" is read from it once the Aura is gone.
- 13 handlers deleted with their registrations (`scripts/step15-run17z12c-remove-handlers.py`).
- The cards say what they read (`scripts/step15-run17z12c-cards.py`): "this Aura / enchantment deals that much damage to
  that creature's controller" (Binding Agony, Backfire, Repercussion) is `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new EventValue(),
  TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)`, Spiteful Shadows' "it deals that much damage to its controller" the same
  `.dealtByTriggeringPermanent()` (the creature deals it, its lifelink and infect apply, as the ruling says);
  `EnchantedCreatureDealsDamageEqualToDealtDamageToControllerEffect` and its handler are gone. Fiendlash's "it deals
  damage equal to its power" is `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect.dealtByTriggeringPermanent(new SourcePower())` (its power as
  the ability resolves, else as it last existed, and its lifelink then: the rulings). `fromEnteringPermanent` is renamed
  `dealtByTriggeringPermanent` (it reads the entry's triggering permanent, whatever the event; 12 cards, an engine handler and two tests).
  Bounty Board's "a creature with a bounty counter on it" is the trigger's filter
  (`Triggers.creatureDies(new PermanentHasCountersPredicate(CounterType.BOUNTY), ObjectRelation.ANY)`, judged on the
  dying creature's last known information), its effect reads the triggering permanent's last-known controller.
- `ConditionEvaluationService.enchantedPermanentMatches` judges the creature the source was attached to (its snapshot as
  the ability triggered, else the live Aura), not the entry's triggering permanent: a death entry's triggering permanent
  is the creature that died, and Blade of the Bloodchief's "if equipped creature is a Vampire" read it once the default
  recorded it (`BladeOfTheBloodchiefTest.vampireGetsTwoCountersAfterBladeLeaves` failed until then). Breath of Fury's
  case (the triggering creature is the one the Aura was attached to) reads the same creature.
- `agent-docs` follow (`scripts/step15-run17z12c-docs.py`).

#### Run 17z12f: the "you may pay" enter abilities are the watcher's and record the entering permanent

Row 17z12f, done; row 17z12d not reached (notes below).

**What the probe found** (a temporary log at each branch of `EnterTriggerCollectorService.handleEnterMayPay` and at
`handleCreatureEnterFromGraveyardDefault`'s targeted branch, removed, over the test classes of the 81 cards with an
enters trigger and a `MayPayManaEffect`, Flayer of the Hatebound and Dredging Claw; all passing):

- The "a payload that admits a permanent is that creature" binding (the entering permanent as the entry's non-targeting
  `targetId`): Mirrorworks, Replication Specialist, Minion Reflector, Flameshadow Conjuring, Riku of Two Reflections,
  Ultron, Inalla (its battlefield and command-zone abilities), Emiel the Blessed, Brilliant Wings.
- `MayPayManaEffect.sourceIsTriggeringPermanent` (the entering permanent as the ability's source): Electropotence (a
  targeted payload, through `EntersTriggerTarget` with the creature as source) and Arni Metalbrow (no target; its effect
  already read the triggering permanent's mana value).
- The player-target branch: Sludge Strider; every other card took the plain branch (untargeted payloads).
- `handleCreatureEnterFromGraveyardDefault`'s `EnteringPermanentAnyTargetTrigger`: Flayer of the Hatebound only.

**What changed.**

- `handleEnterMayPay` puts the ability on the stack as the watcher's (CR 113.7) whatever its payload is: a payload that
  targets a player or a permanent gets its target chosen as the ability goes on the stack through `EntersTriggerTarget`
  with the watcher as source (CR 603.3d), the payment decided as it resolves (CR 603.5); otherwise the entry records the
  entering permanent (`recordEnteringPermanent`, as the defaults do) and no `targetId`. `TriggerContext.PermanentEnters`'
  `mayPayTargetCardId` is renamed `enteringPermanentId` (it always was the entering permanent).
- `MayPayManaEffect.sourceIsTriggeringPermanent` is gone with its two constructors (`CastAbility`'s plain-payment check
  and `ReturnTargetCardsFromGraveyardToHandEffectHandler`'s rebuild follow).
- `handleCreatureEnterFromGraveyardDefault` queues a targeted ability's `EntersTriggerTarget` with the watcher as source;
  `PermanentChoiceContext.EnteringPermanentAnyTargetTrigger`, its queue processing (`TriggeredAbilityQueueService`,
  `TriggerCollectionService`, `StackResolutionService`, `AutoPassService`) and its answer (`PermanentChoiceHandlerService`,
  `PermanentChoiceTriggerHandlerService`) are gone (`scripts/step15-run17z12f-remove-choice.py`).
- The cards say "that creature" (`scripts/step15-run17z12f-cards.py`, 12 cards): the token copies are
  `.ofTriggeringPermanent()` (Mirrorworks, Replication Specialist, Minion Reflector, Flameshadow Conjuring, Riku of Two

  or as it last existed, CR 608.2h); Arni Metalbrow drops the flag.
- `agent-docs` follow (`scripts/step15-run17z12f-docs.py`): the Oracle map's Flayer, Minion Reflector and Necroduality
  rows and its stale `fromEnteringPermanent`, the enters guide's Mirrorworks row, `MayPayManaEffect`'s index rows, the
  trigger-targeting matrix (the entering-permanent any-target row gone) and the target-predicate plan's site list.

**Rules fix.** Electropotence's ability had the entering creature as its source, so the resolution check of its target
(CR 608.2b) judged protection (CR 702.16b) against the creature: a creature with protection from creatures, a legal
target for Electropotence, was illegal as the ability resolved, and the ability was removed without the payment the
ruling offers ("It could target a creature with protection from creatures, but all the damage would be prevented").
`ElectropotenceTest.protectionFromCreaturesTargetStaysLegalButTheDamageIsPrevented` fails at HEAD (mana pool 3,
expected 0) and passes. Flayer of the Hatebound's target choice already judged against Flayer's card and its entry kept
the creature's snapshot, so it plays as before.

**Not changed, noted.** `handleEnterMayPay` stays keyed by `MayPayManaEffect.class` as a route (a command-zone source,
Inalla's, and the any-permanent path reach it); a targeted payload from a command-zone source still goes on the stack
without a target choice (no card writes one). `EntersTriggerTarget`'s entry records the entering permanent, its
controller, last-known card and power and toughness, not the card snapshot `recordEnteringPermanent` sets (as for every
targeted enters ability).

**Row 17z12d, not reached.** Notes for it:

- `StackEntry.triggeringCardGraveyardEntryVersion` is two things: the source card's graveyard stay ("return this card",
  read by `GraveyardReturnSupport`, the `ReturnSource…` / `ExileSource…` handlers and others) and the triggering card's
  (the discarded, milled or dying card). The pending-may path (`queueMayAbility`, `MayEffectHandler`'s pending may,
  `GraveyardChoiceHandlerService`) carries the version only with `triggeringCardId` (`setTriggeringCard(id, version)`),
  which is why `TriggerCollectionService`'s graveyard enter sites set the source card as `triggeringCardId` for a
  `MayEffect` only, and why `GraveyardChoiceHandlerService` restamps the source's stay for
  `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.exileSourceFromGraveyard()`. Recording both stays for every ability needs a record of
  the source's stay of its own (the "this card" readers moved to it) first (CR 400.7).
- The discard collector binds the discarding player as non-targeting `targetId` beyond the row's Megrim handler:
  `handleLifeLossOnDiscard` (Liliana's Caress), `handleConditionalDiscard` and `enqueueDiscardTrigger`'s player variant;
  the `TRIGGERING_PLAYER` recipients (`DealDamageToPlayersEffect`, `LoseLifeEffect`, `MayPayManaEffect`'s payer and
  others) read `targetId`. The default records the triggering player and card but no stay;
  `ExileDiscardedCardFromGraveyardEffectHandler` takes its event-cards branch whenever `triggeringCards` is set, so
  recording a single discard's card there changes its stay check. A uniform record: the discarding player, the
  discarded card(s) and their stays on every discard entry, the `TRIGGERING_PLAYER` readers reading the entry's
  triggering player.
- Hedge Shredder's handler judges "one or more land cards" over the event's cards as it triggers (a trigger condition)
  and records only the lands as event cards, with their stays; the default records every card as a triggering card,
  without stays.

audit 268 reads, 178 ROUTE, 89 STATIC, 1 ENGINE.

#### Run 17z12d: the source card's graveyard stay is its own record, and the discard and milled-card collectors record the event whatever the effects are

Row 17z12d, done. Step 15 stays open (row 17z12e).

**What the probe found** (a temporary log at each "this card" reader, comparing the stay it read before with the source
stay it reads now, run with the old writers; and at each class-keyed discard and milled-card handler; removed; over the
test classes of the 2,094 cards with a discard, mill, dies, graveyard-enter, graveyard-ability or "this card"
graveyard effect, 16,595 cases):

- `StackEntry.triggeringCardGraveyardEntryVersion` held the source card's stay for most graveyard abilities whose event
  is about no card: 15 cases failed once the readers read the source's stay with the old writers, each a CR 400.7 test
  (an old trigger and a card that left and re-entered the graveyard): Akoum Firebird, Silvan Reveler, Hormagaunt Horde
  (landfall from the graveyard), Unconventional Tactics, Vanguard of the Restless, Spit Flame, Sosuke's Summons
  (creature enters), Forsaken Miner (crime), Dungeon Crawler (dungeon completed), Furious Forebear (creature dies),
  Phoenix Chick (attack), Sunstreak Phoenix (day/night), Brood of Cockroaches (its delayed return), Infesting Radroach,
  Sword of the Ages (an activated ability's source sacrificed as a cost, recorded only for
  `ExileSourceCardFromGraveyardEffect`). Other readers lost the stay without a test noticing (Quagnoth and Sand Golem
  discarded by an opponent, Warcry Phoenix, Interceptor, Jocasta, Persistent Marshstalker, Boneyard Scourge, Blood
  Speaker, Vengeful Pharaoh).
- The conflation the other way: the cast-from-graveyard abilities (Aurora, Enigma, Entropic, Verdant and Sandstorm
  Eidolon, Lingering Phantom, Vengevine, Poxwalkers, Shambling Cie'th, Masked Admirers) recorded the triggering spell as
  the triggering card and the source's stay beside it, and Gigapede's discard follow-up the discarded card's stay; the
  readers' "the version belongs to the source only when no other card is the trigger's subject" skipped the source's
  check for them.
- The discard handlers, by card: `handleDiscardMay` (Confessor, Containment Construct, Currency Converter, Geth's
  Grimoire, Moonstone, Nath of the Gilt-Leaf, Pitchstone Wall, Quest for the Nihil Stone, Sangromancer, Tergrid),
  `handleCastDiscardedCard` (Oskar), `handleExileDiscardedFromGraveyard` (Bag of Holding, Necropotence, Tinybones),
  Toluz's event handler, `handleDamageToDiscardingPlayer` (Megrim), `handleLifeLossOnDiscard` (Liliana's Caress, Fell
  Specter, Raiders' Wake, Entropic Battlecruiser, Midnight Oil), `handleConditionalDiscard` (Cool but Rude), and 14 that
  did what the default does (Anje Falkenrath's untap, Glint-Horn Buccaneer's damage, Mystic Redaction's mill, Curator of
  Mysteries' scry, Rankle's perpetual boost, Archfiend of Ifnir's, Lo and Li's, Tourach's, Shipwreck Sifters' and Surly
  Badgersaur's counters, the token, mana and draw handlers of Waste Not, Bone Miser, Aclazotz, Hostile Investigator,
  Urza, Mary Read and Anne Bonny, Green Goblin, Veronica); Conspiracy Theorist's discard-event "you may". No card
  reached a gated handler's `return false` (a recipient other than the one it collected).
- `handleMilledLandsReturn`: Hedge Shredder; `handleEventCardsGraveyardReturn`: Colossal Grave-Reaver. Both judged
  "one or more land / creature cards" over the event as the ability triggered.

**What changed.**

- The source card's stay is its own record. `StackEntry.sourceGraveyardEntryVersion` (read through
  `sourceCardGraveyardEntryVersion()`, which falls back to the triggering card's only when the source card is the
  triggering card: "when this dies", and now the physical card of a transformed source, Galian Beast) is what every
  "this card" effect reads: `GraveyardReturnSupport`'s `CardIsSelfPredicate` return, its "exile it" and its
  moved-source rebinding, `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToBattlefield`, `…ToOwnerHand`, `ReturnSourceTransformed…`,
  `ExileSourceCardFromGraveyard` and its evidence and shuffle forms, `PutSourceCardFromGraveyardIntoLibraryNFromTop`,
  `ShuffleSelfFromGraveyardIntoLibrary`, `RegisterDelayedSelfReturnFromGraveyard`,
  `RegisterDelayedLoseLifeAndReturnFromGraveyardToHand`, `PersistReturn`, `PutAuraFromHandOntoSelfWithinXManaValueOrExile`,
  `AttachOneOfControlledEquipmentToSource`, `ReturnCardFromGraveyard`'s self check and `ForcedCostOrElse`'s source
  check (`scripts/step15-run17z12d-source-readers.py`). The "belongs to the source" guesses are gone.
  `getTriggeringCardGraveyardEntryVersion()` is the stay of the card the event was about only.
- Every collector of an ability of a card in a graveyard records its stay with `setSourceGraveyardEntryVersion`
  whatever the effects are (`scripts/step15-run17z12d-source-writers.py`: the crime, dungeon, nonland-milled,
  creature-death, creature-put-into-a-graveyard, day/night, upkeep, attack, emblem-return and self-discard collectors,
  Brood of Cockroaches' delayed return, the cast-from-graveyard collector (whose triggering card is the spell), the
  graveyard activation and an activated ability whose source a cost put into a graveyard). The graveyard enter
  collectors (landfall, creature, artifact and enchantment, permanent, creature-from-a-graveyard) share
  `recordGraveyardEnterAbility`: the source's stay and the entering permanent, the `MayEffect` branches no longer making
  the source card the triggering card; the "any creature" watch's missing stay is recorded too.
- The may path carries the source's stay (`PendingMayAbility.sourceGraveyardEntryVersion`, a new component; the old
  canonical signature kept as a constructor recording none; `scripts/step15-run17z12d-pending-may.py`), set by
  `MayEffectHandler` and `MayPayManaEffectHandler` and restored by `MayAbilityHandlerService`. A graveyard target
  choice records a source card still in a graveyard as the ability goes on the stack, whatever the effects are
  (`GraveyardChoiceHandlerService`'s restamp for `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.exileSourceFromGraveyard()` is gone).
- The discard collectors record the discard on every entry they build (`DiscardTriggerCollectorService.recordDiscard`):
  the discarding player as triggering player and, for an ability that chose no target, its non-targeting target ("that
  player", which the `TRIGGERING_PLAYER` recipients read, as the step and damage collectors give it); the discarded
  cards as triggering cards with their stays in `eventCardGraveyardEntryVersions`; a lone card also as the triggering
  card with its stay; a discard event's count as the event value. 31 handlers deleted with the player variant of
  `enqueueDiscardTrigger` (`scripts/step15-run17z12d-discard.py`): the row's four, the life-loss and conditional
  handlers, the 14 that did what the default does, and the "you discard one or more cards" watch's 11 class handlers,
  which a default of its own replaces (a targeted ability gets its target through `DiscardControllerTriggerTarget`, as
  before). The discard default collects every effect that chooses no target (`declaredTarget() == null`), the
  self-acting ones (Anje's untap, Tourach's counters) included. The cycling and opponent-caused fallbacks record it too.
  `ExileDiscardedCardFromGraveyardEffectHandler` reads each triggering card's stay from the entry's event versions, so a
  single discard and a discard event are one path (Toluz's record moved there from the target versions).
- The cards-put-into-a-graveyard defaults record their cards the same way (`MiscTriggerCollectorService
  .recordCardsPutIntoGraveyard`; `TriggerContext.CreatureCardsPutIntoGraveyardFromLibrary` gains the cards).
  `handleMilledLandsReturn` and `handleEventCardsGraveyardReturn` are gone (`scripts/step15-run17z12d-milled.py`).
  `ReturnTriggeringLandFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` reads the triggering cards, and
  `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.eventCardIdsOnly` the triggering cards when the entry records no event cards.
- The trigger conditions the handlers judged are the cards' filters (`scripts/step15-run17z12d-cards.py`): Hedge
  Shredder's "one or more land cards" is `Triggers.putIntoGraveyardFrom(LIBRARY, Triggers.LAND_CARD, YOU_OWN)` (a second
  key of `ON_ALLY_CARDS_PUT_INTO_GRAVEYARD_FROM_LIBRARY`, so the event is the lands), Colossal Grave-Reaver's "one or more
  creature cards" `Triggers.NONTOKEN_CREATURE` (the creature-cards watch), Oskar's "a nonland card"
  `youDiscardCard().withFilter(new CardNotPredicate(new CardTypePredicate(LAND)))`.
- `agent-docs` follow (`scripts/step15-run17z12d-docs.py`; `ARCHITECTURE.md`'s trigger-state note by hand).

#### Run 17z12e: the last rebuilds and unwraps: the seek, "choose up to X", delayed-token, graveyard-may, land-tap, Animal Friend and Cephalid Constable sites

**What the inspection found** (each site re-grepped, its cards found by a grep of the card sources for the effect
classes and triggers it reads, and read):

- `SeekTriggerCollectorService.handleSeek` rebuilt Lurker in the Deep's `ConjureDuplicatesOfSoughtCardsAndManifestEffect`
  with the sought cards and, for that class only, judged two trigger conditions as the ability triggered: "during your
  turn" and "one or more cards" (no trigger for a seek that found nothing). The seek abilities are Lurker in the Deep's,
  Vexyr, Ich-Tekik's Heir's and Val, Marooned Surveyor's; the only seek that reached the collector with no card is
  Darigaaz's Whelp's kicked seek with no Dragon in the library (`SeekDragonAndPerpetuallyBoostEffectHandler`), every
  other seek handler returning before it when nothing matched.
- "Choose up to X": the cast collector (Riku of Many Paths) and `EtbTriggerService` (an enters modal's "choose both
  instead" condition, its `allWhen` form and an enters "up to X") rebuilt the card's `ChooseOneEffect` with the bounds
  computed as the ability triggered, losing its other components (mode costs, budget, the "when" flags). The rebuilt
  modal is the mode choice's (CR 700.2b, 603.3c), never a stack object (the chosen modes' effects go on the stack, as
  written), but the bounds were baked into a copy of the card's effect. `StepTriggerService.limitModesToCondition` did
  the same for a beginning-of-combat modal's "choose both instead" (not listed by run 17z12).
- `RegisterDelayedCreateTokenAtNextUpkeepEffectHandler`: the `withAmount(event value)` rebuild is The Eagles Are Coming!'s
  ("for each creature returned to your hand this way", an `EventValue`), not Hazezon Tamar's, whose amount is the lands
  it controls at the upkeep (`PermanentCount`) and was never rebuilt.
- `GraveyardTargetingSupport.withoutOptionalWrapperWhenNoCards`: a `MayEffect` directly around a graveyard-card-choosing
  effect is Rysorian Badger's, Zombie Cannibal's, Spellweaver Helix's and Blood Operative's (Aegis Sculptor's and
  Emeritus of Ideation's wrap a sequence, which the unwrap didn't touch). With no card chosen the effect does nothing
  (the riders of Rysorian Badger apply only to exiled cards), so the unwrap only spared a "you may" with nothing to
  decide.
- `LandTapTriggerCollectorService.handleManaAbilitySequence`: no card writes the `[AddManaOnEnchantedLandTapEffect,
  PutCountersOnSelfEffect]` sequence whose counter step the branch put on the stack alone; a triggered mana ability
  doesn't go on the stack and resolves at once (CR 605.4a). Runaway Growth writes the intensify form, which the
  collector resolves at once, both steps.
- `handleCampLandTap` set `TargetFilters.creatureYouControl()` on the parked entry, as the marker
  `queueResolvedProducedManaTriggerTarget` read for "a target is still to be chosen", and gave the same filter to the
  target choice; C.A.M.P.'s effect declares "target creature you control" in its own target spec. Taking the filter
  away showed `TriggeredAbilityQueueService.restrictToEffectPermanentRestriction` judging an effect's own permanent
  restriction with no source controller, so a source-relative restriction ("you control") dropped every candidate and
  the trigger was skipped: the seven C.A.M.P. cases that choose a target failed until it was judged from the ability's
  controller and source, as `permanentTargetsForEffects` judges the candidates.
- `PermanentRemovalService` counted Animal Friend's Auras and Equipment into the entry's event value when the source
  left, for that effect class only.
- `PermanentChoiceTriggerHandlerService.handleAttackTrigger` (and `processNextAttackTriggerTarget`'s no-candidate entry,
  the same flag) made Cephalid Constable's entry non-targeting when no target was chosen. An entry with no target is
  never judged illegal as it resolves (`TargetLegalityService.isTargetIllegalOnResolution`), and the handler reads the
  empty target list as "returns nothing", so the flag changed nothing.

**What changed.**

- Seek: the seek default records the seeking player as the entry's triggering player and the sought cards as its
  triggering cards whatever the effects are; `ConjureDuplicatesOfSoughtCardsAndManifestEffect` has no component and
  reads "those cards" from the triggering cards as it resolves. `TriggerCollectionService.checkSeekTriggers` dispatches
  nothing for a seek that found no card (its no-card overload is gone). Lurker in the Deep writes "during your turn" as
  its seek ability's event condition (`TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withEventCondition(new ControllerTurn())`, judged by the
  action dispatcher; `scripts/step15-run17z12e-cards.py`).
- Modal choices: `PermanentChoiceContext.TriggeredModalTrigger` gains `modeCount` (`withModeCount(minimum, maximum)`,
  the 10-component constructor kept): the number of modes the trigger event set, read by
  `processNextTriggeredModalTrigger` through `ChooseOneEffect.withChoiceCount`, which keeps every other component. The
  cast collector's Riku X, `EtbTriggerService`'s and `StepTriggerService`'s "choose both instead" (and `allWhen`, "up to
  X") put the card's modal on the choice as written with the count beside it.
- `DelayedCreateTokenAtNextUpkeep` gains `eventValue`: the registrar records its entry's event value, and the delayed
  ability's entry carries it as its own, so the token effect goes on the stack as written and its `EventValue` reads it.
- The graveyard choice paths (`GraveyardChoiceHandlerService` ×2, `GraveyardTargetingService`) put the effects on the
  stack as written; `withoutOptionalWrapperWhenNoCards` is gone. `MayEffectHandler` offers no choice for a
  graveyard-card-choosing effect whose choice, made as the ability went on the stack, took no card (beside its "acts
  only on its targets" rule), so no card asks a question it didn't ask before. The choice is still made as it resolves

- The enchanted-land sequence's never-written counter branch is deleted.
- C.A.M.P.: no target filter is set; the target choice reads the effect's target spec, and a parked land-tap entry goes

- The non-targeting flags for `ReturnPermanentsOnCombatDamageToPlayerEffect` are gone.
- `agent-docs` follow (`scripts/step15-run17z12e-docs.py`).

C.A.M.P. CR 603.3c, 603.3d, 603.5, 605.1b, 605.4a, 608.2h and 700.2b verified.

#### Run 17z13: an independent verification after run 17z12e

trusting the audits' labels:

  (`StepTriggerService`'s egg-counter ability) is the engine's own ability for a card exiled with egg counters; the
  STATIC reads are the legality services' static abilities and `TriggerCollectionService`'s two "as this Equipment

**What it found.** The condition doesn't hold. Besides the four sites fixed here:

  builds the modes for `HullbreakerHorrorTriggerEffect`), Corrosive Ooze
  (`PermanentRemovalService.rememberCombatEquipmentAttachments` rebuilds its effect on the stack entry and on the

- Trigger conditions judged by an effect's class, dropping a declared effect as the ability triggers (row 17z13d): the

**What this run fixed.**

- Phage the Untouchable: `EtbEffectResolver` rewrote its `LoseGameIfNotCastFromHandEffect` into a
  `TargetPlayerLosesGameEffect` bound to the controller. The card writes "if you didn't cast it from your hand" as its
  enters ability's intervening "if", `NotCondition(CastFromZone(HAND))` (an entry fact, judged as the ability triggers
  from the entering permanent, CR 603.4), and "you lose the game" as the existing `ControllerLosesGameEffect`;
  `LoseGameIfNotCastFromHandEffect` and its resolver handler are gone. Rulings checked (putting it onto the battlefield
  from your hand isn't casting it; casting it from the command zone isn't from your hand): both lose, as before.
- Bladecoil Serpent's and Clay Champion's "for each {C}{C} spent to cast it": `EtbEffectResolver.snapshotManaPairs`
  rebuilt Bladecoil Serpent's `DrawCardEffect`, `DiscardEffect` and `BoostSelfEffect` (in a sequence or conditional
  too) with the pairs frozen into a `Fixed`, because the game's record of the payment is cleared when the first of its
  three abilities resolves. The spell's entry records the payment by color as the spell becomes cast
  (`StackEntry.manaSpentByColorToCast`, beside the mana spent, CR 601.2i), the permanent keeps it as the spell resolves
  into it (`Permanent.manaSpentByColorToCast`, copied with the permanent, so its last-known information keeps it,
  CR 608.2h), and `ColorManaPairsSpentToCast` reads the source permanent's record, else the spell's payment (Clay
  Champion's "enters with" counters). The effects go on the stack as written; `snapshotManaPairs` is gone.
- The each-end-step reader (`StepTriggerService`) recorded "that player" on every entry but its untargeted "you may"
  (`queueMayAbility`) and Colfenor's Urn branches; both record the step player now (`recordStepPlayer`).
- `CombatDamageService`'s attached combat-damage reader unwrapped an `EnchantedPermanentConditionalEffect` against the
  creature as the ability triggered; no card's triggered ability is one (the class is a static wrapper; Helm of the
  Ghastlord grants its abilities with conditional grants), so the branch is deleted.

No rules fix: each site played as before for the cards that reach it.

#### Run 17z13b: the emblems' marker and step-wrapper abilities are emblem `TriggeredAbility`s, and `@CollectsEmblemTrigger` is gone

Row 17z13b, done, the step wrappers included: no emblem holds a triggered ability in its static effects any more, and
the `@CollectsEmblemTrigger` machinery is gone. Step 15 stays open: rows 17z13c to 17z13e.

**What the inspection found** (each site re-grepped, the cards found by a grep of the card sources for the marker and
wrapper classes, and read):

- `GraveyardService.collectEmblemPutIntoGraveyardTriggers` read Tamiyo, the Moon Sage's
  `ReturnCardPutIntoGraveyardToHandEffect` by class and stacked an engine-made
  `MayEffect(ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToOwnerHandEffect)` with the arrived card as the entry's source, skipping
  tokens.
- `DeathTriggerCollectorService.handleEmblemArtifactGraveyardReturn` (the `@CollectsEmblemTrigger` handler of Daretti,
  Scrap Savant's `EmblemArtifactGraveyardReturnTriggerEffect`, dispatched by
  `TriggerCollectionService.collectEmblemArtifactGraveyardTriggers`) built the Lifeline-form
  `RegisterDelayedReturnDyingCreatureUnderControlEffect` and skipped tokens; `PermanentRemovalService` called the
  collector only for a permanent that was an artifact as it left (`wasArtifact`). The domain also held
  `RegisterDelayedReturnDyingArtifactUnderControlEffect` and its handler, which no card wrote (the agent-docs named it
  as Daretti's).
- `DrawService.checkEmblemDrawTriggers` read Teferi, Hero of Dominaria's `ExileTargetOpponentPermanentOnDrawEffect` by
  class and queued an `EmblemTriggerTarget` with an engine-made `ExileTargetPermanentEffect` and an
  `opponentControlledOnly` flag, which the choice and its answer read.
- `CreateEmblemEffectHandler` registered Huatli, Radiant Champion's emblem as a persistent Beck source
  (`GameData.creatureEntersDrawSources`) for `DrawOnControlledCreatureEntersEffect`, and
  `TriggerCollectionService.checkCreatureEntersThisTurnTriggers` queued an engine-made `MayEffect(DrawCardEffect)`
  through the may queue, asked before the ability was on the stack.
- `DeathTriggerCollectorService.handleEmblemCreatureDeath` put Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's
  `EmblemCreatureDeathTriggerEffect` effects on the stack as declared, its target filter on the death choice; it and
  Daretti's handler were the only `@CollectsEmblemTrigger` handlers.
- `StepTriggerService.collectEmblemStepTriggers` read the 21 `EmblemStepTriggerEffect` wrappers of 20 cards by class and
  `EmblemTriggerStep`, the declared effects unchanged; `END_OF_FIRST_COMBAT` (Zariel, Archduke of Avernus) was judged
  with `combatPhasesThisTurn == 1`.
- One wrapper is no triggered ability: Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset's "You draw a card during each opponent's draw
  step". Its ruling: "They will draw a card during their draw step and then you will draw a card during their draw
  step. No player gets priority to cast spells or activate abilities between those card draws." The wrapper put an
  ability on the stack after the opponent's draw, which the players could respond to.

**What changed.**

- Tamiyo: `Triggers.putIntoGraveyardFromAnywhere(Triggers.NONTOKEN, ObjectRelation.YOU_OWN)` +
  `MayEffect(new ReturnTriggeringCardToOwnerHandEffect(), "Return that card to your hand?")`. `GraveyardService`'s
  reader judges the emblems' "from anywhere" graveyard abilities as the card arrives: the relation `YOU_OWN` (a card
  goes to its owner's graveyard), the filter on the card ("a card": a token isn't one, CR 108.2b; the filter does what
  the token skip did). The entry's source is the emblem's card, the arrived card its triggering card for that stay

#### Run 17z13c: the cards write the effects and conditions the collectors made for them (rows 17z13c and 17z13d)

Rows 17z13c and 17z13d, done. Step 15 stays open: row 17z13e.

**What the inspection found** (each site re-grepped, the cards found by a grep of the card sources for the classes, and
read):

- Storm Cauldron: `LandTapTriggerCollectorService.handleReturnTappedLandToHand`, the only reader of
  `ReturnTappedLandToHandEffect`, stacked an engine-made `ReturnToHandEffect.triggering()`, and didn't trigger at all when
  the tapped land had already left the battlefield.
- Relic Bind: `MiscTriggerCollectorService.handleEnchantedPermanentTapRelicBind` built its own "choose one" (labels from
  `ChoiceContext.RelicBindModeChoice`) for `RelicBindTapEffect`. A second path resolved the marker from the stack
  (`RelicBindTapEffectHandler`, `PlayerInputService.beginRelicBindModeChoice`, `ChoiceHandlerService
  .handleRelicBindModeChoice`); nothing put the marker on the stack any more.
- Hullbreaker Horror: the cast collector stacked `HullbreakerHorrorTriggerEffect`, and
  `StackedModalTriggerService.announceHullbreakerHorrorMode` built the two modes and a "Do nothing" mode, then replaced the
  entry's effects. The permanent mode offered every permanent whose printed card isn't a land: hexproof, shroud and
  protection weren't judged. A resolution-time fallback (`HullbreakerHorrorTriggerEffectHandler`,
  `ChoiceContext.HullbreakerHorrorModeChoice`) was dead.
- Corrosive Ooze: `PermanentRemovalService.rememberCombatEquipmentAttachments` rebuilt
  `DestroyEquipmentOnEquippedCombatOpponentAtEndOfCombatEffect(schedule, lastKnownEquipmentIds)` on every stack entry and
  delayed end-of-combat action naming the departing creature; the effect's handler rebuilt itself with `schedule = false`
  for the delayed ability.
- Row 17z13d's three sites:
  - `TriggerCollectionService.collectSelfCastAbilities` dropped an `ExileTriggeringSpellWithSuspendCountersEffect` with
    `skipIfCastFromExile` for a spell cast from exile (Rory Williams' "from anywhere other than exile"), and the effect's
    handler checked the zone again.
  - The ward collector (`collectBecomesTargetOfOpponentCounterTriggers`) dropped a printed `CounterUnlessDiscardsEffect`
    when an ability targeted a source without the ward keyword: Reality Smasher's "becomes the target of a spell an
    opponent controls", written on the ward trigger. The 13 other cards with the effect there have ward—discard.
  - `MiscTriggerCollectorService.handleSelfBecomesUntapped` dropped a `RemoveLinkedPermanentEffect` when the source had no
    chosen permanent. No card writes the effect on `Triggers.becomesUntapped()` (Coffin Queen's untap exile is the
    engine's delayed `DelayedDestroyTargetWhenSourceLeaves`, step 16's), so the filter was dead.

**What changed.**

- Storm Cauldron writes `ReturnToHandEffect.triggering()`; the land-tap default puts it on the stack with the tapped land
  as its triggering permanent. The handler and `ReturnTappedLandToHandEffect` are gone.
- Relic Bind writes its "choose one" as a `ChooseOneEffect` of `DealDamageToTargetPlayerOrPlaneswalkerEffect(1)` ("This
  Aura deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker") and `TargetPlayerGainsLifeEffect(1)` ("Target player gains 1
  life"). The enchanted-tap watch routes a `ChooseOneEffect` to the trigger-time mode choice as written
  (`handleEnchantedPermanentTapModal`, ROUTE: the class picks the queue), with the tapped permanent as its triggering
  permanent; the mode and its target are chosen as the ability goes on the stack (CR 603.3c), as before.
  `RelicBindTapEffect`, its handler, `RelicBindModeChoice` and its begin and answer are gone.
- Hullbreaker Horror writes its "choose up to one" as an optional `ChooseOneEffect(options, true, 0, 1)`: "Return target
  spell you don't control to its owner's hand" (`ReturnTargetSpellToHandEffect` with
  `StackEntryPredicateTargetFilter(StackEntryNotPredicate(StackEntryControlledByPredicate))`) and "Return target nonland
  permanent to its owner's hand" (`ReturnToHandEffect.target()` with a nonland `PermanentPredicateTargetFilter`). The cast
  collector already queues a bare `ChooseOneEffect` as a `TriggeredModalTrigger`; that path learnt spell targets:
  `TriggerTargetCollector.hasLegalSpellTarget` (read by `hasLegalModeTargets` and the queue's
  `hasLegalTriggeredModeTarget`) offers a mode that targets a spell only while a spell its stack filter admits (or a spell
  or ability, for a filter that admits abilities) is on the stack, and `queueChosenTriggeredModalTrigger` hands a chosen
  spell-target mode to the existing `ETBSpellTargetTrigger` choice (CR 603.3d), which `handleTriggeredModalChoice` now
  processes. "Choose no modes" (`ChooseOneEffect.NO_MODE_LABEL`) puts nothing on the stack (CR 603.3c, 700.2b), as "Do
  nothing" removed the ability. The Hullbreaker branches of `StackedModalTriggerService`, `HullbreakerHorrorTriggerEffect`,
  its handler, `HullbreakerHorrorModeChoice` and its begin and answer are gone.
- Corrosive Ooze writes `new DelayedEndOfCombatEffect(new DestroyAttachmentsOnTargetCreatureEffect(false, true))` on both
  its block triggers. "The Equipment that was attached to that creature immediately before it left the battlefield will be
  destroyed" (its ruling) is a record, not a rebuilt effect: the departure
  (`PermanentRemovalService.rememberAttachmentsOfDepartingPermanent`, at the old call site, before the attachments fall
  off) records the Auras and Equipment attached to the departing permanent (`DyingCreatureAttachmentSnapshot.capture`, a
  `DepartedAttachments`) on every stack entry that targets it or names it as its non-targeting "that creature"
  (`StackEntry.lastKnownPermanentAttachments`, copied by the copy constructor) and on every delayed end-of-combat ability
  that affects it (`DelayedEndOfCombatTrigger.affectedPermanentAttachments`, a new record component), whatever their
  effects are. `DelayedEndOfCombatEffectHandler` gives the delayed ability the scheduling ability's non-targeting
  permanent as its "that creature" (`affectedPermanentId`) with the entry's record; the end-of-combat reader copies the
  record to the delayed entry; `DestroyAttachmentsOnTargetCreatureEffectHandler` destroys what is attached to the target
  and, once the target has left, what was attached to it just before (CR 608.2h), all as one batch
  (`DestructionSupport.destroyBatch`, as the Ooze handler's departure batch did). The effect class and its handler are gone.
- Rory Williams writes "when you cast this spell from anywhere other than exile" as its event condition,
  `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withEventCondition(new NotCondition(new CastFromZone(Zone.EXILE)))`, with the plain
  `ExileTriggeringSpellWithSuspendCountersEffect(3, CreateTokenEffect.ofClueToken(1))`. A trigger condition, not an
  intervening "if" (CR 603.2, 603.4): the zone a spell was cast from can't change, and the self-cast reader already judges
  event conditions (Banish into Fable's `CastFromZone(HAND)`). The collector's filter, the handler's zone check, the
  `skipIfCastFromExile` component and the `unlessCastFromExile` factory are gone.
- Reality Smasher's trigger is `Triggers.becomesTargetOfOpponentSpell()`, read by the spell-only becomes-the-target
  collector (`collectBecomesTargetOfOpponentSpellOnlyTriggers`, which records the triggering spell like the ward path);
  the ward collector's `CounterUnlessDiscardsEffect` removal is gone. The spell-only collector now skips the printed
  abilities of a face-down permanent and of one whose printed abilities were removed, as the ward collector does, so a
  Reality Smasher that lost its abilities still doesn't trigger.
- The untap collector's dead `RemoveLinkedPermanentEffect` filter is gone: such an ability has no intervening "if", so
  with no linked creature it would trigger and do nothing.

Rulings checked (`get_rulings`): Storm Cauldron (a land tapped for mana and sacrificed in one action goes to the graveyard
before the Cauldron can return it; the return is a triggered ability), Corrosive Ooze (the Equipment is determined as the

rulings). CR 603.2, 603.3c, 603.3d, 603.4, 603.7a, 608.2b, 608.2h, 700.2b and 702.21a verified.

**The audit.** `scripts/step15-run17z13e-audit.py` lists, for every watch, its `CardEffect.class` default and every
class-keyed registration (`@Collects…Trigger(value = X.class, watch = W)`, `registerCreatureDeath(W, X.class, …)`,
`LegacyTriggerBindings.register(h, X.class, …)`) with the record tokens each body sets, following the file's own helpers:
an entry, choice or may setter (`set:F`, a choice's `withF` counted as the same field), a `new StackEntry` with a target,
a cross-service recording or queueing call. Each is ROUTE (records what the default records), RECORD-GAP (records more or
less than the default, or the watch has no default and its handlers record different things), REWRITE (builds or unwraps
an effect) or DUP (a key registered twice); `HAND` overrides a wrong label, `ROWS` names the open row of each watch
family, `READERS` the step and draw readers' class-keyed branches. The labels are a heuristic (a handler that records
the same through another choice can be RECORD-GAP); the rows read them by hand.

- At `78f8d0424d`: 250 class-keyed registrations over 95 watches: 6 DUP, 4 REWRITE, 33 ROUTE, 207 RECORD-GAP; 113
  class-keyed reads in `StepTriggerService` and `DrawService`.
- After the run: 199 registrations: 0 DUP, 4 REWRITE, 27 ROUTE (one by `HAND`), 168 RECORD-GAP; 110 reads. Not ROUTE, by
  row: 17z13e2 23, 17z13e3 29, 17z13e4 34, 17z13e5 59, 17z13e6 11, 17z13e7 16; the reads are row 17z13e8's.

**What the reading found** (the life, enchanted-tap and step sites read by hand, the cards by a grep of their triggers):

- The DUPs: `LifeGainTriggerCollectorService.handleLifeGainSequence` and `MiscTriggerCollectorService`'s
  `handleLifeGainSequence` / `handleSequenceOnControllerLifeLoss` shared the `SequenceEffect` keys of "you gain life" and
  "you lose life" (the life-gain one recorded the source snapshot but no life gained, the other the life gained: Prize Pig's
  and Marina Vendrell's Grimoire's "that many" depended on which bean registered last), and
  `handleLifeGainPutCountersOnSelf` carried the "you gain life" key twice (a lone annotation and its container).
- The life watches: 35 class-keyed handlers (41 registrations). The life gained or lost was the event's value only where the effect's amount
  named it, or never (the counters, token, surveil, untap, prepared, energy and draw handlers recorded it unevenly); the
  losing player was "that player" only for a mill; the source snapshot only for a sequence or a "you may"; the "do this
  only once each turn" mark only for a "you may"; Kavu Predator's handler dropped the opponent the default records.
  "Whenever you lose life" had no default: an effect no handler named didn't trigger. Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin's
  "exactly 1 life" was judged by its `SequenceEffect` handler (`lifeLostAmount != 1`).
- "Whenever enchanted permanent becomes tapped": no default, eleven handlers; the tapped permanent was recorded by some, its
  controller by fewer, and `targetId` held the controller (Chronic Flooding's `TARGET_PLAYER` mill, Lust for War's
  damage, Seizures), the tapped land (Corrupted Roots' `TARGET_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER` loss) or nothing.
- The step readers: the your-upkeep `SurveilEffect` branch put all the permanent's upkeep effects in one bare entry and
  left the loop (Grave Researcher wrote its "surveil 1. Then if …" as two abilities, which this merged; every other surveil
  card lost the source snapshot, attached and granting permanent the generic branch records); the your-draw-step
  `MayEffect` branch queued a bare "you may" with no source permanent or "that player" (Sylvan Library); the your-end-step
  branch for `DestroyRandomOpponentPermanentWithCounterEffect` judged Haphazard Bombardment's intervening "if" by the class.

**What changed.**

- `TriggerCollectorRegistry.register` throws on a second handler for one (watch, class) key, so a collision fails as the
  registry is built (Spring start-up, every `scanBean`).
- Every life watch has one default, `LifeGainTriggerCollectorService.handleLifeDefault` ("you gain life", "an opponent
  gains life", "you lose life", "an opponent loses life", "you pay life"): a graveyard target goes to its choice (with the
  source permanent and the "do this only once each turn" mark), a permanent or player target to `LifeGainTriggerAnyTarget`
  (now carrying the player as `triggeringPlayerId` beside the amount; the entry it makes records both and the source's
  snapshot) or, for "up to X targets" (Heroic Feast), the group-by-group choice with the amount; any other ability goes on
  the stack as written with the amount as its event value, the player as its triggering player and, choosing no target, its
  non-targeting `targetId`, the source snapshot and the mark. A "you may" goes on the stack through `enqueueTrigger` like
  any other entry. Emet-Selch of the Third Seat's handler stays as the default's graveyard choice with its one-target count
  (ROUTE), moved to the life service. 34 handlers gone (`scripts/step15-run17z13e-life.py`: the 32 of
  `MiscTriggerCollectorService`, with their divider comments and an orphaned Javadoc; the life service's three by hand). `TriggerCollectionService.watchJudge` judges a life
  loss's and a payment's event conditions with the amount as the event's value, as it did a dice roll's.
- `MiscTriggerCollectorService.handleEnchantedPermanentTapDefault`: the Aura's ability records the tapped permanent and its
  controller, the controller as the non-targeting "that player" and the Aura's snapshot; a targeted ability (Darksteel
  Garrison) goes to `SelfTriggeredAbilityTarget` with the same record. Relic Bind's `ChooseOneEffect` route stays (row
  17z13e7: it records the tapped permanent only). 11 handlers gone (`scripts/step15-run17z13e-enchanted-tap.py`).
- `StepTriggerService`: the three branches are gone; those abilities go through the readers' generic branches.
- The cards say what they read (`scripts/step15-run17z13e-cards.py`): Ob Nixilis's event condition is `AllOf(EventValueAtLeast(1),
  NotCondition(EventValueAtLeast(2)))`; Grave Researcher's upkeep ability is one `SequenceEffect` (CR 603.3); Haphazard
  Bombardment's "if two or more permanents you don't control have an aim counter on them" is its intervening "if"
  (`AnyPlayerControlsPermanentCount(2, PermanentAllOf(PermanentHasCounters(AIM), PermanentNot(PermanentControlledBySourceController)))`,
  CR 603.4); Corrupted Roots, Contaminated Ground and Pooling Venom lose life for `LoseLifeRecipient.TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER`,
  Chronic Flooding mills `MillRecipient.TRIGGERING_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER`.
- `agent-docs` follow (`scripts/step15-run17z13e-docs.py`; `ARCHITECTURE.md`'s trigger-state note by hand).

Rulings checked: Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin (exactly 1 damage or life paid counts; three 1-power attackers are 3 life, no
trigger), Haphazard Bombardment, Roaming Throne, Emet-Selch of the Third Seat; Oracle text of Grave Researcher. CR 603.2d,

**Rules fix.** Chronic Flooding's "its controller mills three cards" was the controller as the ability triggered (baked
into `targetId`); it is the land's controller as the ability resolves (CR 608.2h).
`ChronicFloodingTest.landsControllerAsTheAbilityResolvesMills` (the land, a Dryad Arbor, stolen by Ray of Command with the
ability on the stack) fails at HEAD (the old controller milled: 6 cards left, expected 3) and passes. Corrupted Roots and
its kin read the land's controller as they resolved before too.

**Behaviour changes, not rules fixes.** An entry of a life ability that chooses no target now has a `targetId` (the
player) and `nonTargeting`; an effect that read `targetId` as its recipient got none before on most of these watches, and
no card's life effect reads one but through `TRIGGERING_PLAYER`. The ordinary life "you may" (Ratchet, Field Medic) now goes
through `enqueueTrigger`: Roaming Throne doubled it before as well (`RoamingThroneTest.doublesChosenTypeCreatureLifeGainMayTrigger`
passes at HEAD), and a life gain during a mana ability now queues it with the mana-ability triggers.

**Not changed, noted.** The life collectors don't record a granted ability's granting permanent (no card reads one); the
step readers' other class-keyed branches (the your-end-step "you may" branch skips a "you may draw" when drawing is
prevented, its bare `queueMayAbility` records no snapshot) are row 17z13e8's; a triggered mana ability among the tap
handlers is argued in row 17z13e2.
